tei:div.tei:p: badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥsngon 'gro'i khog phub kyi rim pa pad tshal rgyas pa bzhugs soḥ

—8rdo: na mo dz+nya na ḍak+ki ni ya /ra 63 'bum phrag mkha' 'gra'i sprin dpung 'khrigs la phyag 'tshal lo skyabs 'gro niḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang ḍak+ki dbyer med pa dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i sprin rab 'byams mngon sum du bzhugs par gsal btab laḥ na mo byin rlabs char 'bebs bla ma dngaḥ dngos grub sprin 'khrigs yi dam lha bde stong dpal 'bar mkha' 'gro rnamasaḥ mngon gyur rig pas skyabs su mchiḥ semasabaskyed niḥ hoḥ ye nas gnyis su ma mchis kyang rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khrul rten 'brel snang ba'i pha ma rnams ye dag chos skur 'god par bya tshogs bsags na na moḥ rdul bral dbyings kyi nam mkha' laḥ lhan skyes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor sharaX phyogs ris bral ba'i gzigs pa canaḥ bdud 'dul drag mor phyag bgyi'oX rang bzhin gsal ba'i chos nyid ngor ma 'dres shar ba'i dga' ston niḥ kun bzang rol pa chen po'i sprinaḥ ye shes dbyings su 'bul 'bya'oḥ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems nyid kyiX lhan skyes bag nyal dri ma bsags sku gsum zhal ras sgrib byed rnams gting gsal shes rab chen pos

padz+ra: bshagasaX sna tshogs sprul sku'i bkod par g.yoX rang bzhin 'od gsal longs skur rdzogasaḥ ye mnyam ka dag chos kyi skuraḥ ngo mtshar chen po'i yi rang ngo ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' yas suḥ de srid sems can khams rnams laḥ gang 'dul mdzad pa'i phrin las suḥ theg gsum sgon me gsal bar bskulaḥskyes 'gag med las skyes dang 'gagasaḥ thams cad rang bzhin mnyam mod kyang: gdul byas dpal mtshor gzigs pa'i skuḥ mi nub bzhugs par gsol ba 'debasaḥdus gsum bsags palirnam dkar dge gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngoḥ kun kyang rang rig mngon gyur nas sku gsum lhun grub sa thob shogaḥ maṇ+ḍal ni na 53 gleng bzhi bshad mjes maṇ+ḍal dang 'od gsal 'gags med rgyan gyi dpal kun khyab rig pa'i dga' ston rnams lhan skyes mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bulaḥrat+na maṇ+ḍal badz+ra pū dzi te ā(ཿmgos kyi zhing rab 'byams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas gnyis su med par bsam moX dkar gtor 'bul ba niḥ spyo las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum las

byung ba nam mkha' mdzod du gyuraḥ a ka ro yi byin gyis brlabs kye stong gsum stong gi 'jigs rten la dbang bsgyur sa yi lha mo dang lha klu gnyan gtod dri za sogs dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad kunaḥ rang bzhin gnas nas da tshur byonaḥ 'o phud rgya mtsho lta bu dang dkar bshos gangs ltar brjid ldan 'di bdag gis 'bul lo bzhes su gsolaḥ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor dam pa 'diraḥ yang dag byang chub sgrub pa laḥ 'gal rkyen ci yang ma mdzad par ༷ mthun snang legs tshogs dpal yon bskyedaX dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ dam la ma 'da' sa ma yu dmar gtor ni hūṃ las rin po che'i sgod du oṃ las dmar gtor sha khrag gi rgyan ldan zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur oṃ ā rtsi nam mkha' mdzod sngags gyis spel laḥhrī slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar khas blangs dam mnos pa'i dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogasaX gangs ljongs skyong ba'i tha tshig can: kun kyang rang rang g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ thogs med stobs kyis 'dir byon laX bza' ba sha khrag dmar gtor dngaḥ btung ba ja chang skyems phud rnamasaX shin tu

ga6rdo: dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyisaḥ bzhes la bdag gi stong grogs mdzod sngags spyod sgrub pa zab mo 'diraḥ 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog zhi rgyas dbang drag gang bcol lasaX thogs med yid bzhin grub par mdzod dam la ma 'da' sa ma māḥ bgegasagator ni bdag nyid skad cig gis dbang chen he ru ka dmar po g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa dur khrod dpal chas kyis brgyan cing ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du 'bying bar bskyed doḥ de'i spyi gtsug nas rta skad drag po stong gsum khengs par bton pas dregs pa can thams cad las la 'chun zhing ༷ mi srun pa'i rigs can thams cad gtor ma'i mgron du rang dbang med par 'gugs par bsam sbyo las rin po che'i snod du treḥlas glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung por gyuraḥ 3 ārtuḥ sam bha ra dang a ka ros sbyangs spel nam mkha' mdzod du spro mtshams lha hūṃ sgrub ltar du bskyed gzhung bzhin bka' bsgo bta ba'i rjes 'dod yon 'bras glud bsngo ba niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ sngon nas lan chags la re zhingaḥ 'phral du nad gdon gtong ba'i 'dre gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur

lhag thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shigaX rnal 'byer bdag cag sgrub pa po'iḥ tshe skyin sgog glud 'byung lnga'i yasaḥ nam mkha' mda' 'phang rgyan dang bcasaḥ gtor kyu changabu mar me dang zhal zas 'bras chan sha chang sogasaḥ 'dod yon bza' btung phun tshogs gteraḥ dug gsum las skyes gdon la bsngoḥ ngoms shing tshim la mgu gyur te gnas 'dir 'tshe bar ma byed paraḥ rgya mtsho chen po'i pha 'thar debhe saḥ gal te'akhu zhing 'tshe gyur naḥ rdo rje'i mtshon chas brlag 'gyur roḥ de bas da ltar phyir dengs shigaXsarba bhisnan gasne hūṃ bzhi' sngag bsdod thun gyis brab gshas med bsrung ba'i gur khang phub sa ma yu brda sgo dbye ba ni hūṃ 〉ཿ chos rnams gdod nas spros dang bral ba laḥ rnam rtog dbang gis du ma sosor bzung don la gnyis med zab gsal phyag rgya ches sgrib byed ma rig dra ba dbye bar bgyi spyo maṇ+ḍal pra gesha ya phaṭaḥ brda phyag yol ba niḥ shā /༷ yenas lhan skyes dri bralarig pa'i gshisaḥ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhan lcan gyis grubaḥ de don mngon rgyur so so rang rig pasaX lta ba mjal ba'i phyag 'di 'bul 'bya'o ḍagli sa ma ya na moḥ dam

—'di: bca' bzung ba niḥ hū (ཿ gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i sku gsum dbyings ma rgyud ḍāk+ki'i gsang ba chen po steḥ lta spyod sgom pa'i ting 'dzin gzungs thag gisaX rtag tu 'brel bar bya zhing mi gtong sgrub tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya hūṃX byin bskul ni rang rang rnams kyis dad mos tshad med pa'i lcags kyus bskul teX rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad 'jigs byed bdud 'dul drag mo'i skur bzhengs te gnas 'dir byin chen dbab cing ye shes lnga'i dbang bskur bsam laḥ khye 〉ཿ mi gnas chos sku spros dang bral mod kyangaḥ ye shes gzigs pa 'gags med mngon snang ba'iḥ mkha' spyod 'bum phrag tshogs rje bdud 'dul maḥ gnas 'dir byon la dbang byin char ltar phob rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro sde brgyad ḍak+ki dang dbang phyug nyer brgyad phrin las phyag rgya moḥngo bo gcig las rnam rol mtha' yas paraX gnas 'dir byin phob ye shes dbang mchog bskur: tsho/ mahā ka ru ṇi ka tri shu hoḥ sa ma ya hoX sa ma ya stamaḥbaskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas:thugs bskyed smon lam dam bca' mnga' lags pas dus

las ma g.yel mchog thun dngos grub stsolaX ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dbang bskur cigaḥ dz+nyā na dhartu mu drwa sa ma ya a we sha ya a āḥ bshags pa niḥho rtag chad mu bzhir gol ba'i nyes sgrib kyis rang byung ye shes sku gsum zhal ras sgribaḥ da ni shes rab rdo rje rnon po yis chos sku mtha' bral thig le'i klong du bshagasaX badz+ra sa ma ya bi shudhe ā yig brgya bzla sman mchod ni snyen āḥ(ཿ mtshan ldan bhan+ta dum gcig khyon yangs dbus sha lnga bdud rtsi rigs lnga yab yum kyis bde stong zag med byang chub sems bcud bskyilaX rnams rtog mtshan ma bcom pa'i rdzas su sharaX o mahā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥ thā rdul bral gzigs pa mtha' yas 'od dpag med byams dang snying rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigasaX gdul bya'i skyabs gcig pad+ma 'byung gnas la sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol dga' rab rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug dngaḥ shrī sedha don dam gsang mdzod 'dzinaḥ bī ma mi tra ye shes bka' rgya mtshor sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang 'phags yul grub pa'idabang spyag brgyad cu dngaḥ gangs ljongs mun sel rje 'bangs nyi shu

btsasdo: dgu snyigs ma'i skyabs mgon gter ston rgya mtsho laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo gdod nas dri bral chos sku kun bzang mo rang bzhin 'od gsal longs sku wa ra hi ༷ thugs rje thabs mkhas khros ma nag mo laX sman mchod 'bul 'o gzhan snang zel gnon bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdongaX tshad med thugs rje mtha' yas mkha' 'gro bzhiḥ rang rang sprul pa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo dur khrod brgyad srung rdo rje phra men brgyadaX rnal 'byor grogs mo dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad brin las lhun grub sgo skyong ma bzhi laḥ sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsolaX dug gsum rtsad gcod sha za spun gsum dang nyon mongs bdud 'joms dam can lha lnga dang dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dam can rgya mtsho la sman mchod 'bul lo phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs snod kyi 'jigs rten mkha' spyod bde chen zhingaḥ bcud kyi sems can dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dalaḥ ye nas gnyis med bde ba chen po la sman mchod 'bul lo rtogs pa mngon gyur shog mahā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha re khā hiḥ khosgom yi dam tshig rdo rje pad+mo la

ye shes snying po gsal bar hū sgom teḥ thabs shes mthe srin phyag rgyas dngos grub blangaX gnyis med gnyam sbyor hū gis myang bar bya kā ya sirnyi 3 ༷ wāk+ka sirnyi.ā tsit+ta sidhi shā sarba sirnyi hrīX gnas gsum la gtug pa lce yos stong gsang gsum dngos grub thob par dmags sa ma pāḥye maḥ reg 'jin brgyud pa'i gsang mdzod 'di zla gam dbang chen bde ba'i gleng pad+ma rak+ta 'khyil ba'i gnas de dang 'brel ba'i sbas pa'i mamo lha chen 'dod rgyal dmar nag gi bla mtsho gsang ba'i sgrom rgya las pad+ma'i pha nor zab pa'i mdzod phrin las sha za spun gsum gyis bskul zhing 'du ba'i brda thabs kyis du mar bskul tshe gsal bamathong bstan 'gro'i don phyir shog skyar bkodaḥ sam māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen dharma saman+ta bha tra badz+ra mtshan can gsum gyis bskul ba dang / nye char shesarab nas kyang mos blos bskul ngo kho bo bdud 'jomasanam mkha'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las zhal bzhus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chosanyed rang grol gyi bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅka lo/

— mi: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX bdud 'dul drag mo'i gsol 'debs 'bar ba'i gzi ldan bzhugs soḥgatsasdo: namo zhi ni yaḥ mam〉〉 skyabs mul lha tshogs mdun mkhar gsal khyed shes dad pas gsol gdab ni e ma ho ༷ ka dag ye grol chos sku'i pho brang nas dab bla ma thugs rje'i gter mdzod laḥ gsol ba 'debs so sgo gsum smin grol nasaḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod maro na gyur shogaX 'gag med rang grol lobrang nasaḥ brda brgyud bla ma mkhyen brtse'i gter chen laX gsol ba 'debs so 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rtsol med rang grol sprul sku'i pho brang nasaḥ snyan brgyudabazhi 'dus laX gsol ba 'debs so 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i dri med klong yangs bde chen pho brang nas khrag 'thung nus ldan bdud 'joms khyung drag laX 'debs 'bum phrag mkha' 'pho med ye shes gzigs pa'i pho brang nasaḥ brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs 'bum phrag rgya chad phyog

ba'i dbyings klong nas dang po'i yum chen kun tu bzang mo laḥ gsol ba 'debs so bde stong rtsal 'bar nasaḥ lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par byin gyis rlobasaX 'od gsal mtha' dbus bral ba'i pho brang nas lhun grub yum chen dz+nya na wa ra hir gsol ba 'debs so bde stong rtsal 'bar nas lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par byin gyis gyis rlobasaḥphyogs med mdzad pa mtha' yas pho brang nasaḥ gzhan snang zil gnon bdud 'dul drag mo la gsol ba 'debs so bde stong lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par tshad med mdzad pa bsam yas pho brang nasaX phrin las lhun grub drag mo rigs bzhi laX gsol ba 'debs so bde stong lhan skyes ye shes 'bar ba'i rang bzhin dur khrod gnas brgyad nasaḥbadud tshogs zil gnon mkha' 'gro sde brgyad laX gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes bde stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nasaX 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs so bde stong lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par bka' nyan dam tshig gnyan srung pho brang nas las mdzad pho nya dam can rgya mtsho la gsol ba

—'di: 'debs so brin las lhun grub cingaḥgadug tshogs zil gyis gnon par byin gyis rlobasaḥde ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin brlabs kyis lus ngag yidakyi mtshan 'dzin rang sar dag snod bcud brtan g.yo dkyil 'khor gsum du sminaḥsku dang ye shes yon tan bkod parasdogasaḥnang dbyings gting gsal bum skur byang chub regagaX de ltar mkha' 'gro'i gas sgrub kyi kha bskang gsol ba 'debs pa' thabs las can bu dang 'phrad gyur teḥbastan dang 'gro la pha na thog shogaḥs ma yuḥrgya rgya rgyaḥkho po bdud 'jom khyung drag pas/dbang phyug 'dod rgyaladamar po' gnas mdun nas/mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod sna bar byed pa' yi ge pa nisngags skyasadharmā'i ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasabadud 'dul drag mo'i zab sgrub bde stong dpal 'bar bzhugs soḥ

sa /sde: na mo sernyi ḍazhi ni yaḥ ཿ rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las ye shes gzigasapa'i spyan ldan ma bdud dpung tshar gcod seṅge'i gdong 'bar ba'i sprin ldan la phyag 'tshal tshogs smon las 'phri 'dzom pa yi gang zag dad dam ldan pa la 'brel tshad don ldan rig 'dzin gyis gsang lam mkha' 'gro'i zab sgrub bstan sa ma mā de yang dben gnas rngam bajid par phyin la sa bslang yul gzhi brngan dkar dmar gtor ma rgya cher 'bul lan chags 'gegs la sku glud bsngo phya nang gegs bsal dam rgya bsdam bsrung ba'i gur kub phun tshogs lnga'i gzhi bzung bsnyen sgrub gzhus bsrang ba ting 'dzin 'gyur med ngang gnasate lta ba'i mar+yās gcod bya ba niḥ hū hūṃ hū nga ni ye nas rnam dag bdud 'dul maḥ nga bdag gdon gyis snang ngor drag mo'i skuḥ khams gsum gdos por za ba'i 'jigs byed ma'i ye shes rang rtsal pho nya mtshon sgogs 'phroḥ ma rtogs log spyor yas kyis mi ngom par glags tshol byed rnams chos nyid stong par bsre0 hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa bsrung 'khor ni / hrī mi dmigs gzhom bral chos dbyings stong pa'i gur dag gsal ye shes 'khor 'das bde mnyam sang phyag rgya me dpung mtshon chas rwa gur gtams kun rdzob mtshan mas

btsasdo: gzhom gzhig bral bar bltaḥ dz+nyā na dhartu rak+taḥ byin 'bebs niḥ hū hrīḥ dbus mtha' med pa dag mnyam dbyings klong nasaḥ dbum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gsang 'dzin wa ra hiḥ gzhan snang zil gnon bdud 'dul drag mo'i skuX ye shes rang mdangs sgyu 'phrul sa ya 'bum ༷ gzugs skur ngom bzhin skal ldan pho mo laḥ rtogs pa mngon gyur don gyi byin phob cigaḥ dhak+ki ni sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ bdag gnas yo byad byin brlabs ni sa ā hūḥbadag gzhan dngos por 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangasaḥ yul drug dgyes bskang ye shes mchod pa'i sprin yid 'ong rdo rje lha mo'i spro bsdu bcasaḥ gang shar rang grol kun bzang rgyan du spelaḥ o badz+ra (bye hūṃX oṃ badz+ra dhu pe (ཿ sa badz+ra a lo ke (ཿ sa badz+ra gharnye 〉ཿ tho badz+ra de wi bye (ཿ ma badz+ra shabha (ཿ badz+ra sarba byu dza me gha (ཿ sa āḥ hūṃ sarba pañtsa a pra hūṃ hrī0'iḥ sa āḥhū mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūṃ hriḥ'i oṃ āḥhūṃ mahā bha lidha hūṃ hrīḥjaḥ.o āḥtī bo dri tsit+ta sarba pu dza spa ra ṇa dzaḥ la bskyed ni maḥ chos sku'i dgongs pas 'chi ba dbyings su sbrangasaḥ longs sku'i ngang nas bar do 'od gsal bsreḥ sprul sku'i 'gro don skye

ba gang 'dul spyodaḥ rmad byung ting 'dzin gsum gyi btsan sa 'dzin ༷sa āhūṃ badz+ra sa ma dhī hrī zhing khams lha bskyed zhe yeḥyum lngalimakha' la bde stong rab g.yos te 'bar ba'irang bzhin mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhingaḥ rdul bral ri bo sna tshogs gangs ri laḥ a 'thas 'dzin pa bcom pas rtsi shing mtshonaḥ chags med bde sbyin rgyun 'bab rak+tar 'phroḥ phrayul rang grol brag shing me mtsho rlungaX phra rtog ro mnyam bya gcan sha za g.yo dodabus sku gsum lhun rdzogs thod mkhar dbus chos 'byung dmar nag bde chen 'gyur med klong ma chags pad nyi rtog med ro gdan kharaX rig pathaḥmayang spro bsdus zhu ba lasaḥzel gnon mkha' 'dza bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdongaX log rtog rgyun gcod mun pa'i gos canal phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rus rgyan rnam par bkraḥ seng zhal gzigs pas khams gsum nga ro 'joms dmar ser ral pas srid pa'i snang shes bsregasaḥ thod rgyan rdo rjesachos nyid stong srog 'gyedaḥ seng chung 'asgo ba nyid zla gza' skar 'jomasaḥ phyag g.yas snang ba dbyings sbyor gri gug phyaraX g.yon pas bde stong rgyas 'debs bhan khrag 'dzin

—8rdo: thabs mchog mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan khung brten srid zhi ro mnyam g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang 'gyeng seng skad sgrogs pas dug lnga'i gdon tshogs brgyal gser sked rin chen dril chung chos sgra 'gyedaḥ gdos por ma grub rtag lta dbyings su sgrol 'od gsal dwangs 1nga chad mtha'i dngos gnyen steḥ sku gsum bde chen mnyam pa nyidakyi ngangaḥ ye shes rab 'bar rdo rje'i me chen sproX mtshan 'dzin gdon gyi phung khams 'khrul pa bsregasaḥ rigs bdag rgyal kun sras mchog pad+ma 'byungaḥ he ru ka pa'i chas rdzogs rol stabs bzhugasaX rdo rje bhan+ta bsnol ba'i thabs su 'dzin gnyams med bde chen chen rnal 'byor 'khril sbyor rolaḥ rtsa ba'i sku la gnas yul he ru ga'i 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin rdzogasaḥ kun kyang bde stong nyams la dgyes par spyodaX mtshan 'dzin 'khrul ba'i chags rtogs sang sa bar byed de yi phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i kharaX gnyis snang rū tra gan skyal 'gyel ba'i kharaḥ rdo rje seng gdong spug nag rngam pa'i sku renachen seng gdong ser nag gtum pa'i zhalaḥ pad+ma seng gdong dmar nag

bshad pa'i gar0 garmaseng gdong ljang nag khro zhing gtumaḥ kun gyi phyag mtshan gri gug thod khrag 'dzin kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan bcug ral pa me ltar 'baraḥ thod rgyan rdo rje seng chung glogaltar 'byugasaX rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs me klong gar stabs rolaX tshad med mdzad pas gdul bya'i re ba skong phyirim pad+ma 'dab brgyad bam gyi stengaḥ tshogs brgyad rang grol mkha' 'gro sde brgyad niḥ 'jigs rngams gdong pa gdug rtsub mtshon cha bsnams mthing nag khro gtum srin mo khros 'dra'i nyamasaḥ mi lngags go bgo sbrul chun gzigs sham klubs me dud sprin rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bskyedaX bka' nyan mkha' 'gro sde bzhis sgo rnams srung phrin las rnam bzhis gdul bya'i re ba skong gang 'dul sbyor sgolamadzad thabs du ma yis mtshan bcas nyams pa can la bka' chad 'bebs mtshan med bde stong sgom pa'i grogs su sharaXkun gyithugs sgog 'od zer lcags kyu yis rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes lha tshogs bskul: dam ye ro gcig mnyam pa nyid du bsreḥ zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i rol bar bzhugs ḍāk+konihaḥriḥniḥs badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza:

badz+ra: spyan 'dren ni hū trīḥ skyed med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid lasaḥ rnam rol skye ba'i cho rol bsgyur mdzad pa'iḥ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seṅge'i gdong pa can 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsolaḥ rin chen rus pa'i rgyan cha khro lo loḥ gser sked rin chen dril chung si li liX rnyan pa'i glu dbyangs chos sgra 'u ru naḥ'adu ba tshogs kyi dpung bcas tshubs se tshubaX gnas 'dir byon la dbang bskur rtogs pa sboraḥ nyams rtogs dpal bskyed don gnyis lhun grub mdzodaḥ ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar sharaX ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs nyi ltar gsalaX dbyer med zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i klongaḥdam ye tha mi dad par bzhugs su gsolaḥ dzā na dhartu tiṣ+ṭha lhan phyag 'tshal ni na moX ma chen phyag rgya mkha' ltar dag pa'i klongaX dam tshig ye shes srog gcig 'brel ba yisaḥgadung shugs mos pa'i sems ldan sgrub mchog gisaḥ brkyang bskum 'bying bag gar bcas phyag bgyi'oḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ phya mchod na hūṃ dhiX gzung ba dag pa'i dga' ston ngo

mtshar gnas mdzes pa'i me tog dri zhim bdug pa spos dbang gi sgron me bde mchog dri yi chab ro ldan zhal zas dbyangs snyan rol mo rnamasaḥ ma cig bdud 'dul drag mobaskang phyir 'bulaḥ zang thal ye shes rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ khyed badz+ra pusgodhu pe a lo ke gharnye nai wi bye shabha pra twe ts+tsha ye swāhā nang mchod niḥ/ hrī 'dzog pa 1del b.lidaga'aston 'phrul mo cheX mdzes pa'i gzugs bzang snyan pa sgra yi rigs zhim pa dri dang mngar ba ro bcud ldan 'jam bde reg bya ye shes chos kyi dpalaḥ ma lus bdud 'dul dragamo dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ gang shar rang grol rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol oṃ badz+ra du pa shabha gharnye ra sa sparnye dharma pra tits+tsha ye swāhāX gsang mchod na shā hrī ro mnyam banab chen po'idaga' ston niḥ mdzes 'dzum sgeg bzhad g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur canaḥ rdo rje'i rig ma yid jeng bde sbyin dpalaḥ dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga'i zhal bzang ngomasaX gsang bamachog gi mchod pa 'bul bgyi'oḥ bde stong ye shes zag med rtogs pa'i mthu ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo/sa bdag la stsolaḥdzad badz+ra mu dra ma ha pā dza sa ma ya hoḥ a nu rā ga

—8rdo: sirnyi pha la hūṃ sman mchod niḥ ( hrīḥ dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i a dṛ ta rigs lnga yab yum gsang bar byin rlabs pasaḥmyong grol sngags kyi dga' ston mid byung ba ma chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bulaḥ yo mahā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiḥ rak+ta ni hūṃ hrīX srid pa'i rtsa ba 'khor ba'i bag chags bsgralaḥ rten 'brel dbyings stong chags pa bcom pa'i rdzasaX dmar chen rak+ta tshar gsum 'bul bar bgyi ma dang mkha' 'gro'i don gsum grub par mdzodaX ma mahā rak+ta kha re khā hiḥ gtor ma niḥ / hrīX snang ba brdal khyab yangs pa'i gzhong pa ru srid pa bcud kyi dpal rdzogs gtor chen bshamasaX bde stong lha mo'i spro bsdu 'khrigs pa 'di ma chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang phyir 'bulaḥ mahā ba lirnya kha ram̐ khāhiḥ sbyor mchod niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ gnyis 'dzin chags pa'i rtog pa bcom pa'i phyir: bde chen 'khor lo lnga yi da la rtsa thabs shes mnyam par sbor ba'i byang sems sminaḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bulaḥ o mahwa bo dhi tsitā kha ram̐ khāhiḥ sgrol mja ni tram̐ hriX las ngan nasal ba'i bag chags rgyan

gcod phyiraḥ thog mar bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bsgralaḥ de nas gnyis med blo yis gzhan snang skyongs dong sprugs zlos gar mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ o ma hā ma tram̐ rū tra pra ban tsakra pra we sha ya phaṭa de bzhin nyid mchad ni e chos rnamasarang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dgaḥ ka dag ye mnyam thig le nyag gcig klong mngon gyur lta ba dag pa'i mchod pa 'di ma bu'i dgongs rgyud bsre phyir 'bul 'byi'o oṃ ma hā shu bye ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3nya byu dza hoḥ bstod pa ni / trīX ngo bo gdod nas ka dag kun bzang moḥrang bzhin 'od gsal ro mnyam wa ra hiḥ kun gzigs thugs rje ma 'gags khros mar shar sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod klong la bstodaḥ chos kyi dbyings nyid dag gsal me long zhalaḥ bde stong ro mnyam chags bral sor rtogs dang bya ba lhun grub gzung 'dzin bdud 'joms pa'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga sedha ka lir bstod tshogs brgyad gabrul ba'i gdon tshogs sma phab cing dregs pa'i sde tshogs zil gnon dam la 'dog lhun grub sgo brgyad nang gsal klong du bsre thabs mkhas sde brgyad mkha' 'gror phyag

gtsasdo: 'tshal bstodaḥrnal 'byor yongs la grogs ltar snying nye zhingaḥbran bzhin 'dud cing ma ltar gdung ba yiḥbade stong dpal sbyin dbang phyug nyi shu brgyadaḥrang rang g.yog 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥtshad med rnam bzhis gang 'dul mdzad thabs mkhasaḥdakyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs kyi sgo bsrung ba'iḥzhi rgyas dbang drag mdzad pa'i pho nya ba mkha' 'gro sde 'azhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥhū trīḥchags bral pad nyi rtog med ro gdan khar gzhan snang zil gnon bdud 'dul drag mo ni:mun pa'i go bgos sedha'i gdong ba canaḥdamar ser ral gsebs seng chung 'gyed la bstodaḥgazigs pa g.yas su ngom pas pho tshogs 'dulaḥgayon du ngom pas mo rgyud dam la 'dogasaḥmadun du gzigs pas dregs pa las la 'junaḥ'agran bral dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥphyag g.yas gri gug nyon mongs rgyun gcod phyaraX g.yon pa bde stong dpal sbyin bhan+ta 'dzin thabs shes cha 'dzin mkha' 'gro las la 'gyedaḥdakyil 'khor spro bsdus rgyal mor phyag 'tshal bstodaXdapa' bo'i rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan du

dug gsum rtsad gcod sku gsum rtags chas brgyanaḥ dar sna'i co pan ḍa ru dril chung mdzesaḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprin 'khrigs klong la bstod sku la phar phyin drug nas pas brgyanaX gzhan snang 'dul ba'i dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phuraḥ brkyang bskum gar gyis srid zhi'i sgo 'phar gnonaX 'gro 'dren mthu ldan ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaX mkha' la thugs rje shugs kyis 'gro bde stong dpal sbyin gdul byas re ba skongaḥ ye shes gzigs pas 'khor ba chos skur spyor gdul bya'i skyabs mgon ma la phyag stodaḥ bskal ba dpag tu med pas sngon rol nasaX ma chen khyed dang 'bral med 'grogs pa'i mthuX ye shes gsang grog gcig pa'i dam tshig bzhin ma chen khyod kyis ༷/nga bar mdzodaḥ lhan skyes rtog pa mngon du gyur pa dang 'gyur med ting 'dzin zas kyis 'tsho bzhin duḥ sa lam yon tan rtsal chen rab rdzogs teḥ 'bum phrag mkha' /sang mdzod mngon gyur 〈snagaḥ bshags pa naḥ hoḥ 'khor 'das gnyis su lta ba sems kyi ngang blang dor rtsis gdab gang yang rtog pa'i 'phrangaḥ thams cad a 'thas

gtsasdo: gzung 'dzin dri ma steḥ ma chen thugs klong mtha' bral chen por bshagasaX ḍasko ni sa ma ya shudhe āḥ de nas 'dzab dmigs ni rang nyid bdud 'dul drag moragasal ba'i thugs gar gser gyi mchod rten seng khri tshad med bum pa bre mgul chos 'khor gdugs tog dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa tshon gang ba tsam gsal ba'i bumalter pad nyi ro gdan la bdud 'dul dbang phyug rgyal mo ser gsal nas 'bru tsam gyi thugs gar nyi zla'i ga'u nyung 'bru kha sbyor ba tsam gyi sbubs suḥ rig pa'i ngo bothoḥmagring nag sbus bris pa tsam la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yon du 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyisaḥ 'phags pa mchodaḥ sems can gyi sgribs pa sbyangasaḥ slar 'od zer tshur 'dus pa'i sna labargyud gsum bla ma gcig rdzogs kyi ngo bo he ru ga'i rnam par byon nas bdag la dbang bskur zhing sgrib pa bcom te thugs yid ro gcig tu 'dris par bsam laḥ ba badz+ra sgo ti kā li sedha mu kha sirnyi pha la hūṃ smra bcad ting 'dzin ldan pa yis 'bru 'bum bzlos tshe nyams rtogs 'bar mkha' 'gros bu bzhin rjes su 'dzan dbar bskur lung bstan thob par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ sgrub 'dzab ni yang

rang gi thugs ga'i 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du spros pasaḥ sum bskor 'dod khyil rdul bral mun pa can na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro thams cad dgyes par bskulaḥ kun kyang bde stong chen po'i dgongs mnyam la zhugs 'khor 'das bde stong gnyis med gcig tu sbyor ba'i thugs dam la gnasaḥ gzhan yang zhing lnga dang 'brel ba'i rten dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad bde stong zag pa med pa'i 'dzab dgongs la snyoms par zhugs teḥ rlung sems nyi zla'i 'pho bsgod kyi rnam pa can thams cad dbu ma sgra gcan gyi dbyings su nub ste nang gsal ye shes chen po la longs spyod par dmigs laḥ snye tha badz+ra kro ti kā li sedha mu kha sarba sirnyi pha la skyed〈snaX hūṃ trī dgongs pa chos nyid don la gtadaḥ bde stong zag med 'dzab rgyun skyongs bzlas pa dbugasakyi rta la drangs 'bum phrag lnga ru tshad them pas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod mngon du 'gyur sa ma yā las spyor na yang ma chen mkha' 'gro'i srog sngags 'od zer gyis bskul te snod bcud brtan g.yos snang ba thams cad mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa'i gnasaḥ o rgyan he ru ga'i

badz+ra: dur khrod chen poX zhing dbang zhing skyong dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i grong khyeraḥ sgra skad ha rejesaḥdang / phaṭatha gyi brda glu sgrogs pa 'gyu 'phro bde stong zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi dgongs rgyud dag par shar teḥ pha rol pos rbod gtong bsam sbyor ngan pa sogs 'jigs pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi ba dang che dpal nyams rtogs ye shes kyi sgo rab tu 'phel zhing rgyasaḥ khams gsum srid gsum kyi dregs pa can rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor thams cad bdag nyid kyi mnga' dbang du bsdusaX nga bdag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo thams cad skye med kyi dgongs rgyas btab steḥ 'gag med bde chen rdo rjer spyor ba'i mngon spyod kyi shugs la drangs nas chos nyid 'khrul mi shes pa'i dbyings dza/ ar la gtad deḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥr tsaḥsha da raḥsaḥmā ra ya phaṭaḥ drag sngags nus 'bum rdzogs 'ad mkha' 'gro yongs kyi srog sngags yin sde brgyad 'dus pa' snying srog ste rbad chod bzlas na bka' chad 'bebs dgongs par gnas te shub bur bzla 'khor 'das yongs kyi dbang bskur 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥde nasarjesarim tshogs mchod ni sha chang tsha sgog sbod kya rigs dum gcig snod du bsags byas

te bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa ni / hrīḥbardal khyab ka dag yangs pa'i gzhong pa rtsa lhun grub 'dod lnga'i dga' ston tshogs chen bshamasaḥ dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa ram̐ yekhaṃ zhi lhag rig pa ye shes 'phrul du spro0 o badz+ra spra ra ṇa dzaX de nas spyon 'dren ni hūṃ hrīḥsamed rnam dag 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings lhun grub ye shes 'od lnga'i gsang mdzod nasaḥ lhan skyes bde chenabadud 'dul drag mo niḥ zhi mdzad dkar mo 'bum tshogs sprin ltar gtibasaḥ rgyas byed ser mo 'bum sde nyi ltar gsalaX dbang sdud dmar mo 'bum niglog ltar 'khyugasaḥ mngon spyod drag mo 'bum tshogs ljang nag rngamaX bya ba lhun gyis grub mdzad mthing gsal 'bumaḥ gzung 'dzin nyon mongasabadud 'dul seng geligadong skumadog nag mo khro gtum khros pa'i zhalaḥ rin chen rusapa'i rgyan cha khro lo loX gser sked rin chen dril chung si li li snyan pas brda glu sna tshogs 'u ru rtsa dar dpyangs cod pan sna tshogs da la laX las byed mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs nyi li liḥ 'du ba tshogs kyi dga' ston dpungs se dpungaḥ rnal 'byor mos gus gdung shugs lam se lamaX snyen rgyan te

gtsasdo: ru'i gnas mchog nyams re dga'aḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gdung bas 'bod lags naḥ ma thogs dam la dgongs bzhin gshegs su gsolaḥ dad mosadam tshig dag pa'i snang ngor bzhugasaḥ bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i phyir: rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i dga' ston bzhes su gsolaX ḍasko ni haḥreX ni sas pā ri war badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaX tshogs phud ni / hrīX rang las spros pa'i lha mo grangs med pas gser dngul rin chen gzhong par tshogs ston sabakramaḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bulaḥ nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas phyir bzhes su gsolaḥ 37 mahā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khāhiḥ bar bshags ni hoḥsku gsum rang la rdzogs pa'i zhal ma mjalaḥ 'khrul gzhi ma rig yin pa ngo ma shesaḥ tha snyad rjes 'brang chags nyams ci bsags paḥ snying nas bshags so ye shes tshogs kyis bskangs yin mahā ga ṇa tsakra sa ma ya bi shukhye ā bsgral las na hūṃ bh+yoḥ bdag 'dzin a 'thas nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i gdonaḥ ma rig log sbyor 'du shes phyin log rnamasaḥ sor rtogs rang mdangs ye shes mtshon chas bsgral

rnam shes skye med yum chen mkha' ru spar sarba rū tra pra we sha ya phaṭa bstab pa niḥ / hrī0 mtha' bral bde chen zhal gyi hom khung duḥ ma rtog gnyis 'dzin bsgral ba'i phung khams bstabs las nyon bag chags 'khrul ba ka dag steḥ grol gzhi'i klong du ldog med sangs rgyas shog sarba du tra mā ra ya me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khāhiḥlhag ma niḥ bh+yoX rdo rje khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ga'iX spyan sngar khas blangs dam mnos tha tshig canaḥ dbang phyug ma sring ging lang 'bar ma rnams 'du ba tshogs kyi lhag la da tshur byonaḥ dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong lhag ma'i zhal chab len rnal 'byor grogs byed sgrub pa'i sgo skyong zhes0 khas blangs bzhin du pham 'bab 'di bzhes la zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs rlung sems bde stong bskyed pa'i grogs mdzod cigaḥ o ma ma hrīng uṣ+ṭi ṭa ba lirnya khāhi ga tho niḥ / smyo thog mtha' bar gyi bkra shis dus tshigs laḥ dbang chen rgyal po khrag 'thung he ru gaXrdo rje thod phreng grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyadaX rnal 'byor dbang phyug skyes chen thams cad kyiX spyan sngar khas blangs dam tshig gnyer thob pa'i pho rgyud mgon po

khrod lha mo bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin ma gnod sbyin shan dmar btsan rgod yang le ber dregs pa bco brgyad sde dpon sum cu sogasaḥ rang rang g.yog 'khor rta bcasaḥ ma thogs dam tshig bzhin du da tshur byonaXdapa' brngan gtor ma ri ltar spungs ba dngaX ja chang 'o phud khrag skyems mtsho ltar bskyilaX sha khrag rus parte ltar gtibasaḥro mtshar dga' ston rang rang yid mthun rdzasaḥ dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul lo bzhes su gsol grin las rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen srungasaḥbasring thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhingaḥ bshad sgrub rab rgyas skye rgu'i phan bde spelaḥ bskal pa rdzogs ldan ltar bskyed bde legs spelaX nad mug 'khrug rtsodazhingaX a ti 'bras bu chos kyi nying khu yisaX mtha' dbus kun khyab lta sgom spyod mthar byin ༷ sgyu lus lhag med dwangs ma'i sku grub nas rig 'dzin brgyud pa

mdzod gnyer bcom phrin las ma g.yel sa ma yāḥbartan ma naḥ bh+yoḥ tshogs bdag bka' yi gnyer 'dzin dam tshig can bod skyong brtan ma ya ma'i tshogs rnams kun lhab lhub rgyan dang dril g.yer sgra sgrogs bzhinaḥ rlung las mgyogs pa'i bang rtsal rlabs po chesaḥ rgya bal bod yul kun nas da tshur byonaḥ dbu 'phang dma' bzhin gus 'dud thal mo bcas dam rdzas bshal chu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog nyams rtogs yon tan spelaḥ gangs ljongs bod khams chos kyis skyongs ba dngaX bshad sgrub gtsug lag dge 'dun 'dus sde spel 'jigs rten bde legs dpal yon rgya mtsho yisaḥ yongs su 'tsho ba'i phrin las kun sgrubs shig ma ma sabo hrīng trīng dza ba lirnya khā hiḥ kro minan niḥ / trīḥ stong gsum rnam dag yum gyi mkha' dbyings suḥ ma rig gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi'i mtshan 'dzin brub ldang med sku dang ye shes chos skur rgyaḥ gang shar rang grol na gongs pa mngon gyur shogaḥ ma aḥhūṃ swā hā stam bha ya nan nanaḥ bzod gsol ni hoX rtag chad mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'byul ba yisaḥ blang dor rmongs shing sor byang sngags sdom

btsasdo: nyamasaX a 'thas blo yi dri ma phra rag kunaX rig pa 'od gsal dbyings su phyag bgyi'oXs ma ya āḥbasngo smon niXhoḥrnam dkar dgedangos ma lus gcigabasdus teX 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo bar bgyiḥde mthus gzung 'dzin srid pa'i rgya grol nasaḥnang dbyings bum pa'i sku ru byang chub 3snag:rtag chad mtha' bsal ni ā spro bsdus dkyil 'a dar ye shes sgyu 'phrul lha ༷mi gnas mi dmigs dbu ma chen poratswa:slar yang thugs rjes gdul bya'i dpal skyong phyir stong gsal sgyu ma'i sku yis spyodalam khyeraḥ.a āḥphaṭa phaṭaX shis brjod ni na moḥchos nyid nam mkha' dpe med brjod las 'dasaXde don rtogs pa kun tu bzang mo'i klongaḥyum chen mngon gyur bkra shisagang lags pa deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la smin gyur cigaḥrang bzhin 'od gsal grwa zur dngos mtshan bralaḥdon te mngon gyur rdo rje phag mo'i zhalaḥbade stong gsang mdzod mngon gyur bkra shis gang deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la smin gyur cigaḥthugs rjes gzung 'dzin blo yi dri ma bralaḥso so ra rig khros ma nag mo'i ngang ma cig

gzigs pa mngon gyur gang lags pa deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la smin gyur cig gzhan snang zil gnonartogs pa rlabs po che bdud 'dul drag mo gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs zhalaḥ gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod bkra shis gang lags pa deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la smin gyur cigaḥ mkha' ltar dag pa'i lta ba yas nas 'bebs 'ja' ltar bkra ba'i spyod pa mas nas 'jegasaX nyi ltar gsal ba'i sgom pa shugs la thon 'bras bu mkha' spyod mngon gyur bkra shis shogaḥ thog mar dge ba sems bskyed rlabs po cheX bar du phun tshogs dmigs med zang thal ngang tha ma 'khor gsum yongs dag rgyas 'debs la skye rgu rtag tu gnas pa'i bkra shis shog de ltar lta ba'i gdengs ldan pas 'od gsal 'phags ma'i gsang lam spyod ye shes sgyu 'phrul spro bsdu 'gyed rig pa sku gsum lam 'bras smin ma chen thugs kyi sras su 'gyur sam shā rgya rgya rgya ye ma ma chen gsang srasanam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi thugs gter grogasapo ma ku muta rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun bzang nye rukaḥ yon tan mthu thob 'gyur med rgya mtshodapal chags bral pad+ma dga' ba'irdo rje dang dharma kirnyi rkarma girtidang pad+ma kirti pho gakerta sogs gdung bzhi phran brgyadasbas pa'i rnal

la sa: 'byor lnga shes rab bas srog smon larma dbang gis 'dzomaḥbaka' 'di sha za gsum gyis brdas bskul tshe dbang mdzod sgrom rgya las bshus shog skyar pheb don gnyis grub pa'i ga sa ma yāḥrgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thamaḥlja zhesalung zen saman+ta bha dra' mtshan can gyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang /phren las mthar phyan rdo rje ran chen gnyis pa'i skyes bcas bskul ba da /gre'adun bzang po'i sgo nas ba nga yas bskul ro ra/kho bo klong chen nam mkha' rnal 'byor gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod gsal bar byed pa 'iyi ge pa na chos nyid rang grol gyi bgyas pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masko le/

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥbadud 'dul khrag 'thung nag mo'i 〉ཿsgrub dug gri ngar ma bzhugs soḥl mi na mo to na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ 11ཿbadza'i snye med chos sku' gsang mdzod las 'gag med gzigs pa'i phrin las can ye shes chags thog bral ba yis bdud 'dul drag mo la phyag 'tshal pad+ma'i brgyud 'jin las can rnams tshe 'di blos dor 'chi chos sgrub chos brgyad bya ba dag las dben ya dag snying po' nyis khu spyod rtsa gsum rgya mtsho gtsug tu bkuraḥchos skyong srung ma grogs su gsol bshad sgrub gzhi bzu bstan paskyongs sems can phan bde brtson pa la nag po bdud kyas bar chad 'byu smon log dam sris sgol ba 'tshubs mkhon 'dzi slo zhing ar jag ston phra ma sna tshogs dab med g.yo dug lnga lus kya rtog pa slo ཿbya ba ya rabasabazang dgu bul log pa 'i spyod ngan rtsol med 'grub de tsha lha sru 'khru zhi ldog dkar po'i phyogs rnams dbyings su yal nag phyogs sdig pa 'i tshang khang 'khrugs chos mdzad sku tsha dam la gajod bstan pa nyams dma' byed para'agyur de tshe man ngag thams cad kyi rgyal po /sgrub dam pa'oḥsnyigs dus skyobs pa'i lha lnga yi nang nasam chen bdud 'dul maḥbyad bzlog phyag ga 'khor lo can bdud 'dul lcags kyi mche ba ngoms dgra gsod gra gug phyar

ba mo gdon 'dul rdo rje'i go cha can sri tshogs tshar gcod g.yu ral sprugasaḥ 'khor ba dbying sbyor khrag chen 'thung rgyal ba thamasacad bskyed pa'i yumoḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso rig sngags zhang skyes ḍak+ki 'dudaḥ bde sbyinardo rje khrag 'thung maḥ khro mo dbang phyug mthu ldan dpal bsgrub pas grub 'bras rtsol sla zhing snying nye dam srung nyams rtogs bskyed phu po gnas yul he ru dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde chen bskyed a rgyan mkha' spyod gsang lam 'byed 'di ya yon tan bsam mtha' yas ma chen khros ma la phyag 'tshalaḥ sa ma māḥ sngon che rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul mdo sngags bstan pa rgyas pa'i tsheḥ mu stegs phra men tshogs 'dus nas chos la rgol zhing bsnub par brtsams de tshe khrag 'thung nag po yis rdo rje brag nag 'bar ba nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod lcags sgom byung tshogs dang gtor ma rgyas par mdzad sgrom rgya bkrol tehūṃ sgrub 'di bsnyen sgrub zhag bdun tho rang khar mkha' 'gro'idangos su zhal gzags te g.yu ral sprugs pas me yis zer reg pas mod la nags klong bsregs der brten phra men mang po brlag yang cig thod pas khrag dbab ste gtso bo che dgu myos 'bog brgyal grags pa'i yon tan mtha' dbus khyab mu stegs gzhan rnams bros shing 'khumaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa nyi ltar gsal phan bde'i 'byung gnasabadud 'dul ma'i hūṃ sgrub dug gringar ma 'ad slob dpon khrag 'thung nag pos mdzad rgya gar yul du skor

—rten: gcig sbas rgya nag yul du de ltar la bod kyi khyu rdzo brag gi mgul 'dod rgyal bla mtsho dmar po rtsa bka' rtags rdo rje phyag rgyas btabaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ sngon byon khung btsun rim pa'oḥ de nasanyams su len pa la ma dag las kya rlung dug bsal dag pa ye shes dwang bcud len bde stong 'bar ba'i 'khrul 'khor bslab gzung 'dzin rdul spran mkha' la gtor zang thal rag pa thad gar skyong de'i nga nas 'ad ltaragasalaḥ sa ma yāḥ rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo gnam lcags kyi rdo rje gru gang baḥ lte ba 'bur zhing pad 'dab rgyas paḥ lcags kyi rwa rnams shin tu gnyer zhing kha sdig pa'i zhal ltaragadengs ba'i nang nas ye shes kyi me tsha ngar dang ldan pa tho ro ro 'phros pas rgyal bsen dam sri 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad par byed paḥ mas kyi rwa rnams gdengs pa las dug rlung 'tshubs ma phyu ru rnga 5grang nas sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad 'dar yed yed byed paX lte ba nas rdo rje thog ser pheb pas log sbyor 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog paḥ de lta bu'i nang khongs su pad nyi ro gdan la rang nyid khro mo bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma nag mo mun pa'i gos canaX zhal seng ge'i gdong ba can shin tu 'jigs

pa'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pa0 spyan gsum nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'bar ba'i ma rag mun khams thams cad dbyings su sang bar byed paḥ shangs nas rdo rje'i rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i byad kha rbod gtong thams cad gtor bar byed pa lcags kyi ral pa bsigs pa las yang sprul mkha' 'gro bye ba sa ya 'byed paḥ thod rgyan rdo rje'i byas pa'i 'od zer gyis mi dang mi ma yin pa lha srin dregs pa can thams cad dbang du sdud cing dam la 'dogs paḥ phyag g.yas gri gug phyar bas snang ba thogs bcas su 'khrul ba'i 'byung po thams cad dum bur gtubs pa g.yon pa bhan khrag gsol ba'i chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i gdon tshogs mnyam pa nyid du rol baX zhal nas seng skad kyi nga ro sgrogs pas khams gsum gsal ba'i 'jigs rten gyi dpa' brjed dang mthu nus kyi dpa' skongs shing sma phab ste zil gyis gnon par byed pa mchan khong g.yon du yab he ru ga'i ngo bo kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum brten pas dug gsum ar la gtad cing sku gsum lhun grub kyi dgongs nyams la bsre bar mdzad pa zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur mdzad bas gzungs 'dzin gyi mtshan ma sna

gtsasdo: tshogs thad gar gcod paḥ rus rgyan dar dpyangs rdo rje ska rags kyi mdzes par byas pas 'khrul ba ma rig pa'i 'khor lo thams cad 'khrul med ye shes kyidabyings su sang bar mdzad paḥ tshogs yul gyi mtshan 'dzin ka nas dag phyir dur khrod dpal chas kyis shin tu mdzes par spras pa che btsan 'gran zla dang bral baX ye shes kyime rlung 'byubs ma'i dbus su snang stong sgyu 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor du bskyed doḥ de yi sku dbyings chos nyid stong pa'i rtsa chen shar ba las spyi bo'i 'khor lo nasangs rgyas phag mo la 'khor mthing nag 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas paḥ ro rnams 'dus pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo napad+ma phag mo dmar mo 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas paḥ yi ge 'dus pa chos kyi'akhor lo na rdo rje phag mo dkar mo 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa ༷ bde ba bskyed byed sprul pa'i 'khor lo na rat+na phag mo ser mo 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas paX shin tu bskyodabyed g.yo ba'i 'khor lo na darma phag mo lngang nag 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas paḥ ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par bskyed doX gzhan yang gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i ma mo dang

mkha' 'gro rten dang brten pa'i tshul du rdzogs par gsal gdab poḥ de nas rang githugs galisrog nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi bar du yi ge(ཿmthing nag spus bris pa ltar gsal b.las ( lu gu rgyud du byung teḥ rtsa 'khor thams cad na bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro rigs lnga yang sprul sa ya 'bum sde dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ kun kyang chos nyid mnyamapa chen po'i bro gar bsgyuraḥ 'gag med bde ba chen pos/ glu gyeraḥ ma rig gzhi la sangs ba'i mkhyen brtse'i gzigs pa ngoms shing gang 'dul bde stong gi mdzad pa rab tu'abar bar dmigs slar yang de dag las spros pa'i /༷ grangs med pa spyi gtsug nas yar byungaX skra gseb na bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro bye ba sa ya 'bum sde'i thugs rgyudabaskulaḥ kun kyang sku yis khro nyams dgra gdon la ston cing gsung/ ༷glu rnal 'byor la brtse bar sgrogs paX thugs snying rje gzhan don du g.yo te 'khor ba dong nas sprugs parabasam ༷ yang (ཿgi tshogs zhal dang shangs khung spran mig rnams las byung ba dang smra yi cha shas kun nasahūṃḥgi tshogs tho ro ro sbos te phyi stsod 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad

btsasdo: yongs su khyab paḥ des gzi byin gyi snod thams cad mkha' spyod bde chen gyi zhing dang bcud thams cad bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma'i gsang ba gsum du dag smin rdzogs te hūṃ chos nyid kyi glu dbyangs sgrogs pas phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad shig shig tu g.yo bar byed paḥ sde brgyad dregs pa dug gsum 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad 'dar yed yed du dngangs shing brgyal nas bka' nyan las sgrub 'bangs byed zhes shin tu phra ba'i skad kyis khas blang bar bsamaX hū hūṃ hūḥ hūṃ hū hūṃX hūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥhūṃḥ slar hūṃ thams cad lu gu rgyud du bsdus te bdag nyid kyi rig pa'i ngo bo hūṃḥl gcig tu dril bas 'khor 'das kyi spyi dpal bdud 'dul zil gnon khrag 'thung chen mor shes par bya'oḥ gzhom med lta ba'i yang rtse nas chos nyid stong pa'i glu dbya sa sgogs mtshan ma tshig dang tha snyad chos gang gis mi brdzu rnam rgyal gyis ma chen gsang spyod nges par mthongaḥ sa ma yā dngos gzhi hūṃ sgrub kyi nye lam zab mo'o rgya rgya rgyaḥ de nas las la sbyor ba ni sri'u gso che stsasgrub gong ltar la sgo bsdus(5)sa lus kyi phya nang gtams bsru byas lus sems 'byur med stsadu dmags bzlas pa 'bum gyis rkyen snang

kun las rgyalaḥ sa ma yuḥ ser ba bsrung na bskyed rim go ltar la 4las hūṃ dmar me yi tshogs 'dra spros sprin rnams khyab pas ser ba ser byed kun sor rtogs ye shes chen por bsregs par dmigs sngags bzlas sdigs mdzub phyag rgya gzer bas bzlogaḥ sa ma yāḥ nad yams bsrung na hūṃḥ sgrub go ltar la srog snying yi ge me rlung dug zer bcas rab tu spros pas nad yams gdon bgegs rnams bsregs bcom gtor la stong pa nyid du dmags 'dre 'dul ming can sbos sngags dud pa bdug bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i nus mthu yon tan thob sa ma pā dreg pa'i cho 'phrul rgol ba bzlog 'dod na bdud 'dul drag mo'i snosgrub gong ltar laḥ snying po spro pa'i lcags kyus dregs pa bkugs gnad la dbab cing las la gcun bcas te shan tu rang zhing srog snying mngon phul bsam drag po' ngar skad rdo rje'i /mu1 len mtshan ma'i snang ba mtshan med dbyings su gcod sa ma yuḥ yang gcig 'phral rkyen god kha rgyun gcod na /ཿsgrub gong ltar srog snying gru gang ba me rlung ngar ldan dri na dpag yas 'phro de 'dra grangs med spros pas bsrung bya yi sna bug nas zhugs lus ngag yid dang 'dres nad gdon rkyen ngan sbur ma me 'phrad bzhinaḥ mi gnas stong pa nyid kyi 'khor lor brdal bgegs gzhom dzos bdug thun gshar brab pa sa thub sa ma yāḥ de nas 'jigs tshogs zha bar byed 'dod na drag mo' bskyed bzlas gong ltar sa ga ni dkar po'i tshogasas stong gsum

la ba sdo: 'jig rten gyis nad gdon sdag sgrib bag chags las nyon dang 'gro drug 'khrul snang sdug bsngal ma lus pa zhi ba' phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub ba ra dmigs ཿ glu bya zhi rig pa thad gar skyongasaḥsam yā de nas tshe da bsod nams rgyas pa'i phyar lhar snang gong ltar srog gi yi ge ni gser mdog lta bu grangs med spro bsdus yas snod bcud brtan g.yo dpal yon dwa bcud spel legs tshogs rgyas shang nyams rtog yon tana'aphel chos 'khor bstan gzhi bshad sgrub bskyed pa ra dmigasaḥ/ glu gyer zhing rig sto rjen pa ra skyongasaḥs ma yuḥde nas mos bzhi dbang du 'du ba'i phyir bskyed rim gong ltar srog gi yi ge ni rwa ga'i mdog 'bar de las/ grangs med spros pa sa khams gsum srid gsum dregs pa dang lha klu ma yi dpal 'byer nor sna bcas rang dbang med par bsgrub mchog dpal 'byor te snang grags rig gsum sgyu ma' lha ru bzhengs khams gsum dbang bsdudasrid gsum dam 'dogs shing chags bral bde stong rtogs pa mngon gyur dmigs tu glu gyer zhing rig sto rjen par skyongasaḥs ma yuḥde nas drag po mngon spyod grub pa'i phyir ma bskyed gong ltar sgog gi yi ge ni yirnya'i mdog 'bar grangs med spro bsdus yis dgra bgegs dam sri byad ma zod gto kunaḥtshar bcad rdul rlog bran du bkol ba dang 'jags pa'i g.yul rgyal rdo rje pha lam du gsang gsum de nyid rtogs pa mngon gyur dmigs snoglu bcad

thon brjod bzhin rig ngar bskyed sa ma yu de nas byad phur zod gtong bzlog 'dod na gnam lcag tsakra :bas stong mtshon ngar can g.yas su 'khor bas byad ma rbod gtong mkhan kun gyi sha khrag chal chal gtor bar byed pho nya lce spyang tshogs kyis rol bar dmigs de'i lte bar / sgrub gong ltar la gan lnga la spros(ཿyig kha dog lngas byad gtad 'byung ba lnga ru bcing ba rnams mi gnas ye shes lnga ru sbyang bsregs bsgyur stong nyad dmigs sbyor rig pa'i mthu yis dkrugs byad gtad thamasacad rang sar grol bar dmigs rtse glu gyer zhing dmags med ngang la bzhagaḥ sa ma wāḥ gzhan yang las bzha gong ga rigs gtogs pas gdul bya'i yul la 'dul byed / sgrub gzeraḥgrub 'bras rtags 'byung yon tan bsam yas 'byor bdud 'dul man ngag zab tig nag po'oḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya sa ma slo gam dbang sgogazhal yas nas dga' bde' char 'bebs glang po'i gdong phrin las dpal bskyed sha za gsumaḥ gang zhig mos pa'i dam tshig gis yang yang brda dang thabs kyisabaskul de tshe sngon smon dag pa yis ga ga ma'i gtad rgya tha ler sad mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod hrig ger mthong rten 'brel che phyir shog skyar phebaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda zimaḥdziḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ta dang samarnya bha dra badz+ra ming can gsum gyis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang nye char11gas sa kyang bskul ngor/kho po bdud bsdomasanam mkha'i
sa /snye: rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gas ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni chosanyid rang grol gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

'am/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasabadud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'iḥbasrung bzlog bsad pa'i tsakra man ngag nus pa 'bum rdzogs bzhugs soḥ—8sde: na mo tswa na ḍak+ki ni ya thos ga dam ldan sgrub mchog mos gus can mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam la zhugs tshe man ngag snying dang srog lta bu bsrung bzlog bsad dmags 'ad la brtsonaḥs ma yāḥdang po bsrung ba' tsakra na stong pa'i ngang las rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa yar gyi rwa lnga la gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin paḥyang dag he ru gaḥ'ajam dpal nā ga rak+kaḥdabang chen rta mchog rgyal po khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyal ba rnams sku mdog mthing nag khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'byud cing phyag thams cad hū mdzad kyi rgyas gdug pa 'i tshogs thams cad dam la 'dog ci ar la gtad par gyur kun gyi sku la dur khrod dpal chas kyis brgyan cing ye shes kyi me ri dang dug rlung khol zhing 'tshubs par bsted doḥms kyi rwa rnams la dbang spug nag po lcags kyi ral ba can dngaḥdrang srong nag po me yi 'khor lo can dang las ga na nag po rlang gi rkang ba

can dngaḥ sha za nag mo sbu gri rnon po'i lce can dngaḥ ngan ngag phyir bzlog nag mo rdo rje'i lus can rnams gcer bu mi srun 'jigs pa'i cha lug can g.yas na phyir bzlog gi 'khor lo dang g.yon pas khrag zor thogs pa pha rol po'i byas pa'i byad phur mnan gtad hom zor gyi rigs thams cad me yis bsregs shing rlung gis gtor la 'khor lo dang spu gri rnon pos tshar gcod pa'i las la drag tu rngam par bskyed doḥ rdo rje'i lte bar khong seng gi dbus su chos 'byung dmar nag e yi klong du chags bral pad nyi dang rtog med ro yi gdan la bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong ba can sku mdog mthing nag me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gsal ba de yi seng zhal g.yas su gzigs pas dregs tshogs dbang du bsdud cing nga ro nam mkha'i mthong su sgrogs pas sde brgyad 'byung bo dbang du sdud cing ar la gtad pa phyag mtshan gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin cing dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes par spras pa yab he ru ka mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan khung g.yon du brten paḥ gser gyi ske rags la dngul dkar dang g.yu yi dril chung mdzes par brgyan paḥ rus pa'i rgyan

btsasdo: drug dang dar sna'i cod pan 'phur zhing bskyod paḥ 'ja' 'od thig le me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong du bskyed doḥ de yi thugs dkar gser gyi tsakra bcu bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor ba'i dbus su rig pa'i ngo bo hū mthing nag gi zig ler bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par gsal gdabaḥ zla tshes kyi ga'ur yi dam rtsi'i gang che dang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar bskyedaḥ ha khog gi nang du g.yas su bsrung bya pho rigasaḥ g.yon du mo rigs mdun du bu slob rgyab du 'khor g.yog mnga' ris nor gsum gsal bar bskyed tsakra'i rtsibs rnams la drag po'i yi ge bcu bzhi pa me yi tshwa tshwa dang ldan par gsal gdabaḥ de yi rgyab 'od skor gyi nang duḥ skyid e ka ya ma du ru tsakra srungasaX he ka ya ma du ru tsakra srungs ༷ skṛ ma ya ma du ru tsakra srung shig rak+ta rak+ṣaḥ de rgyab me klong 'tshubs ma'i dbusaḥ sabo cit+ta gzer thum bisnanaX trig nan rbad yaḥ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig ma ma rak+ta rak+ta ku ru ye swāhāX bsrung bya'i rigs rnams thams cad la 'od zer rdo rje go cha'i gur spros la rang gi thugs

gar bsduḥ snyen (skon ro/ga hūṃ phaṭa tsit+ta rak+taḥ ci 'grub brjod la dmags med ngang mnyam par bzhag pas don gnyis 'grub bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'i bsrung ba'i cho ga thugs la bstim tsat+ta man+d+ra la gurgya rgya gnyis pa bzlog pa' tsakra ni stong pa'i ngang las rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo hūṃ mthing nag gsal ba las 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma mo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul gzi byin dbang dang dngos grub bsdus te bstim ( yongs su gyur ba las gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsrung bzlog gi lha dang bcas pa ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa gsal gdabaX de yi phyi la gser gyi tsakra rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i rtsibs rtse rnams la phyir bzlog ngan sngags kyi rgyal mo g.yas bzlog pa'i tsakra dang g.yon brdung byed kyi tho ba 'dzin pa gcer mo mi sdug srin mo khros 'dra re gsal gdabaḥ rdo rje'i lte bar chos 'byung dmar nag gi dbus su rang nyid bdud 'dul drag mo mun pa'i gos can gri thod 'dzin pa rus pa'i rgyan can ye shes kyi me rlang 'tshubs ma'i dbus su gsal bar bste do de yi thugs gar gser gyi tsakra rtsibs bcu

bsko/: bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor ba'i dbus su rig pa'i ngo bo hū mazing nag gi thig ler bla ma rdo rje 'chang dngaḥ zla tshes kyi ga'ur rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dngaḥ ha khog gi nang du g.yas su bsrung bya pho rigasaḥ g.yon du mo rig mdun du bu slob rgyab tu 'khor g.yog mnga' ri'i longs spyod dang bcas pa gsal gdabaḥtsakra'i rtsibs bcu bzhi la drag po'i yi ge 'bru bcu bzhi gsal ba las 'od dang 'od zer me yi tshwa tshwa 'asgo bar gsalaḥ de rgyab 'od skor gyi nang duḥtshigatshigatshos65ཿraX tsa mnadaḥratsha gaX mā ra ya phuṭaḥ ma ma tsit+ta hūṃ sbyoX de rgyab me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bzlog pa'i yi ge zhal phyir kyu ba'i tshul duḥ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra hūṃ sneX de rgyab me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su bzlog pa'i yi ge zhal phyir kyu ba'i tshul duḥ e ka ya ma du ru tsakra bzlog he ka ya ma du ru tsakra bzlog spri ma ya ma du ru tsakra bzlog sarba tsit+ta gzer thum bisnanaḥtrig nan rbad yaḥ bzlog yaḥ byad ma'i sha rgyud snying la mā ra ya bzlog dbugs rgyud sgog la mā ra ya bzlogaḥ khrag rgyud rtsa la mā ra ya bzlog mi dang mi

ma yin pa'i byad kha phur kha hom zor mnan gtad thams cad mā ra ya bh+yoX mā ra ya bzlogaḥ e ka bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ de ltar sngags bzlas pa'i tsheḥ gser gyi tsakra g.yas su rga ra ra 'khor zhing 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phros pas byad ma 'khor bcas rdul du brlag par bsam: bzlog byed ngan sngags kyi rgyal mo grangs med pas pha rol pos brtsam pa'i ngan sngags dmod byad thams cad tshar bcad par dmigs yang bdud 'dul drag mo'i mig g.yas nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis byad phur thams cad bsregs pa dngaX mig g.yon zla ba'i 'od zer gyis byad gtad thams cad bkru zhing sbyangs ba dang sku las spros pa'i rdo rje'i rlung gis byad gtad thams cad gtor bar bsam laḥ ma pa ra na mi khyu bzlog ci 'thub brjod la dmigs med ngang mnyam par bzhams pas byad gtad sogs mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog par 'gyuraḥ sa ma mā mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i yang bcud skor man ngag tsit+ta'i sgrom rgyar chug maṇ+ḍal gurgya rgya gsum pa bsad pa'i tsakra ni stong pa'i ngang las rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo hūṃ mthing nag gsal ba las 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phros0 phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa gsum dam can

de'adi: thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bulaX byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus te bstim ༷hūṃ yongs su gyur ba las gnam lcags kyi tsakrartsibs stong dang ldan pa ral gri'i so ltar rno ba g.yas su rga ra ra 'khor ba las mi mthun nyes byed pho mo'i sha khrag rus gsum dmar nyil nyil du bcad gtub gtor gsum rtag tu byed bar gyuraḥde yi dbus su me rlu thog zer 'phro bas nang du khro rgyal ya ma ra tsa ser nag g.yas spu gri 'dzin pas dgra bgegs kyi sgog rtsa khrag rtsa snying rtsa thams cad dum bur gcod paḥgayon me rlung gi zhags pas dgra bgegs kyi dbang po'i sgo rnams sdom par byed paḥsku la dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes shing zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor stabs su bsgrad pa me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su gsal bar bskyed doḥdeyi thugs gar chos 'byung dmar nag gi klong du pad nyi ro yi gdan labadud 'dul drag mo mun pa'i gos can gri thod 'dzin par gsal ba'i thugs gar gser gyi tsakra rtsibs bcu bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor ba'i nang du thugs srogahāḥmathing nag gi thig ler bla ma rdo rje

'chang chen poḥ zla tshes kyi ga'ur rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs ha khog gi nang du g.yas su bsrung bya pho rigasaX g.yon du mo rigasaḥ mdun du bu slobaX rgyab tu 'khor g.yog mnga' ri'i nor longs spyod dang bcas pa rnams gsal gdab 'a chung nang du chos skyong dam can zhabs kyu ru dregs pa sde brgyad kyi srog yig rnam pa 'od zer gyi drwa bas gcun cing gnas par gsal gdabaḥ gser 'khor gyi :bas rnams la drag po'i yi ge 'bru bcu bzhi 'od zer me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bzhin du gnas par bsam de rgyab me rlung mtshon thun 'khrugs pa'i dbus suX o ye ka ya ma du ru tsakra sod he ka ya ma du ru tsakra sodaḥ : ma ya ma du ru tsakra sodaḥ sarba tsit+ta gzer thumaḥ bisnan ༷trig nan rbad nan bzlog yaḥbyad ma'i sha rgyud snying la mā ra ya sod dbugs rgyud srog la mā ra ya sodaḥ rtsa rgyud khrag la mā ra ya sodaḥ dgra bgegs mi dang mi yin pa'i snying tshal ba tshal bar gtubs srog dum bu dum bur chodaḥ sha rus khrag shag pa shag par phyesaX mā ra ya pāṭa mā ra ya sod kha ṭ+wāṃ tsakra dz+wa la ru pa hūṃ phaṭaḥ deltar sngags bzlas pa'i tshe 'bar ba'i mtshon cha rab tu

gtsasdo: 'khrugs shing drag po yab yum gyi sku las dug thun tsakra'i rno ngar drag tu g.yos te dgra bgegs 'byung po'i lus ngag yid gsum dmyal dmyal du brdung shing tshal ba dum bur bcad nas rdul du brlag par bsam la oṃ tsakra su ru su ru ཿtri.a mu ga'i me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ko ro tsa na king ri ni ti mā ra ya tsakra thun bh+yoḥ rbad sod nan pāṭaḥ de ltar drag po'i sngags bzlas pa saḥ dgra bgegs thams cad rdul brlag bsam rnams shes skye med dbyang sa su bsreḥ mngon spyod las la dga' brod lajug don rnam thams cad yid bzhin 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yuḥ mkha' 'gro' thugs bcud man ngag 'di rag pa 'dzan pa'i tsat+tar bstemaḥ maṇ+ḍal gurgya rgyaḥyem dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi gnas pad+ma rak+ta bde chen klo de dang nye ba'i gnas mchog nas dus su mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe dbang chen dgyesapa'i rdo rje yas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gdan drangs nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde gsal bar byasaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brdo thamaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen dharma ku mu tas bskul ngor kho bo bdud mjomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'i yi ge pa nimakhyesnya dra bgyisapa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masko lam̐/

bsko/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX ma chen bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'iX mdun bskyed rab gsal me long bzhugs soX —6sno na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki na ya 'osko911)sgro ཿ 'bar ba'i sku mchog bde ba'i gzi byan can 'bum phrag gtso mo bdud 'dul ma la 'dud de yi zhi sgrub mdun bskyed sgom pa na tang 'dzin gsal snangalngan pa sa 'di skad do gdod nas chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ka dag spros mtha' dang bral ba'i ngang la gnas par bya'o lhun grub snying rje chen po'i rang 'od kun tu gsal zhingayongs su khyab cing brdal bar byaX de'i ngang las thabs shes kyi rtsal mdangs rig pa hūṃ mthing nag me yi tshwa tshwa spro ba gcig tu gyuraḥ de lasatsosaḥspros pas stong chen nam mkha'amatha' dbus bral ba laX yo spros pas brten byed rlung gi dkyil 'khor 'pho med du gnas pa laḥ raXspros pas rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs kun tu 'khyil baḥ sum spros pa las zhingachen gyi sa gzhi rgya che la khyon yangs par kenispros pas rus pa'i ri rab zur brgyad sra brtan lci zhing 'thas pa'i kharaḥ rab 'jigs dur khrod chen po brgyad kya bkod pa yongs su

rdzogs pa'i dbus suḥ hūṃḥlas thod pa'i sku mkhar rngam brjid 'bar ba chen po tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su tshang baḥ ye shes kyi me dang dbang gi 'od khyim rab tu g.yo ba'i nang duḥchos 'byung dmar nag pad nyi ro gdan gyi khar rig pa hū mthing nag khra thabs su bab pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byasaḥm mo dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi dbang byin dngos grub thams cad bsdus te bstim stsayongs su gyur pa las mdun bskyed bdud 'dul drag po seng ge'i gdong ba can sku mdog mthing nag mun pa'i mdog lta buX zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa g.yu ral nam mkha'i dbyings su gzengs shing seng chung bu yug ltar 'tshubs paḥthod rgyan rdo rje rtse lnga las byas shing dar sna lnga yi cod pan 'phur ba seng zhal g.yas su gzigs shing nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs pas pho rgyud dbang du sdud paḥ seng zhal g.yon du gzigs shing mkha' 'gros brda gla sgrogs pas mo rgyud dbang du sdud pa seng zhal thad du gzigs shing chos nyid stong pa'i gru dbyangs sgrogs pas dregs pa can thams cad dbang du stud pa smin ma

—8mi: las me yi tshwa tshwa 'phros pas 'byung po gzhob kyis bsregs paX phyag g.yas pas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar bas khams gsum dbang du sdud pa nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i skye rgyud gcod pa g.yon thod khrag thugs gar brten pas srid gsum gyi bcud la rol zhing bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyis rgyas 'debs par byed pa zhabs gnyis gar stabs su bsgyur bas srid pa'i sa rnams zil gyis gnon cing ye shes sa rnams 'byed par byed pa ༷ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pas khams gsum dbang du sdud cing pha rol phyin drug gi chos char 'bebs paḥ dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes par spras pas tshogs yul mtshan 'dzin gyi du tra thams cad ka nas dag par byed paḥ bya ba mthar phyin pa'i rtags su dar ljang gu'i dpyangs pa 'phur baX dgos 'dod longs spyod kyi char chen po 'bebs pa'i rtags su rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par spras paḥgazung 'dzin rab bsregs kyi me 'bar zhing bskal ba'i dug rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus su snang stong zung 'jug rol ba'i dal du bskyed doḥ de yi mchan khung g.yon du yab he ru ka

sbas tshul kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum brten pa thod pa ra ri sum brtsegs bskyon zhing rdo rje rgya gram gyis mdzes par brten paX byang chub sems mtshon chu shing nag po'i yu ba la ye shes lngamatshon dar sna tshogs pas mdzes shing thabs kyi rang bzhin ḍā ma ru dang shes rab mtshon pa'i dril bu g.yer kha rin chen sna tshogs ba'i mdzes par brgyan pa'oḥ spyi bor rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal he ru ga'i cha byad can g.yas ḍā ma ru g.yon bhan dmar 'dzin paḥ yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma pad phreng 'dzin pa dang 'khril sbyor mdzad pas mkha' gsang nas byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs pas sgrub pa po la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol bar dmigasaḥ bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i thugs gar nyi zla'i dal sran ma phyed bkas tsam gyi steng du 'od lnga'i thig le bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa'i khongs seng du rig pa /baḥmathing nag la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yon du 'khrigs se bskor bar dmigs sngags las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi che btsan can thams cad dbang du sdud cing dgra bgegs 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad dpal yon dwangs ma

btsasdo: thams cad dbang du sdud cing sgrub pa po yi dpal du stsol bar dmigasaḥ de yi phyi rol du gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi yul sum cu rtsa gnyis dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad he ru ka yi gnas bcu na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad ma 'dres yongs su gsal gdab gzhan yang mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod sprin stobs pa dngaḥ lha chen po brgyad kyis rdo rje gsang ba'i las byed cing klu chen po brgyad kyis dgos 'dod bsam yas su spro bar byed cingaḥ drang sgong chen po brgyad kyis mngon brjod dang bstod tshig sgrogs paḥ reg 'dzin chen po brgyad kyis gsang sngags kyi spyod pa bshad pa dngaX rdo rje phra men ma'i tshogs kyis bro gar glu yi las byed paḥ sha za lce spyang gi tshogs kyis dur khrod gsod gcod kyi las byed paḥ gnas ma dang yul ma'i tshogs kyis bde ba chen po'i dgyes ston stobs pa thams cad kyang ye shes sgyu 0〈ga95 1105 ba'i da95 sdos gas05 gdab dbyi sa nas ye shes dbab bstim ba gnyis med rol bar bzhugs gsal gdab lta ba 'jal ba'i phyag bgyi zha ཿ snang srid kun bzang mchod sprin stobs glu gar phyag rgya

dbyangs kyis bstod bzlas pa sngags kyi 'dzab rgyun bgrangs des ni don gnyisalhun gyis grub nyams rtogs yar ngosazla ltar 'phel tshe dpal mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dbus spyod rig 'dzin sa la nges bar 'byor ze tshoms med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma māḥ e ma rgyal kun gsang ba gsum rdzogs dbyings pad+ma rak+ta 'byel klong nas gter srung sha za mched gsum gyis dus su dam tshig brdas bskul tshe rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rje yis rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod brtes gdul zhing smin cing sgol phyir spelaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥdziḥ zhesa'adi'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ta dang sngags gzhen kun bzang zung gis bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'ardoms nga drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i zab mdzod kyi sgom rgya las zhal bsal te dag par phab pa' yi ge pa ni pusabha dra bgyisapa dge legasa'aphel/ sabo maṅga le/

ga6/sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo'i phyi sgrub dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ rortenasithenargya(sgo dug lngas mnar ba'i 'gro ba la bde chen ye shes mchog stsol ba'i ma chen bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i phyi sgrub dngos grub char 'bebs bstan sa ma yāḥ dben pa'i gnas su yod byad bsags phyi na gsang ba'i dam rgya brdamaḥ phun tshogs lnga yi gzhung bsrang steḥ sngon 'gro'i bya ba grub pa'i rjes dngos gzha'i bskyed rim 'di ltar roḥ sa ma yuḥ —1nga pa'i ngang las snang srid kyi khams thams cad bde chen zhing gi bkod par gsal ba'i dbus suX dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong chos 'byung pad nyi ro gdan gyi khar rigs pa'i ngo bo hūḥmathing nag yongs su gyur pa las bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong ba can zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngam brjid 'jigs su rung bar gsal ba'i phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon pas bhan dmar 'dzin pa dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes par spras shing zhabs gnyis gar gyis bam gdan la rol ba'oḥ de yi shar phyogs su rdo rje seng gdong

ma dkar mo lho ru rin chen seng gdongs ma ser moḥ nub tupad+ma seng gdong ma dmar moḥ byang du las kyiseng gdong ma ljang nagaḥ kun kyang rdo rje rin chen pad+ma rgya gram gyi yu babyas pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la phyar baḥ khams gsum dbyings sgrol gyi khrag chen bskyil ba'i bhan dmar dku la brten paḥ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyisamadzes par spras pa 'ja' 'od thig le me dpung gi slong du gar bsgyur gyis 'gyeng ba'o gtso 'khor thams cad kyi mchan khung g.yon saduyab nyaru ka sbas pa'i tshul du kha ṭ+wāṃ kartse gsum brten cing bde stong zung 'jug gi nyams la rol ba'oḥ de rgyab ye shes kyi dbyings dang 'jigs rten gyi khams la dbang mdzad pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnal 'a 1ra ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bde stong spros mtha' dang bral ba'i nyams la spyod par mosaX las gzhung bzhin du spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod bstod bya sngags kyi sde khabasgyur ba ni rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po dzaḥsbrel ma lta bu dpag tu med par spros te snang srid 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dngas bcud ma lus pa 'od zer sna

—'di: tshogs pa'i rnam par 'ab se 'ub se sib rug rug bsdus nas bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la yang yang bstim moḥ hū baḥbarnya seng ha ḍāk+ki ni sidhi pha la hūṃ āḥ ting 'dzin ldan pas bye ba bzla de tshe lus bde shes pa gsalaḥ nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel tshe dang bsod nams rab tu rgyasaḥ khams gsum phywa g.yang dab du 'byur srid na ya mtshan che ba thob mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyongs bar 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yāḥ skabs su mchod bstod bya ba niḥ zod rnga sgrogs la 'di skad do hū hrīḥ stong nyid chos sku'i klong yangs nasaX ye shes sgyu 'phrul zhal bzang can 'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor dang bcasaḥ dad pas 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ skal ldan sgrub pa po rnams laḥ dbang byin dngos grub char ltar phobaX ḍāk+ki ni haḥriḥniḥs sarba sa ma ya dzaX mkha' 'gro 2bor 4 dpung gis byon par bsam la oṃ gyis rat+na'i snod stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang duX āḥyis bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung por gyuraḥ ( gis rdo rje lha mo'i gar dang bcas te dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la dgyes ston phul bar bsam la oṃ dz+nyā na ḍazhi ni paṃḥhaXriḥniḥs saX pā ri wa ra e rda bha lirnya kha kha

kha hi khāhiḥ lan bdun gyis phul nas bdag la rab tu dgyes par bsam moḥ / hrīX mi rtog chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos bzhin rtog bcas gnyis snang 'dul ba'i dpa' rtags canaḥbadud 'dul nag mo seng ge'i gdong ba can chos dbyings ye shes gar la phyag 'tshal bstod skye med dbyings las skye ba'i rnam 'gyur can snod bcud brtan g.yo gzugs skur bcos ma kunaX me long ye shes nyid du gsal mdzad pa'iḥrdo rje bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaX gshos su dag cing gshis las shar ba'i chos mnyam pa nyid du rol zhing chub mdzad cingaḥ rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i dbyings chen moḥ rat+na bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstod dhu ti'i rang bzhin ma rtog chags pa'i myos bde ba'i rang bzhin ma chen dgyes pa'i sprin so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ngo bo nyid pad+ma bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstod mtha' bzhi bral b.lichos kyi dbyings nyid las mu bzhir gol ba'i sems can 'dzin stangs canaḥ bya grub ye shes nyid du dag mdzad pa'iḥ karma bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstod (ཿ 'khor gyi las byed mkha' 'gro rnam par

btsasdo: brgyadaXganas dang yul skyong dbang phyug ma sring ging0 kun kyang ma chen drag mo'i sgyu 'phrul dalaḥrnam rol bsam mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstod gawa ya bsngo smon rgya yis gdab shis brjod dge ston dag pa ra bya des ni phrin las rab 'byams 'grub ma chen gsang gsum mngon du 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥs ma yāḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa 'di'ang lung zin pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dang kun bzang gnyis kyas bskul ro ra kho bo bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'iya gepa ni pu snya dras bgyisapa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma lam̐/

ga6/sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ bdud 'dul drag mo'i gsang sgrub 'arjegs med go cha bzhugs seḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ za'izug〉〉 mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dam tshag chogaḥ rang byung ye shes skyo ba gnad shin tu dwangs ba'i bla rdo yang sems kya phyag rgya phrab bca dgyes bska yongs kyiya gyal ni zla ba nyi sbyor tshogs ston spro mkha' 'gro mgu ba'i gsang gnad la dga' bzhi' ye shes gcerabur byung dben gsum mtha' ru du na pa 'i phyar mi med g.ya' gang sa ra la 'grims grub pa mthar phyin he ru ga'i tshogasakyi grwal chen bu des spyodaḥ sa ma māḥ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na mo shin tu dwangs ba 'byung lnga'i sgogaḥ sku gsum rang chas chen po laḥ bde chen mthong phyir skyabs su mchiḥ rdul sogasadag phyir sems bskyed doX gnyis pa la sna niḥ āX 'chi ba ka dag chos skur sbyangasaX bar do sgyu lus longs skur khyeraX skye ba sprul sku'i gzhan don bya mdzad phrin nub med phun tshogs shogaḥ 3 badz+ra sa ma dhi (ཿ hrīX sems nyid nam mkha' phyogs ris bralaX rang bzhin rlung gi byed las can rol pa gsal dag chu yi tshul ma 'gag gzhi snang sa ru

'phos so sor lta ba me yi ngar thams cad 'degs byed yum lnga'i mkha'aX rang byung rang shar lhun gyis grubaḥ eX yemaḥsuḥreḥphaṭaX hrīX rab 'jigs mkha' spyod bde chen zhing khrag mthung brda bkod rdzogs pa'i klong dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung dbus pad nyi rtog bral bam ro'i khar0 (༷ mthing las byung bdud 'dul maX mun pa'i gos can na pal chas brgyan seng skad nam mkha'i dbyings su sgrogasaḥ ral ba bsigs shing mkha' 'gro 'gyed snang ba dbang sdud gri gug phyar stong pa'i rgyas 'debs bhan khrag g.yon nabs gnyis gar gyi bsgyur thabs rolaḥ bde chen he ru mchan g.yon brten me dang rlung gi 'od zer 'bar rig sngags zhing skyes he ru ga'iḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro las la 'byed dza lan dha ra la sogs pa'i phyi nang 'brel ba'i gnas nyer bzhiḥ so dang sen mo 'bab pa sogasaḥ khams kyi grong khyer chen po naḥ zla ba thabs kyi cha 'dzin pa'iX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sa ya 'bumaX nyi ma shes rab rang bzhin canaX dpa' mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ༷ bde ba'i dbang phyug bsam mtha' yasaḥ rdul dang khu ba mtshan bcas kyiX spros pa dag

gtsasdo: pa'i dga' ston laḥ kun kyang mnyam gnas chen por dmigasaḥ( yul bzang yin rgyan he ru'i yulaX gnas mchog dhu ma tha la'i gnasaX zhing dang nye zhing lasogs paraḥrdo rje'i spyod pa rnam dag pa'i mkha' 'gro'i gtso moseng geligadong ཿ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcasaX ro gnyam chen por gshegs su gsolaX dam tshigadag pa'i 'khor lor bzhugasaḥ bden pa mthong phyir phyag 'gyi'oḥ yas dbab thabs te byi mchod dngaX mas brtan shes rab nang mchod dpalaX spros bral gcig 'khyil gsangab steḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bulaḥbyin rlabs rlung gi rta la drangasaḥ gtum mo me yi reg byas bskulaḥ bde stong bdud rtsi char ltar dbabaḥ gnad bzhi'i chings kyim khyod bstodaḥ phyi ru khu rdul g.yos pa'i skyonaḥ nang du mtshan bcas rtog pa'i driḥ bar na rlung sems 'brel ba'i 'phrangaX thams cad ma chen dgongs klong bshags yig brgya bzla gsum pa 'dzab niḥhūṃḥshes rab dbyings kyi phyag rgya mo'i ye shes thugs kyi 'dzab rgyun g.yosaḥ 'bar ba'i stobs kyi ba bzhos nasaḥ 'khor lo lnga yi yan lag bcasaḥ yongs khyab

nyi zla zhal sbyor teḥ rdo rje dpa' bo rnal 'byor laḥ mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro'i tshogasaḥ kun kyang thugs dam dgyes bskang nas bde stong ye shes glu gar bcasaḥ mtshanabacas snang rtog zil gnon cing spros bral ye shes mngon mthong nasaX ma chen thugs klong mngon gyur dmigasaḥ garma ḍasgonisedha mu kha kro ti kwa li hūṃ phaṭaḥ chos nyid lta bas 'dzabasgyun skyongs shes rab bde ba'i rdzogs rim sgomaḥ nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rab rgyas shing ma chen gsang gsum rjen par mthongaḥ sa ma yāḥ /ཿ phral byung rtog pa ma rig pas bskyed cing 'thas pa gzung dnga'adzinaḥ rten 'brel byad phur rbod gtong rkyen thams cad zhi ba chos skur sad tshe dpal nyams rtogs bkrag mdangs dngaḥ bsod nams dpal yon rab rgyas shingaX dregs tshogs zil gnon ar la gtad sde brgyad lha 'dre dbang du 'dus 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin gang yang drag pos tshar bcad nas phrin las rab 'byams yongs 'grub dmigasaḥ ཿ65ཿkaḥs maḥr thamachogaḥdaḥraḥs mā ra ya phaṭa swāhāX lta bas gcun cing sgom pas gzir spyod pa dam rgyas btab pa na byad gtad mi mthun g.yul las rgyal che btsan dregs pa'i gtsug na spa nus

— ba/sdo: mthu phrin las bsam mtha' yasaḥ sa ma yuḥ bzhi pa tshogs dang mchod bstod ni bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams kun dum gcig snod du bsags byas te bsangs sbyang spel 'bul bya ba ni ཿhrī ka dag stong chen dbyings kyi khyonaX rdul bral 'dod rgu'i dga' ston sprin sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rol par dmigasaḥ 'dod yon lha mo'i spro bsdu 'gyed re yi kheḥ tshe āḥhūṃḥ hūḥ rnam dag stong chen dbyings kyi klong cir yang mchar ba'i ma chen mkha' bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin nasaḥ mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol oṃ las byung ba'i dga' ston tshogs0 rin chen sna tshogs bzhong pa rtsa sgyu 'phrul ltad mor legs bkod nasaḥ ma chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bulaX gnyis snang rtog pa dbyings su bshags dam bskangs tshe dbang dngos grub stsolaḥ a 'thas 'khrul ba'i 'byung po bsgralaX skye med dgongs pa'i sang du bstabasaḥ 'khrul ba gzhi las sangs ba dngaḥ gdod ma'i sku gsum mngon gyur shogaX oṃ āḥshāḥ kun khyab dbyings kyi rgyan gyur ba'iḥ gzung 'dzin spros bral mchod pa'i sprin ro gnyam bde ba chen po yisaḥ ma chen 'khor bcas dgyes phyir

'bul oṃ ā hūṃḥ hoḥ sku ni zhing rnams kun la 'groḥ gsung gsang sngags gyi lta spyod sgogasaḥ thugs ni ye shes gzigs pa can bdud 'dul drag mor phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ the thog bskal ba grangs med nasaX ma khyod gsang chen 'du ba'i gnas dhu ma tha la'i dkyil 'khor dngaḥ 'du 'bral med pa'i smon lam mthu da ni rig par rang ngor sad gabor gsum spros pa ka dag steḥ klong chen bum sku'i gzhal yas su ༷ rgya grol ma chen gsang gsum laX dbang bsgyur thabs kyi he ru gaX rta mchog rol par byang chub shogaḥ āḥlhar snang ma dmigs chos skur bsdu rtag mtha' grol ba'i dgongs pa skyongs rjes thob lhar snang sgyu ma yis chad mtha' dgrol zhing spyod lam skyongs a āḥ phaṭa phaṭaḥ na moḥzil gnon stobs ldan seṅge'i zhal rdo rje gar gyi phyag rgya bsgyur bde chen sbyin pa'i pad+mo ngoms nyag gcig mngon mthong shis pa stsol/ rngams la bdud 'dul khro tshul ston zhi ba 'jigs skyobs tā rer sharaX chags la bde sbyin wa ra hi dbyer med ma chen bkra shis stsol de ltar ོga rim rnal 'byor pa'i nye lam mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrub 'di spyod pas bar chad bdud

— mi: las rgyal nyams rtogs lhan skyes bde stong 'baraḥ sa ma pāḥ ye maḥ rgyal kun thugs kyi thig le'i bcud man ngag rig pa'i khu phyug 'ad khye'u chung lo tsa'i dpal du shar bstan 'gro'i don phyir gter dusbas ma 'ongs dus kyi snyigs ma la thugs srasanusaldan rdo rje yis rted nas bstan 'gro'i pha na bde spelaḥ sa ma wāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyi mdo khams dpal gyi tsa ri ṭa'i dbang mdzod 'dod rgyal bla mtsho nas dus su sha za'i brdas bskul tshe don gyi nying khu dag par rted 'tshubs slong dbang ga re zhig sel chos bdag ral khur kun bzang gis bkra shis wa reg dri bral dang rngon chen gnyas pa 'i skyes bcas bskulaḥ bstan 'gror phan phyiranus lngan 'i dga' ston spro ba' thun gseng du dag par phab pa maṅga lam/ dza yan+tu/

—'di: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ bdud 'dul drag mo 'i nang sgrub khams gsum dbang sdud pad+ma'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo tswa na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ ṅkar+sharnardo k+karnashā tshogs spron las 'phro 'dzom pa yi skal bzang skyes bu las ldan gyis bsod nams nor sgrub bum pa bzang 'di nyid srog gi gta' ru 'chongs sa ma yāḥ dben pa'i gnas su phyi nang gi dam rgya bsdams teḥ mtshan ldan dum gcig gi nang du dza gad la bdud rtsi chos sman sbyar bas kha kheb rin chen gsum pa'i me lo gi ngor bzang drug dang la khri sbyar ba las chos 'byung gi ri mobetalnganasa'i mtshan par byas te thabs shes mtshon pa'i dar gyi kha kheb bkrams de nyid da la'i dbus su bkad la g.yas su sgrub gtor pad+ma spung ba dang g.yon du chag ga'i bral ba'i mda' dar mtshon sna lngas brgyan pa can dang gzhan yang zas sna dar zab g.yang rdzas sna tshogs pa bkod la rnam lnga nyer spyod kyi mdzes par byas te bas khrus tshogs bsags sngon du 'gro bar byas nas nor sgrub kyi las gzhung bsreng ba ni sha shātosgyu 1ṭi che nga pa'i ngang las snang srid kyi khams thams cad mkha' spyod bde ba chen po'i zhing gi bkod pa ma 'dres yongs rdzogs su shar ba'i dbus su zla gam dbang gi gzhal med khang 'dod rgu'i

longs spyod kyi char chen po 'bebs pa'i nang duX chos 'byung dmar nag pad nyi bam gdan gyi khar rig pahrīḥdamar po las 'od zer spro bsdus yongs su gyur pa lasabadag nyid khams gsum dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje gar bsgyur gyis rol ba de yang seng zhal g.yas su gzigs shing bdestong gi brda glu rtags tu sgrogs pas ma mo mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du sdud paX g.yu yi ral ba sprugs pa'i gseb nas dgos 'dod longs spyod kyi char chen po 'bebs pa phyag g.yas snang ba dbang sdud kyi pad+ma'i gri gug dang g.yon pas bde stong bdud rtsis bkang ba'i bhan dmar dku la rten pa dar dang rus pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyisamadzes par spras paḥ dbang gi 'od khyims rab tu g.yo zhing 'tshabs pa'i dbus su bskyed doX deyidapral bar bde chen gyi 'khor lor rdo rje seng gdong ma dkar moX 'grin palongs spyod kyi 'khor lorapad+ma seng gdong ma dmar moX snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor rin chen seng gdong ma ser moḥ lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lorayas kyiseng gdong ma ljang nag

ga6she: kun kyang snang ba dbang sdud kyi gri gug dang stong par rgyas 'debs pa'i thod khrag 'dzin pa dar dang rus pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes par spras shing khams gsum dbang sdud kyi dgongs pa la rtag tu gnas par mosaḥ gzhan yang snying ga'i rtsa 'dabs brgyad kyi shar du mkha' 'gro phag gdong ma mthing gsal ḍā ma ru dang bum pa 'dzin paX lho ru mkha' 'gro stag gdong ma ser mo gri shul dang bhan dmar 'dzin paḥ nub tu mkha' 'gro chu srin gdong can ma dmar mo rgyal mtshan dang bhan+ta 'dzin paX byang du mkha' 'gro gzig gdong ma ljang mo zhing chen gyi gzhi dang bhan khrag 'dzin pa shar lhor mkha' 'gro khyi gdo ma nag mo bar bu dang thod khrag 'dzin pa lho nub tu mkha' 'gro khra gdong ma dmar ser gri thod 'dzin paḥ nub byang du mkha' 'gro spyang gdong ma smug nag bum thod 'dzin paḥ byang shar du mkha' 'gro 'ug gdong ma ser nag zhags pa dang bum pa 'dzin paX kun kyang mdzes sdug srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'gyur canaX dar dang rus pa rin po ches rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras shing dbang gi 'od khyims g.yo ba'i sang du

brdzis skyes gar stabs su bskyed doḥ rigs bdag gu ru a tsar+ya yab yum 'khril sbyor mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi rgyun babs pas grub rdzas bhasto ltemamer gang zhing rnam 'byor pa la dbang chen bskur bar mos g.yin yang g.yas phyogs su dpa' bo pho tshogs kyis bro 'khrab cing thabs kyi rnam pa thams cad dbang du byed pa g.yon phyogs dpa' mo mo tshogs rnams kyis glu len cing shes rab kyi rnam pa thams cad dbang du byed paX mdun du ma sring dbang phyug rnams kyis gar bsgyur zhing sgrub pa po yirtogs pa bskyed pa rgyab tu rnam sras nor la'i tshogs kyis khams gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod phyu g.yang thams cad dbang du sdud cibhe sgrub pa po la stsol bar dmigs bum pa dang bhan+ta gtor ma la yang la tshogs de ltar du bskyedaḥ kun gyi thugs sgog sa bon las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis mkha' spyod gsang chen rol ba nas bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstim moḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod bstod las gzhu ltar du bya khyad par gyi dmigs ba ni rang dang rtsa gnas kyi lha thams cad kyi thugs gar

—8/sde: pad+ma dmar po'i sbubs su beḥha'ijeya'i/ rnam par gsal ba las 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phrosaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi dngos grub dngaX snang srid khams kyi rgyal blon 'bangs gsum zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang skyes pa pho mo thams cad rang dbang med par dbang du sdud cing bran du bskol bar dmigs 31 pad+ma seng ha ḍāk+ki ni baṃ lo ka sarba sirnyi pha la shāX bye ba bzlas pas ma chen rgyasaḥ snying nye dngos grub char 'bebs 'byur sa ma mā khyerngo nig nal nig nal 'gro ba mi yi snying rtsa 'gul 'gulaḥ srog rtsa slong slongaXmi sems g.yos shigaX snang ba dbang du bsgyur cigaḥ sarba sidhi pha la hoḥ skabs skabs tang 'dzin lcags kyu yasaḥkhams gsum phywagayang dbang du byed sa ma yā 61 bha wa sha na ḍak+ki ni sur+ya sirnyi slong slong aḥkṛ ༷ a ga ya hūṃ rat+na sirnyi pha la khug skyolaḥ ting 'ad na : gas kyu 'od 'bar sa rab tu bskul te bzlas pa byaḥ sa ma yāḥ61 pad+ma ḍak+ki ni pra mo yang yang rat+na bsdus bsdusaḥ ba su na na kha dhe ā la ya dza dza rig pa'i lcags kyu 'od 'bar bsaḥ khams gsum tswa g.yang dab du bsgyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ khyed pad+ma dhe wa ༷ sarba
