a dṛ 38ā shatī ya bsdus bsdus0 srid gsum dkor nor nga la regagaX mi g.yo ting 'dzin gdengs ldan pas khams gsum phywa g.yang dbang du byedaḥ sa ma mā 'di las zab pa'i man ngag ni khams gsum srid pa kun na dben rno nus byin rlabasabasam mtha' yas nyams su long dang rtags mtshan gsal chos pa ri la nyal na'ang mthun rkyen 'di nyid 'dzom pa'i chogaḥ bkres skom dbul phongs rgud sel phyir sbyin bdag bsod namasacan la dbang dngos grub nor gyi skal ba ni mkha' 'gro'i nang sgrub brtson la 'byor the tshom med do sa ma māḥ bka' 'di 'dod rgyal dmar pos skyong dam nyams lag tu ma shor cigaḥ sa ma yāḥyem dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi gnas pad+ma ra 'khyil ba'i klong de dang nye ba'i gnas mchog nas dus su mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe zab mdzod thugs sras dpa' bos rnyedaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥsnyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zinakun bzang dang pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni lung zinamakhye'i ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/

ba6/sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i bka' nyan dbang phyug ma'i mngon rtog phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so bsnyerdo: na mo to na ḍak+ko ri yaḥ ༅ sgo117 rab 'byams rgyal ba bskyed pa 'i dbyis sa 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i spyi rje mo za byed drag mo seng ge'i gdong mi 'bral snying dbus ze'u 'brur mchod bdud 'dul drag mo'i gzhung bsrang tsheḥ kha bskang dbang phyug sgrub pa ni dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' dbang mo'i khrag khyams la gnas pa'i yi ge spyoḥnyer brgyad yongs su gyur pa lasaḥ shar phyogs su srin mo g.yag gdong ma spug nag rdo rje 'dzin pa tshangs pa sbrul gdong dmar ser pad+ma 'dzin paḥ lha chen gzig gdong ljang sngon gri shul 'dzin paḥ gtog 'dod sre gdong sngon po 'khor lo 'dzin paḥ gzhon nu dred gdong dmar mo mdung thung 'dzin pa brgya byin dom mgo dkar mo rgyu zhags 'dzin paḥ kun kyang mi sdug srin mo khros pa'i cha byad can noḥ lto phyogs su rdo rje pha waṃ gi mgo can ser nag spu gri 'dzin pa zhi ba chu srin gyi mgo can dmar mo bum pa 'dzin paḥ bdud rtsi sdig gdong dmar spug pad+ma 'dzin paḥ zla ba khra

mgo dkar ljang rdo rje 'dzin pa be con wa gdong ljang nag dbyug to 'dzin paX srin mo stag gdong mazing nag thod zor 'dzin paḥ kun kyang rlung sems ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa'oḥ nub phyogs su za ba dmar ljang bya rgod kyi mgo can be con 'dzin paḥ dga' ba rta gdong dmar mo khog chen 'dzin pa stobs chen khyung gdong dmar ser dbyug do 'dzin pa srin mo khyi gdong dkar mo rdo rje 'dzin paḥ 'dod pa pu shud kyi mgo can dmar mo mda' gzhu 'geng ba nor srung sha mgo ljang nag bum pa 'dzin paX kun kyang chags pa'i rnam 'gyur can brin las rnam bzhi'i las la mnga' brtes par bskyed doḥ byang phyogs su rlung lha spyang gdong ljang mo ba dan 'dzin pa mi mo skyin gdong dmar mo gsal shing 'dzin paḥ phag mo phag gdong nag mo mche zhags 'dzin paX rdo rje khā gdong dmar mo zhing chung 'dzin pa sna chen glang chen dkar mo bam chen 'dzin paX chu lha sbrul gdong ljang nag sbrul zhags 'dzin paX kun kyang g.yon rnam bhan dmar 'dzin pa mchan gar sna dzadzhags su bsgyur zhing rja 441la ya ma zung stso na pa mi lngags g.yang bzhi dang sbrul chun matreX phreng can

badz+ra: gzig gi sham thabs klubs shing me rlung 'tshubs ma'i 1nga du gsal bar bskyed doḥ de rgyab dkyil gsar chen po'i sgo skyong shar phyogs rdo rje khu byug gi gdong can dkar mo lcags kyu dang bhan dmar 'dzin paḥ lho ru rdo rje ra gdong ser mo zhags pa dang bhan dmar 'dzin paḥ nub tu rdo rje seng gdong dmar mo lcags sgrog dang bhan dmar 'dzin paX byang du rdo rje sbrul gdong ljang nag dril bu dang bhan dmar 'dzin paX kun kyang dur khrod dpal chas can 'jigs rngams srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan par bskyed do lha tshogs thams cad gyi spyi bor zla ba la gnas pa'itsan dkar boḥ mgrin par pad+ma la gnas pa'ilha dmar po snying gar nyi ma la bzhugs pa'i3 sngon po gsum gsal ba las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pas rab 'khyams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs te dam tshig bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor la ro gcig tu bstim moḥ sbyar spol kyi dud pa btang zhing snyan pa'i dbya sa da bcas te 'di skad doḥ hūṃ hrī yul gyi ming ni o rgyan yul gnas kyi ming ni mkha'

spyod gnas dur khrod ming ni gsang chen rol mkha' 'gro'i ming ni seng gdong maḥ mun pa'i gos can srin mo'i sku rigs bzhi phra men sde brgyad dang dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu brgyad 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro maḥ 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod pan rnams rlung gis bskyod de pu ru rtsa lag pa gser gyi gdu bu canaX rdo rje'i mkha' la gar chen bsgyuraḥ rkang pa thabs mkhas 'gros stabs kyisaḥ mkha' la thogs med bun ne bun gser gyi ska rags mdzes pa lasaḥdril g.yer sgra snyan si li liḥ 'dzum sgegs bzhad pa'i rnam 'gyur las dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam yas 'gyedaḥ kun kyang gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskuraḥ sgrub mchog bdag gi bar chad sol mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ o dz+nyā na shāk+ṣi ni sarba sa ma ya dza dza dza0 hūṃ baṃ ho de ltar sgrub pa po rnamasal dbang go dngos grub char ltar 'bebs nyams rtogs yar ngos zla bzhin gsal don gnyis lhun gyas grub pa ra 'gyuraḥ sa ma ku ye maḥ rgyal kun gsang rdzogs gsu gi gnas pad+ma rak+ta 'jil ba dang nye ba'i gnas mchog rbas yul

brten: nas dus su sha za'i brdas bskul tshe zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod 'di rgyal mchog bshad pa'i rdo rjer sim skal ba can gya dpal du shar sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ta dang kun bzang bstan 'dzan dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda mdzod las zhal bsas te dag par phab pa'i ye ge ni pusabha dra bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo lam/

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las bdud rtsi sman gyi bskang ba mkha' 'gro'i dgyes bskyed zab mo bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nya na ḍak+ki ni ya shā rtsa bye mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo la 'bum phrag ḍak+ki'i sprin 'khrigs par mdun gyi namamakhar gsal gdab steḥ bdud rtsi sman gyi bskang ba niḥ skyong aḥ( pashā migurgya na ma ra sa ya na a dṛ ta hūṃ trīḥ'iX lan bdun dag par brjod byas te rigs lnga yab yum rdzas su brlabs zag med mkha' khyab sprin 'khrigs bsam rtsa gsum sras bcas dgyes pa bskangs ces āto/ hrī rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyis gzhal yas nas: 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon o rgyan pad+ma la sngags kyi dga' ston bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul rtogs pa mngon du gyur ba'i dngos grub stsol rang gsal lhun grub 'od lnga'i pho brang nasaḥ mkhyen brtse'i gter chen rtsa rgyud bla ma laḥ sngags kyi dga' ston bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bulaḥ rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i dngos grub stsalaḥ rang grol bde chen rdo rje'i pho brang nasaḥ yi dam rgyad sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor laḥ sngags kyi dga' ston bdud rtsi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i lhan stes bde stong

gnyug ma'i pho brang nas sku gsum ye shes dbyings rdzogs mkha' 'gro laḥsngags kyi dga' ston rtogs pa mngon du rig stong mi shig zang thal pho brang nas sems rtog zil gnon bdud 'dul drag mo laḥ sngags kyi dga' ston rtogs pa mngon du tshad sted thugs rje klong yangs pho brang nasaḥ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo drag rtsal rigs bzhi laḥsngags kyi dga' ston rtogs pa tshogs brgyad ka dag ro mnyam pho brang nasaḥ gzhan snang zil gnon mkha' 'gro sde brgyad laḥsngags kyi dga' ston rtogs pa grin las rnam bzhi lhun grub pho brang nasaḥ dkyil 'khor sgo skyong mkha' 'gro sde bzhi laḥsngags kyi dga' ston rtogs pa mngon du nyon mongs rang sar dag pa'i pho brang nas bka' nyan pho nya dam can lha lnga laḥ sngags kyi dga' ston dam tshig gsang sgog gcig tu 'dres gyur cig dug gsum ka nas dag pa'i pho brang nasaX gter gyi bdag mo sha za spun gsum la sngags kyi dga' ston dam tshig gsang sgog dbang chen zla gam gnyer skyong dregs pa'i gtso dbang phyug 'dod rgyal glang gdong dmar nag laX sngags kyi dga'

gtsasdo: ston dam tshig gsang sgog ye nas ma bcos thig le nyag gcig ngangaḥ 'khor 'das dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor laX blang dor mi dmigs sngags kyi dga' ston 'bulaḥ ye grol dgongs pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsolaḥ mahā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ khā hiX hūṃ nyi chos dbyings spros mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nasaX 'bum phrag gtso mo seng gdong 'khor bcas laX bdud rtsi sman dang tshogs mchod dam pa 'bulaḥ dam skong tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ mahā pañtsa a pra ta khāhiX ga ṇa tsakra khā hiḥ sarba pū dza khā hiḥ gags pa ni hoḥ sems nyid ye nas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i zhal: kun tu bzang mo'i rang bzhin yin pa laḥ ma rig dbang gi de ltar ngo ma shes rmongs sgrib chos kyidabyings su bshags bgyi'o rang bzhin 'od gsal spros pa kun dang bralaḥ 'gags med longs sku phag mo yin pa la ma rig dbang gi de ltar ngo ma shesaḥ dri bral chos kyi dbyings su bshags bgyi'oX thugs rje'i rtsal sgo gzigs tshul mtha' yas pa sgrul sku khros ma nag mor sangs rgyas kyang: ma rig dbang gis de ltar ngo ma shesaḥ bde chen chos

kyi dbyings su bshags bgyi'oḥ kun khyab bde ba chen po'i klong yangs suX tshad med rnam bzhi phrin las lhun grub pa mkha' 'gro sde bzhi yin par ngo ma shesaḥ gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dri ma bshags bgyi'o gdod nas dri ma bral ba'i chos nyid la: rnam shes tshogs yul spros pa ka dag nasaḥ mkha' 'gro sde brgyad yin par ngo ma shes gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dri ma bshags bgyi'o nyon mongs rang grol dam can lha lnga'i zhalaḥ dug gsum cer grol sha za spun gsum ngangaḥ rlung sems rang grol 'dod rgyal zung 'jug dal sgrub gzhi ma shes rang mtshan gol ba bshagasaX ye nas stong nyid spros dang bral ba laX rnam rtog dbang gi kun rdzob mtshan mar bzung tha snyad tsam du sdom dam nyams pa kun rgya grol rig pa'i klong du bshags bgyi'oX o āḥhūṃ badz+ra sa ma ya āX de ltar bskang bshags phul bas mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi thugs rab tu dgyes rteX bdag cag gi dam tshig nyams pa bskang zhing nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing bskyed par da' /gas seX de ltar ba gro nga — ni spri / nu na rtsi sman gya bska—bshags 'ari ཿ phul bas nyams rtogs 'phel zhing rgyas tshe

—8mi: bsod chos dang mnga' tha dar don gnyis lhun grub ze mi tshomaḥ sa ma yuḥyem klong chen mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod ni gsung gsang rak+ta'i dga' tshal dang 'brel ba'i 'dod rgyal bla mtsho nas sha zagasum dang dbang phyug gis tshogs kyi 'du ba chen por bcas dam tshig bdo yi gsang rgya grol rten 'brel dus bab smon lam mthus rin chen shog skyar pheb pa'oḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thamaḥsnyiḥ zhesache bdag kun bzang dang mthar phyin shes rab kyi cha bcas nas bsku ngor/kho bo bdud 'jomasanam mkha'i rdo rjes dag par smos te gsal byed kyi sgron mechosanyid rang grol nas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma la/

bas: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'iḥ don dam klong gi bshags pa brjod pa rang grol bzhugasaḥpas: namadz+nyān ḍa ska na yab sgri sko oX spros bral chos kyi dbyings nyid dag pa lasaḥ ma 'dres so sor snang ba'i chos so cogaḥ gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i nongs pa kun bya rtsol blo las 'das pa'i dbyings su bshagasaḥ mkha' 'gro'i sku ni gdos dang bral ba'i klongaḥ sna tshogs sku yi rdo rjer byang chub kyangaX gdos por 'dzin pa'i sems kyi dri ma kunaḥ rig stong ka nas dag pa'i dbyings su bshagasaḥ mkha' 'gro'i gsung nai 'gag pa med pa'i 1ngaX grags stong gsung gi rdo rjer byang chub kyangaX ming tshag tha snyad re ba'i blo rtog kunaḥ brjod bral gsung gi rdo rje'i klo du bshagasaX mkha' 'gro'i thugs ne+e 'khrul ba bral ba'i 1ngaḥ 'gyu 'phro ye shes thugs su byang chub kyangaḥ chags sdang rang khar spyod pa'i sgrib pa kunaḥ ye nas gnyis med chos sku'i klong du bshagasaḥ rtogs ge'i lta ba tha snyad sgom pa'i blo re dogs gnyis 'dzin chags sdang spyod pa kunaḥ gdod nas spros

dang bral ba'i dbyings su bshags bshags dang bshags byed tha snyad spros rtog kunaX ye nas gnyis med bde ba chen po'i klong sku dang ye shes chen por lhug par bzhag a āḥde ltar 1 bshags phur ba yis gzugs 'dzan sgrib tshogs sbya sa ba dang nyams rtogs yar ro sa zla ltar 'phel don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyuraḥs ma māḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥbado zimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa 'di'ang lung zin sngagasa'achangazung gis bskul ngor kho bobadud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las zhal bdus te dag pa ra phab pa'i yi ge pa na lung zin pusabhadras bgyis pa dge leg 'phel/sarba ma le/

bsko/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'iḥ dgyes bskyed rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs soḥ badz+ra: / nyi bla med gsang chen don gyi dkyil 'khor 'diraX rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i.a gro taḥ nyon mongs chags pa bral ba'i dmar chen po ro brgya nus pa stong ldanab lirnyiḥ ma rig mun selasgron me 'od stong 'baraX ye shes lha mo'i glu gar phyag rgya bcasaḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bulaX ma chen mkha' 'gros brtse ba'i dgyes bzhes nasaḥ 'khrul ba ka dag chos sku'i dngos grub stsolaḥ gdod ma'i dbyings su nges don byang chub shogaḥ de ltar bskang bshags phul ba yis nyam rtogs yar ro sa zla ltar 'phel ma sring mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyongs dbang byin dngos grub thob par 'gyuraḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgyaḥ brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di' lung zen dharma ku mu ta dang kun bzang zung gis bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyu — drag rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus rte dag par pha ba pa'i yi ge pa ni86sta dra bgyas dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lo/

—8rdo: tshogs bsdus ni bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs rnams dum gcig kā pa lar bsags te ram̐ yi khaṃX tshe āḥhūṃ gzhi snang sgyu 'phrul kun bzang rgyan gyi tshogasaḥ dug gsum rang grol sha khrag rus par bcasaX 'bum phrag gtso mo bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdongaX phyi nang nyer rgyu'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gror 'bulaX rnal 'byor nyams bskang rtog sgrib dri ma bshags rlung sems dhu tir sgrol la gnyis med bsre lhan skyes bde stong rtogs pa mngon gyur teḥ lta sgom ting 'dzin ye shes 'bar zhing rgyasaḥ tshe bsod nyams rtogs grogs mdzad lhag mas brngan rig 'dzin rnal 'byor srog gcig 'brel tshad kunaX kun khyab gdod ma'i dbyings su byang chub shog grangs bsogs tshe bsod nyams rtogs 'phel don gnyas lhun grub ze mi tshomaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥrda zimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang cho bdag dharmasabaskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'jomasanam mkha'i rdo rjes dag par phab pa sarba ma lo/

ga6/sdo: tshogs bsdus ni ram̐ yi khaṃḥ tshe āḥshāX gzhi snang dag pa rab 'byams don gyi tshogasaḥ stong chen mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog bskang byir 'bulaḥ rlung sems sgyu lus mtshan 'dzin ka dag nas dwangs ma'i dbyings su sku gsum mngon gyur regagaX grangs sogs nyams rtogs tshe bsod 'phel don gnyas lhun grub the ma tshomaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang dgos gal da bstun nas nus ldan bsoso/

bsko/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'iḥdagyes bskang 'dod yon sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo tswa na ḍak+ka na yaḥ gsamatshog3/rno snye med dbyangs las ma g.yos kyang 'gags med sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i maḥ ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo la rab gus dad pa sa phyag 'tshal loḥ dngos su'abyor ba' tshogs ston la yid kyis nam mkha'i mdzod du sprul ting 'dzan rdo rje rol ston gyas ma chen drag mo'i dgyes pa bskangs sa ma mā bskang gtor pad+ma sbung ba la bskang rdzas 'byor tshogs yo byad bkramaḥ lha sngags phyagargyas sbyangs bsgyur spel mi zad rig pa'i rgyan du sprin rnga rol snyan 'i dbya sa bcas te mkha' 'gro'i dgyes bskang 'di lta ra gyer hū nyi dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor niḥ rgyan ldan 'ja' 'odathig le 'khrigs pa'i klongaḥ lha klu mi yi dga' ston 'dzom pa'i gnasaḥ mkha' spyod 'bum phrag tshogs kyi grwal dbus nasaX mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong chos nyid spros bral sku mdog mthing nag rngamasaX 'bum phrag rgyud kyi char 'bebs g.yu ral mdzes a ti snying po ston pa'i thod brgyan laḥ ye shes lnga rdzogs dar lnga'i cod pan

'phur g.yas g.yon gzigs pas khams gsum mnga' dbang sdudaḥ ma rig mun sel nyi zla'i snyan cha byasaḥ pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rus rgyan spras: bya ba mthar phyin dar ljang dpyangs pa 'phuraḥ tshogs yul rang grol dur khrod dpal chas klubs srid zhi mnyam brdal zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur mdzadaḥ nyon mongs rgyun gcod ye shes me lnga 'baraḥkun rdzob bslu med brda ston gri gug phyaraX khams gsum don dam klong sbyor bhan khrag 'dzinaX thabs chen dpa' bo mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ gaX gnyis med bde bar rol ba mchan g.yon brtenaḥ gdos por ma grub dwangs ma'i 'od lus la gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i mkha' 'gro rdzogasaḥ grags stong haX ri shaṃ t+ma'i rang sgra sgrogs chos rnams ma lus mnyam pa nyid du stonaḥ ye shes thugs ni kun la yongs su snyomasaḥ bde ba chen po'i dga' ston gdul byar 'bebs bdud 'dul seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaX bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ trīX skye med nam mkha'i rang bzhin 'khor lo laḥ 'byung ba snyoms par byed pa'i dal dbus suḥ bde stong spros dang bral ba'i mkha' 'gro maX

btsasdo: stong nyid nam mkha'i rang mdangs dga' ston laḥ gnyis med gnyam par rol pa'i dam tshig can sku yi yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ hrīX 'gagasamed bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo laḥ shes rab bde stodra 'bebs pa'i thig le rtsa gas bral dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin tshogs ston laḥ gnyis med mnyam par rol ba'i mkha' 'gro maḥ gsung gi dbang phyug chen mor phyag 'tshal bstod bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ hrīḥ mi g.yo spros dang bral ba'i 'khor lo 13 thams cad yi ger gnas pa'i dal dbus suX blo bral gnyug ma gshis kyi dga' ston la mnyam par rol ba'i ma chen dam tshig canaX thugs kyi dbyings phyug ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ hrīḥ ye shes mchog gsang bskul ba'i 'khor lo rtsa sa lam yon tan 'byung ba'i dal dbus suḥdaga' ston spros dang bral ba'i tshogs ston shar bde ba chen por spyod pa'i mkha' 'gro maḥ yon tan kun gyis 'byung gnas mchog la bstodaḥ bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos

grub stsol 33 don dam bde ba mchog bskul 'khor lo na ye shes thig le sbyin pa'i da la na ro mnyam khams gsum sde sbyor tshogs ston sharaḥ gnyis med 'ub chub rol ba'i mkha' 'gro maX phrin las rgya mtsho'i gter la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaX hūṃ hrī mun pa'i gos can ma rig mun khams sel me tog sna tshogs mu tig char ba 'bebs: longs spyod gter dang phywa g.yang kun gyis mdzod nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed pa'i gzhi ma cheḥrdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug ma la bstodaḥ bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ hrīḥ 'jigs pa brgyad skyobasardo rjes go cha canaX pha rol gdug pa tshar gcod bdud 'dul ma nyon mongs zhi phyir zla ba'i 'od zer 'bar ma chen rdo rje gar gyi dbang mor bstodaX bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsalaḥ hrīḥ 'byor drug dpal bskyed rat+na'i mgul phreng canaḥ lha klu mi yi 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs ma yon tan rgyas phyir 'char ga'i 'od zer 'baraḥ ma chen ratā'i dpal ster dbyings la 'dudaX bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsol hriX khams gsum dbang sdud

bam/: pad+ma'i thod rgyan canaḥ lha klu mi gsum dregs pa'i sgog 'phrog maḥ dbang chen stsol phyir 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phroX ma chen pad+ma chags 'bar bde klong 'dud bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ hrīḥ mngon spyod lhun grub dur khrod dpal chas canaX gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med bgegs 'dul ma drag po'i las byed merlung 'od zer 'baraḥ ma chen bdud kyi gshed la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ bskang ngo tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaX hṝḥye shes kun khyab gzigs pa'i bka' drin canaX spyor sgrolathabs la mkhas pas ma chen mo legs nyes so kha srung ba'i dam tshig canaḥ 'khor 'das ro mnyam ston pa'i thugs rje canaḥ dgongs pa zang thal byin rlabs char 'bebs ma skye med dbyings las skye ba'i rnam 'gyur canaX gar gyi dbang phyug bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso mor phyag 'tshal bstod khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i rdzasaḥ lha rdzas rgyan gyi phyi mchod bdunaḥ nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga dug gsum cer grol sman gtor rakāḥ ma brtsal rdzogs ldan ting 'dzin 'phrulaX sha lnga bdud rtsi che

ba'i mchogaḥ zhun chen sbar ba'i mar me dngaḥsha chen gsur dud sbol kyi sprinaX 'khris pa'i dri chab mtsho ltar bskyilaḥ mo sa snying sna ri ltar spungs dbang lnga'i me tog gcal du bkramaḥ thod pa ltag sprod gsang ba'i rnga thabs shes rkang gi gling bu dang phyar dar g.yab dar mda' dar rdzas tha tshig bskul 'bod bshug glu dngaX snang srid ro gnyam dga' ston gyisaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs sku yi nyams pa gso ba'i phyiraḥ rdo rje gar gyis thugs dam bskangs gsung gi nyams pa gso ba'i phyir glu tshig dbyangs kyis thugs thugs kyi nyams pa gso ba'i phyiraX ting 'dzin dgongs pas zhi ba'i phrin las grub pa'i phyiraḥ dza gad skyems kyis rgyas pa'i brin las grub pa'i phyiraḥ dga' ston tshogs kyi dbang gi phrin las grub pa'i phyiraḥ a dṛ ta yis drag po'i phrin las grub pa'i phyiraḥ sha khrag gtor mas pho rgyud dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir pad+ma mtshal chen thugs mo rgyud dbang du bsdu ba'i phyiraḥrdo rje zil bas thugs dregs pa dbang du 'du ba'i phyir rin chen bdar bas gdug tshogs 'byung po 'dul ba'i phyiraḥ lcags bye

ga6sdo: zangs byes thugs nyams rtogs mngon du gyur ba'i phyir dad mos ldan pas snyan grags stong khams khyab pa'i phyiraḥrol mo'i sgra yis thugs lta ba nor na dbyings su bskangs sgom pa nor na rig pas bskangs spyod pa nor na tshogs kyis bskangasaḥ bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsolaḥ rnam 'byor las bzhi 'grub pa dngaX don gnyis yid bzhin 'byung bar mdzodaḥ hūṃ nyishar phyogs zhi ba lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas tshad med snying rje'i rang bzhin seng gdong ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsgres rgud bral ba'i sku rig pa ye shes 'char mdzad dam tshig canaḥ kun rdzob tsam du brda rtags sku yi garaḥrdo rje bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstod khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i sogs nas 'byung bar mdzod hūṃ nyi lto phyogs rgyas pa rmad byung dkyil 'khor nasaḥ tshad med byams pa'i rang bzhin seng gdong maḥ rat+na'i rang bzhin 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnasaX nyams rtogs yon tan bsted pa'i dam tshag canaX tha snyad tsam du sku yi bkod pa ngoms ratā seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal bstod khyed kyi thugs dam sogs

'byung bar mdzod hū trīḥ nub phyogs dbang chen zla gam dkyil 'khor nasaX tshad med dga' ba'i rang bzhin seng gdong maḥ pad+ma'i rang bzhin chags bral bde chen gzhi dben gsum mthar phyin 'od gsal don ston maḥ pad+ma bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstod khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzodaḥ hū nyi byang phyogs mngon spyod lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas tshad med gtang snyoms rang bzhin seng gdong maḥ rgya gram rang bzhin las bzhi 'byung ba'i gnasaX bdud dang dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dam tshig canaḥ kun rdzob tsam du dpa' rtags gar ngoms pa'iḥ karma bdud 'dul ma la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzod hū nyi sa rgyan rang byung gsang chen dur khrod nasaX bdud 'dul chen mo'i bka' yi las byed maḥ shar phyogs mkha' 'gro mthing nag phag gi gdongaX pho nya 'bod pa'i ḍa ru mkha' la khrol bde chen dpal smin gter gyis bum pa 'dzinaḥ rus rgyan dar gyi chas rdzo gas me kong 'gyingaḥ rdo rje phra men gar la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥkhyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byang bar

ga6sdo: mdzodaḥ hūṃ nyi ma chen mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi las byed ma lto phyogs mkha' 'gro ser nag stag gi gdongaḥ dug gsum tshar gcod gri gug mkha' la phyaraḥbade stong dpa la sbyin bhan dmar dku la brtenaX gar chen mkha' la bsgyur bzhin rus rgyan sprasaḥ me long glog gi 'od zer kun nas 'khyugasaḥ rin chen phra men sku gsung thugs la bstod khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzodaX hūṃ nyi bdud 'dul drag mo' bka' yi las byed maḥ nub phyogs mkha' 'gro dmar nag chu srin gdongaX brin las nub med sgrub phyir rgyal mtshan dang chags pa dbang du bsdu ba'i bhan khrag 'dzinaḥ rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung ston rus rgyan sprasaX 'bar ba'i me chen 'khyil ba'i klong du 'gyingaḥpad+ma'i las mdzad phra men sku la bstodaḥ khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzodaḥ ( nyi bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi las byed maḥ byang phyogs mkha' 'gro ljang nag gzig gi gdongaḥ rtog bcas gdon 'dul rtog med zhing dbyug phyaraḥ mtshan bcas rū dra'i khrag bskyil bhasmo 'dzinaḥrdo rje gar bsgyur rus rgyan dar chas spras ye shes

me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su 'byengaX las kyi phra men stobs shugs ldan la bstod khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzodaḥ hū nyi dbang phyug mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi las byed maX shar lho mkha' 'gro nag mo khyi yi gdong dngos grub char 'bebs bar bu mkha' la btegasaḥ log rtogs khrag bskyil bhan dmar dku la brtenaḥ bde rol gar bsgyur chags pa'i me 'od 'bar rus rgyan dar dpyangs me long dril g.yer brgyanaḥ phra men sha za mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstodaḥkhyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzodaḥ hū hrīḥ drag mo chen mo'i bka' nyan las byed maḥ lho nub mkha' 'gro dmar spug khra yi gdongaX nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri gug nam mkhar phyar khams gsum rgyan rol thod khrag thugs shar bsnamasaX bde ba'i gar bsgyur 'dzum pa'i zhal bzang ngomasaX rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs me rlung 'tshubs dbus 'bying phra men dam tshig mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzod hūṃ hrī ye shes mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi las byed ma0 nub byang mkha' 'gro spug nag spyang ku'i gdongaX

bam/: log rtog rgyun gcod spu gri ba ra ma dngaḥ bde stong dpal sbyin gter bum dku la rten ༷ rus rgyan dar gyi chas rdzogs me klong 'gyingaḥ 'dzum pa'i zhal ngoms rdo rje'i gar chen bsgyuraḥ phra men 'jigs rten mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar shogaḥ hūṃ trī bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro'i bka' nyan las mdzad maX byang shar mkha' 'gro ser nag 'ug pa'i gdongaḥ dgra bgegs 'ching byed rin chen zhags pa bsdamasaḥ mnyam nyid ro ston 'gyed pa'i bum bzang 'dzinaḥye shes gar bsgyur rus rgyan dar chas canaX sna tshogs 'dod gur me yi klong du 'byingaX phra men las kyi mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod ༷ khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzodaḥ hūṃ hrīḥ rnal 'byor grogs mo dab phyug nyi shu brgyadaḥ sku mdog mgo brnyan sna tshogs cir yang stonaḥ legs nyes stong 'dzin rnal 'byor yongs kyi grogasaḥ rlung sems ting 'dzin bskyed pa'i dbang phyug ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang rigs sngags zhing skyes rdo rje rnal 'byer maḥ sha za chen mo dbang phyug 'dod rgyal

dngaX dam can lha lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis sogasaḥ bka' skyong bstan srung tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstodaX khyed kyi thugs dam sogs 'byung bar mdzodaḥ de ltar bskang zhing bshags pa niḥhoX ye shes mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas dgongs su gsolaḥ bdag cag rnal 'byor mched lcam 'khor dang bcasaḥ ma rig 'brul ba'i dbang du gyur rkyen gyisaḥ slob dpon bsnyen bkur zhan zhing phan sems chungaX ma chen ye shes mkha' 'gror bshags bgyi'oḥ le lo'i dbang gis mchod pa phyi dus g.yelaḥ rdo rje seng gdong ma la bzod par gsolaḥ ser sna'i dbang gis tshogs gtor chung zhing chags: rin chen sed gdo ma la bzod par 'dod chags dbang gis dam nyams phyag rgyar brten pad+ma seng gdong ma la bzod phrag dog dbang gis chos la phyogs ris byasaḥ las kyi seng gdong ma bzod gti mug rmongs pas tshogs brgyad rang mtshan bzungaḥ mkha' 'gro sde brgyad sku la bzod tshad med thugs rje'i sang yangs zhal ma mjal dbang phyug ma sring tshogs la bzod sbyor sgrol ma byin dang du ma blang pasaḥ bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs la bzod par

ba6sdo: gsolaX hoḥ gti mug ma spang ngo bo rang grol teḥ chos dbyings ye shes yin par ngo ma shesaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul yin par don ma rtogs ༷ gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du bshags bgyi'o zhe ldang ma spang ngo bo rang grol teḥ me long ye shes yin par ngo ma shesaḥ rdo rje seng gdong yin pa don ma rtogaḥ ma rtog 'khrul ba'i dri ma bshags bgyi'oḥ nga rgyal ma spang ngo bo rang grol teḥ mnyam nyid ye shes yin par ngo ma shesaḥ rin chen seng gdong yin pa don ma rtogaḥ nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i rtogs pa bshagasa'agye'oḥ 'dod chags ma spang ngo bo rang grol teX sor rtog ye shes yin par ro ma shesaḥ pad+ma seng gdong yin par don ma rtogaḥ go rtog 'khrul ba'i blo 'di bshags bgyi'oḥ phrag dog ma spang ngo bo rang grol teḥ bya grub ye shes yin par ngo ma shes las kyi seng gdong yin par don ma rtog: nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i sgrib tshogs bshags bgyi'o tshogs brgyad ma spang ngo bo rang grol te lhun grub sgo brgyad yin par ngo ma shes phra men sde brgyad yin pa don ma rtogaḥ gzung 'dzin sems gyi dri ma bshags bgyi'oX bshags bya

bshags byed gnyis med ka dag ngangaX don dam mtha' bral ma chen dgongs klong bshagasaXḍak+ki ni sa ma ya bi shudhe āḥde ltar bskang bshags phul ba yis rnal 'byer nyams pa sor chud cing dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskangs sgrub pa po yis nyams rtog 'phel don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par 'gyuraḥs ma yāḥye maḥrgyal kun gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde chen klong de dang nye ba' gnas mtshog nas dus su mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe thugs sras rgyal mtshog bshad pa yis mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod gsal bar 'gyuraḥs ma pāḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa 'di'ang lung zin pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang kun bzang gnyis kyis bskul ngor/kho bo bdud mjom khyung drag rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na purje'i ming gisabargyasapa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo le/

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las mkha' 'gro'i dgyes bskang bsdus pa kun bzang sprin dpung bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki mi yaḥ rgyarngonazu snod kyi 'arig rten khyon yangs ba ra bcud gyi dga' ston tshogs su bkod blang dor med pa ra 'bul bgyid na nyams pa gso zhing zugs dam bskangs rba gling bshug glu rol ma'i sgra snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad doḥ hūṃ trīḥ chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nasaX bde stong gsang mdzod 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i rjeX bdud 'dul drag mo seṅge gdong pa canaḥ snang stong gzigs pa ngoms pa'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ mthing nag g.yu ral nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phroḥ thod rgyan rdo rje rtse lnga 'od zer 'baraḥ dbang rtags dar sna lnga yi cod pan bcingasaX ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ seng zhal g.yas ngoms pho rgyud dbang du sdudaḥ g.yon du gzigs pas mo rgyu dam la 'dogasaḥ thad gar rngam pa'i dregs tshogs ar la gtadaX ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i thugs dam bskangs tshad med rnam bzhir mtshon pas mche ba gtsigasaḥ mnyam nyid rdo

rje'i ljags ni glog ltar 'khyugasaḥ nga ro seng skad sgrogs pas sa gsum 'dar ma chen 'dud 'dul drag mo'i thugs nyid kyi dpral b.rathal chen tshom bur bkod ༷ 'khur tshos bde chen sbyin pas khrag thig byugaX ro mnyam brdas ston zhag gi zo ris chagasaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul drag smin mar bskal ba'ime 'bar srid pa bsregasaḥshangs nas rlung 'byung dug gsum 'byung po brgyal spyan mig nyi zla'i 'od kyis mun khams 'joms: ma chen bdud 'dul phyag g.yas nyon mongasargyun gcod gri gug phyar g.yon pa gzung 'dzin rgyan rol thod khrag 'dzin thabs shes cha 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'bum 'bum 'gyedaX ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i pha rol phyin drugadza gas pa'i rus rgyan sprasaḥdam ldan yongs la brtse bas gser rked mjesaX stong nyid chos sgra sgrogs pa'i dril g.yer snyan ma chen bdud 'dul bde stong bu labasre bas nu ma 'buraḥ gsang chen snying po'i don ston pad+mo rgyasaX zag med ye shes sbyin pas 'o rgyun 'bebasaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul zhi ba chos skurasgrol bas zhabs g.yas bskum 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon phyir

bas: g.yon pa brkyangaX sgeg 'gying rnam 'gyur bzod dka'i gzi mdangs 'baraḥ ma chen bdud 'dul zhe sdang rang grol gzig gi sham thabs mdzesaḥ 'dod chags ro mnyam mi lpags sked chings byas nga rgyal rgyan shar glang gos stod g.yog klubasaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul gti mug ma spang sbrul gyi do shal la kun rtog gnas dag mgo phreng brgyad cu spudaḥ phrag dog shar grol rdo rje'i rlung gshog g.yo ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i thugs dam bskangs khrag 'thung lnga mtshon thod skams dbu rgyan laX zhi ba rigs lnga rdzogs pas rtse phran mdzesaḥ ye shes lnga ldan cod pan phyogs su 'phuraḥ ma chen bdud 'dul phrin las mdzad pas seng chung thog ltar 'bebs snyan cha nyi zla las byas 'phrag la bkalaḥ bya ba lhun grub dar dpyangs ljang sngon mdzes ma chen bdud 'dul dpa' bor mtshon pas kha ṭ+wāṃ mchan du bcug dug gsum rtsad gcod rtse mo gsum dang ldanaX sku gsum mtshon pas thod pa'i tshar gsum brgyanaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul 'chi med dpal stsol tshe bum bcud ldan dngaX brin las lhun grub rdo rje rgya gram mdzesaḥ 'gro

don phyogs med dar dkar 'phur ma g.yoḥ ma chen bdud 'dul yu ba bsil ldan tsan+de shing la byasaX ma tshogs 'bod pa'i ting ting dril g.yer spud thabs mchog bskul ba'i ḍa dra rnam par brgyanaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul spyi gtsug rigs 'dus pad+ma 'od 'bar shar sku la gnas yul he ru'i mkha' 'gro rdzogs rdo rje me rlung thog ser bu yug 'tshubasaḥm chen bdud 'dul rig sngags zhing skyes dkar ser dmar ljang 'bum cha lugs gtso dang mthun zhing rnam 'gyur sgeg rdo rje phra men brgyad dang sgo bzhi skyong ma chen gtso 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs khyod kyi rnam 'phrul la la gzhon nu maḥ mdzes sgeg chags pa'i nyams 'bar sngags la gdungaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du grwal ma nges spyodaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul kha cig sha za mkha' 'gro ral bsigs maḥ sha 'thug lus rgyas so dang sen mo ring khyod srog gcod cing sha khrag sngags la mos ma chen bdud 'dul kha cig sngo sang nam mkha'i mdog lta bu skra dkar kha na so med ha ha rgodaḥ lag na sba thogs mgur dbyangs snang glu len ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i thugs dam

ga6sdo cha bskangasaḥ du ma khrag mdog chags pas pho grwal rgyugaḥ bzhad dang mtshar glu bro gar bzhad la skyenaX nyams snang 'ur zhing spyod pa ma nges stonaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul re 'ga' rig sngags zhing skyes tshul 'dzin kyangaX bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i grogs byed sngags bstan skyongs rig 'dzin yongs kyi zhabs pad spyi bor lenaX ma chen bdud 'dul 'khor 'das dngos mtshan dag pa'i bskang rdzas dang chos nyid sgyu mar rol ba'i 'phrul mo che rig pa ye shes dga' ston mtha' yas pas ma chen bdud 'dul lta ba yas 'bebs gdod nas ka dag klong spyod pa mas 'dzeg gzung 'dzin rnams grol ngang sgom pa zang thal thig le nyag gcig gisaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul bskang bya bskang byed dngos 'dzan dag pa na/ 'khor 'das ro mnyam rmad byud rdzogs pa cheḥ 'bras bu mtha' bral kun bzang dgongs pa'i klongaḥ 'bul bzhes gnyis med chen por a la laḥ de ltarabaska bas tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib dag nyams rtogs nga gis 'phel tshe da bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas ma chen thugs son sras su 'gyur sa ma mā dbang mdzod zangs sgom dam ra po las du tra'i snyi shog brda ris ni sred

len bral bar klong nas mjal gzung 'dzin yul la re ma dogs blo bral rag pa'i rgyun bzang po nam mkha'i rnal 'byor dpal du shar sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ gurgyaḥ brda thimaḥdziḥ zhes chos bdag kun bzang dang mthar phyin zu gis skyes bzang por byas te bskul ba dang / nye char grogs gisayang yang bskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'jomasanam mkha' rdo rjes dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa na sngags skyes chos nyid mang gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

gtsasdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ gter srung sha za mched gsum gyi ༷ mngon rtogs gnam lcags spu gri bzhugs soḥ—rten: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ 4049shā ཿ/ shin tu 'jig pa'i dur khrod du phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya bsdams nal zod nang du sha khrag gas brgyan pa'i gtor ma zur gsum pa mnyen lhug gsum da gtor chung bzha nyer spyod 'dod rdzas bā ril sbu saḥ dar stags gdugs sogs mdzes byas te dkyil 'khor dbus su bkod par bya sman rakwa gtor ma rnam lnga bkrams sgrub rdzas bsangs sbyangs nan du bya rang nyid bdud khrul drag mo yaḥ bskyed rim nga nas 'di skad doḥ bh+yoḥ rang mdun me rlung dud sprin 'tshubs ma'i dbusaḥ rak+ta rba rlabs 'phyo ba'i klong dkyil du ruyuX bh+yoḥlas byung ba'i ma chen mo sha za ḍāk+ki mi snying rlon 'phrog maḥ khrag mdog zhal gyi dkyil 'khor bzod dka'i nyams spyan bsgrad mche gtsigs zhal nas ha ha dgod: khrag ral gzengs shing dug khrag char ba 'bebs dam rtags dpral bar me tog tshom bu'i dbus: gser gyi rdo rje phyed pa 'od zer 'bar: snyan cha dung las byas shing rin chen brgyan mi lngags rlon pa sku yi rgyan du

gsol:mgo phreng sbrul chun dar gyi dpyangs pa mdzes:nu ma phrag bkal 'o khrag rgyun 'bebs cing:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur glog sprin dbus na 'gyeng phyag g.yas dgragasod spu gri ngar ma phyar:g.yon pas zhing bcu'i don snying zhal la stobs:'jigs rngam srin mo 'khros 'dra'i sku ru gsal:g.yas su phyag bsnyen chu srin gdong can ma:sgruganag khros ma lcags kyu na dmar 'dzin sbrul dang sgyu ma glog gi zhags pas brgyan:g.yod du bka' nyan dred kyi gdong pa can:dmar gsal chags nyams rgyas shing 'brutshigs lta phyag g.yas r+sha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon pas nad skyal bsdamasaḥrus rgyan mgo phreng me yi 'od zer 'bar gnyis ga'i zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur bam gdan rolaX shar du dur byed nag mo mun pa'i mdogaḥphag dkar mi ro'i rgyan cha byas pa khrid ༷dgra srog gcod pa'i sha za 'bum gyis bskoraXgatso mo'i bka' nyan bstan la lhag par gdungaḥlte ru kha kha mthing nag bya rog gdong sprel ser nad kyi rkyal chen bkal ba khridaXdagra snying 'byen pa'i sha za 'bum gyis bskoraḥm chen bka' la nyan zhing dam la gdung nub tu hu lu

—8mi: smug nag 'ug gdong maḥ shin tu khros nyams gser 'phar mtshon bkal khridaḥ dgra dbugs sdud pa'i sha za 'bum gyis bskor kun kyang gtso mo'i bka' nyan phrin las sgrubaḥ byang du he le ljang nag spyang gdong masaḥ lce spyang khyi nag bla gsod mang po khridaḥ dgra bo rdul brlag sha za 'bum gyis bskoraḥ thams cad bstan la gdung zhing dam la gnasaḥ ma chen srog sngags kun gyi sa bon lasaX 'od 'phros bde chen dbang gi bzhal yas nasaḥ dur khrod rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrigs pa las ༷ ma chen 'khor bcas sngon gyi tha tshig bzhinaX dgyes pas zhal bzang brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur bcasaḥ dam tshig bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib bstimasaḥ rang srog 'od kyis pho nya zil gyis mnanaX de dag sgog snying bdag la rab 'dus teḥ bka' nyan 'bangs byed ci bcol sgrub par bsamaX bh+yo ma hūṃ tsa dur mu kha snying kha rasmo dung dung 'dus 'dus dzaḥ smra bcad dam rgya byas te zhag bdun bsgrub sgo brdung thugs chom sgra 'byung me stag 'phro bskang gsol mnyes pa 'i thabs la nan du 'badaḥ sa ma mā bye ma hūṃ tsit+ta yak+ka sim sim a tsar+ya sidhi stamaḥ dam rgya byas te zhag lngar bzlas par brtson bud med tshogs 'du

rab la zhal gzigasathobaḥ sa ma māḥ bh+yo ma hūṃ snying kha ra1 yak+ka zlog bh+yoḥ 'khu rtags byung tshe 'di nyid bzlas pas thub sa ma yuḥ :sna ma hūṃ ḍāk+ki kā li rkang pa ye ye dgra la thob spor dzaX zhag bdun bzlasapas dgra bo'i steng du 'groḥ sa ma yāḥ bh+yo ma hūṃ lcags thig khol bur phobaḥ ming ka dur bram dza gī la nag mo dun dza sa ma ya rak+ta sto haṃ sngag 'di shub bur brgya rtsa bzla bong khrag gzhi la dur sola'ajog dpa' bo bsad pa'i rkang gis brngan bden pa brdar bas dgra ming nyid sha za mkha' 'gros yi ger bri bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsalaḥ sa ma māḥ bskul ba za ru drag bskang 'bul dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang brlag nang du ma bzhin gdung sems che 'di sgrub yon to bsam mi khyabaḥ sa ma yuḥ skabs susngags kyikhā hi 'bul zhing bstod pa niḥ / bye pad+ma'izab gter bstan pa'i gter skyong zhingaX rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi grogs gcig puḥ dgra la gshe zhing bgegs la za rngam cheX dug gsum rtsad gcod sha za mkha' 'gror bstod de ltar sha za spun gsum gyi sgog sgrub tsit+ta dmar po 'di gcig brgyud la ni 'chorami rung spel rgya che na bka' chad 'byung mkha' 'gros 'khru ldog rang la 'bebs de phyir bsdams spel mkhas par gyisaḥ sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya mi maḥ shin tu zab pa thugs kyi bcud bstan srung drag sngags las kyi mtha' rnal

—rten: 'byor bstan pa 'dzin la spelaḥ ra 'dod gsod gcod mkhan la sbaḥ bshad sgrub gzha 'dzug dpal du shogaḥ sa ma shāḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda zimaḥdziḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zen kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas nas bskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'joms nam mkha'i rdo rjes man ngag zab mdzod kyi sgrom rgya las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'iyi ge pa na lung zin pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅka lam̐/badz+ra: bh+yoḥ rab 'jigs dus mi'abar ba'i skuḥ sha za mi snying rlon 'phrog maḥ bka' nyan zung dang yang g.yog 'bumaḥ 'dir pyon dgra sha khrag skyems bzhes zab gter bsrung la bstan dgra sgrol ༷ 'khor slob bsdus la nyams rtogs bskyedaḥ 'od skur 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig de ltar grangs bsogs phrin las 'grub rno nus yon ma bsam mi khyab bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal nges shes gting nas 'drong bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ ces pa 'da'ang sa bdag kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas nas bskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'joms namamakha'i rdo rjes dag par smras te yi ger gsal byedayu zan dharma ku mud tas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

ba'i dgra la rbad do za ngu gyisaX gsang chen bde klong gnas la dbang bsgyur zhing zab gter chos 'khor bsrung ba'i bstan skyong ma gar dmigs yul sde brlag pa'i phung byed maḥ dgra snying rlon par bza' ba'i bdud mo laX sdang dgra gtad do 'chor med za ngu gyisaḥ pho rgyud grir sod mo rnams 'gags su chugaḥ byis pa chung rlog dkor nor phung thal mdzodaX khyod la drag rtsal yod na da phyungs shig ming dang don mthun yin na da ran pasaX sdang ba'i dgra sgog chod la za ngu mdzodaX nye ba rtsa lag stong ba'i za ngu mdzodaḥ dkor nor phung thal btang ba'i za ngu mdzod za ngu'i dmag gi nus mthu phyir ma ldogaḥ rang las 'phros pas srung mdud gos dum sogasaḥ dgra la shor dang zhu mjal blang na'angaX ma chen khyod kyi 'khu ldog mi mdzad paraḥ nyes can ma stong bar du za ngu mdzodaḥ ma 'da' pad+ma'i bka' dam dpang btsug go dgra bo tsig tsigaḥ tsit+ta shag shagaḥ mā ra ya dzaX thum ri li tsa) ching thegadaḥ khrag skyems mchod cing gtor ma bstabs des na dgra sde tshar gcod cang mngon spyod grags pa rab tu rgyas the tshom med do sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya ye maḥshin tu zab pa'i thugs ba da skor dam ldan bstan pa'i

dur byed nag mo yangaḥ nyams pa'i sha la rol cig dgyes pa bskangasaXdrag tu bskul lo spyo 'bog ltas ngan lto yi las mkhan khā kha mthing nag yangaX nyams pa'i rus la rolacig dgyes pa bskangs drag tu bskul lo spyo 'bog ltas ngan nub kyi las mkhan hu lu sgrug nag yang nyams pa'i khrag skyems phul lo dgyes pa bskangs drag tu bskul lo spyo 'bog ltas ngan byang gi las mkhan he le ljang nag yangaX nyams pa'i dbugs kyi mchod do dgyes pa bskangs drag tu bskul lo spyo 'bog ltas ngan shar gyilas mdzad pho nya rdzu 'phrul can phag dkar mi ro bkal ba drag tu bskulaḥbarngan pa'i dpa' skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la ༷ dgra bo'i yul du than ltas rang gzugs 'phrulaXlto yilas mkhan pho nya rdzu 'phrul can sprel ser nad skyal bkal ba drag tu bskul brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dgra bo'i yul du nub kyilas mkhan pho nya rdzu 'phrul can gser 'phar mtshon cha bkal ba drag tu bskul brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dgra bo'i yul du byang gi las mkhan pho nya rdzu 'phrul canaX khyi nag dgra bo'i bla rkun drag tu bskulaḥ brngan

gtsasdo: pa'i dpa' skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ dgra bo'i yul du than ltas rang gzugs 'phrul sgob dpon pad+ma khrag 'thung nag po yis dur khrod 'dre mo'i dmag tshogs gtso 'khor bcasaḥ sngon nas tha tshig gnyan la bzhag la bzhinaḥ bstan pa'i dgra la bka' chad sna dgu stonaḥ sha khrag don snying dpa' skyems brngan yon bzhes dgra bo pho rnams gri ru 'gum par mdzodaḥ dgra bo mo rnams spyo 'bog 'gags srir sodaX dgra bo'i chung gsum mngal nas skems zhing sodaX dgra yul than gyi char phob dgra sde rlogaḥ mngon spyod mthu yi drag pa rgyas par mdzodaḥ srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i che btsan bskyedaḥ sngags kyi dbang phyug rnal 'byor dam ldan gyis phrin las gang bcol dzo/bas chagag sa ma yāX ces brjod grangs bzhin gtor chung re bsags la bsang nang 'bul bar bya dmod bar drag po' bcol gtad 'bul dgra dpu pha lam yin kya 'jigs bgegs dpung rdo rje yin kyang rlog byin rlabs nus mthu bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma wāḥye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud skor rin chen sa ya gter kha 'di dus kyi rgud pa sel ba'i phyir thugs gras rig 'dzin dpa la du sharaḥs

ma pā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda zim snyi zhes pa 'di'angatshasabadag kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyis bskul ngor/kho bo bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyis dag pa ra phab pa 'i yi ge pa ni༄rje'i ming gis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

—8/ : sha za sbun gsum gyi gsol mchod bsdus pa niḥ sha khrag snyemasadang gtor ma bshams la 'gugs bstam nan du byas mthar sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor dmigs nas bskang ba naḥhū rje bde chen dbang gi 'od khyim 'bar ba'i sangaX zangs lcags 'dres pa'i sku mkhar sdem pa nas pad+ma'i bka' nyan sha za 'bum gyi gtsoḥ zhing dang nye zhing yongs la dbang bsgyur ma dgra bgegs snying 'byin spug mo khrag ral canaḥ mi lngags go bgos sbrul dang mgo phreng brgyanaḥ nu pad rgyas shi mche ba zla ltar gtsigasaX spu gri ngar ma dgra snying dmar rlon 'dzinaḥ me dud 1nga 'bying legs nyes shan drang 'byedaḥ ro langs dmar mo chu srin gdong can dngaḥ rlung gi shugs canagubyu dred gdong canaX dur byed nag mo kha kha hu lu maḥ he le ma tshogs sprul pa 'bum 'bum bcas rnal 'byor dam tshig can gyi mos ngor byonaḥ dpa' skyems dgra sha khrag gi rgya mtsho 'bulaḥ sku gsung thugs bskang dgyes pas 'dzum bzang ston thugs 'gal nong pa phra rags gang song bshagasaX dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su mnga' gsol loX rnam rol bstan dgra'i gshed mar rtag tu bskul phrin las

thogs pa med par stsol phyir bstod ma gdung bu la brtse bas dam tshig bzhin thugs gter 'dus pa'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongasaḥ legs pa'i dpal sprod nyes pa'itshogs dang bsnolaX dgra sde sdang na than gyi char ba phob ༷ bgegs sri g.yo na chos dbyings stong par bsreḥ drag rtsal ya mtshan srid na dper 'jog pa'i phrin las myur sgab mchen dam tshig canaḥ zhes grangs ldan du 'bul lo yang na bh+yo rab 'jigs dus me 'bar ba'i skuX sha za mi snying rlon 'phrog ma bka' nyan zung dang yang g.yog 'bumaḥ 'dir byonadagra sha khrag skyems bzhesaX zab gter bsrung la bstan dgra sgrol 'khor slob ba sa la nyams rtogs bskyedaḥ 'od skur 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cigaḥrwa/ ltar grangs bsogasaphri las 'grub rno nusayon tan bsam mi khyab bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal nges shes gting nas 'drong bar 'gyuraḥ sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyi ces pa 'di'ang chosabadag kun bzang bsnyan 'dzin dar rgyas nas bskul ngor / kho bo bdud 'jom nam mkha' rdo rjes dag par smras te yi ger gsal byed lung zin rdarma ku mud tas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

btsasdo: dam chos thugs gtor 'dus pa lasaḥ gter bsrung sha za chen mo'i phud gsol rgyug mchod ngar ma bzhugs soXbatsasdo: za 14khri khrag yo bsres pa'i skyems bshams la 'gugs bstems grangs mang byas pa'i mthar ram̐ yi khoḥ bhan+ta yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang duḥyid la brnag pa'i dgra bo'i snying khrag gi dmar ltem mer gang zhingaḥ khrag sbu rab tu 'phyo zhing sob sgra dang hab sgra g.yo baḥ bla rkun sha zan khyi nag 'phar spyang gi tshogs 'phro baḥthan gyi 'ug pa la than rigs sna tshogs pas bskor nas khrag la gzhib cing dgra la rngam par bskyed doḥ sa aX〉 ma hā rak+ta hūṃ hrī 'iX lan bdun brjod hoḥ drag po phud kyi mnga' bdag sha za mi snying rlon phrog chen mo gtso 'khor phyag brnyan dang bcas paḥ rang bzhin gyi rnams par dag pa'i gnas na bzhugs samaḥ li yul lcang ra spug po na bzhugs samaḥrgya gar rdo rje gdan na bzhugs samaḥ rgya nag dur khrod bsil sprin na bzhugs samaX su shar gser gling na bzhugs samaḥ 'byung ba lnga yi dbyings na bzhugs samaX 'on te sgrub

gnas chos 'dzadar gtsug lag rigs sngags zhing skyes kyi tshogs gral gang na bzhugs kyang dza gad dang khrag skyems sbyar ba'i rgyugs mchod 'bul ba'i dga' ston la gshegasashigaX byon cigaX badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza rol mo sna tshogs pa' sgras bskul zhing spyan drangs bar bya'o nal bu'i gsur dud btang bshud pa rnga gshang 'grol khrag skyems bshar la 'di skad doḥho dade sa su gache la 31 sha za stong gi gtso moḥ sha za khri yi rje moX sha za 'bum gyi che shos sha za byed ba'i grwal bdag sha za dung phyur gyi phyag brnyan mi srun gson snying rlon 'byin dgra yi gshed ma chenamo sku nam mkha' la bskyod tshe nyi zla gza' skar gyi 'od 'phrog par byed paX bar snang la gnas tshe thog ser bu yug rlung nag gi 'tshubs ma g.yo bas nyin mtshan go 'byed dka'abaX sa gzhi la rgyu tshe gas rims dang khrag nad char ltar 'bebs shing gnam sa yo log tu byed pa'i dur bdag chen mo la gsol loḥ mchod do miyiyung po 'od 'bar tsha regabazod par dka' ba la gsol loḥ mchod doḥ nyi zla gnyis kyi spyan khrag ltar khol ba la gsol loḥ mchod doḥ shangs nas nad kyi rlung dmar g.yo zhing dug gi bu yug 'tshubs

—8rdo: pa la gsol loḥ mchod doḥ zhal nas spu gri'i 'khor lo nad sna tshogs kyi char ba sprin ltar g.yo ba la gsol loḥ mchod doḥnu ma gnyis phrag tu bkal zhing khrag nad kyi rgyun dgra bo la 'bebs par mdzad pa la gsol loḥ mchod doḥ rkang pa rlung gi gar la gnas shing gling bzhi yud tsam gyis bskor bar mdzad pa la gsol loX mchod doX lag pa lcags kyu dang sha zung lta bu'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'tshor med du 'dzin par mdzad pa la gsol loḥ mchod do yang cig rgya gar rdo rje gdan na bzhugs tsheḥzhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro bdun gyi phrin las byed cing bstan pa srung bar mdzad pa la gsol loḥ mchod doX dur khrod chen po bzhin na bzhugs tshe sha za mched brgyad kyi grogs da bcas te sbyor sgrol gyi las sna tshogs mdzad pa la gsol loḥ mchod doḥtsha ba'i rong na bzhugs tshe dmag gi rgyal mo bcu gnyis dang bcas te dgra yi grong khyer brlag par mdzad pa la gsol loḥ mchod doḥhor gyi yul na bzhugs tshe a phyi hor mo'i dmag tshogs dang bcas te rtags par dgra bo gsod pa'i las su chas pa la gsol lo mchod doX

zhing zhung gi yul na bzhugs tshe mu stegs bu mo sum stong gi grogs bcas te dgra bsad 'dre mor grags pa la gsol loḥ mchod doḥ li yul na bzhugs tshe lcam sring bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te gsang sngags kyi bstan la gshe ba thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad pa la gsol loḥ mchod do su shar gser gling na bzhugs tshe mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas te lta log ngan pa'i grong khyer 'jig par mdzad pa la gsol lo mchod do 'byung ba lnga yi dbyings na bzhugs tshe dus bzhi'i lha mo mu med pa dang bcas te dgra bo'i 'byung khams rang gnas su bsdu bar mdzad pa la gsol loḥ mchod do mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs grwal na bzhugs tshe skal ldan pho mo'i tshogs thams cad lam sna dang sun mar mdzad pa'i ḍāk+ki ma la gsol loX mchod doḥ yang cig nyid kyi phyag brnyan rgya mtsho chu la dbang bsgyur ba'i sha za chu srin gdong can la gsol lo mchod do ༷ ri rab kyi zom la brten cing skye 'gro'i sha khrag la spyod pa'i dred gdong chen mo la gsol loḥ mchod do gzhan yang dmag gi rgyal mo bzhi dngaX than 'byed cho 'phrul ltas ngan

da'adi: 'gyed pa'i sha za mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gsol loḥmachod doḥ sprul pa'i nyi ma'i zer ltar g.yo zhing yang sprul bsam yas thog ltar 'bebs pa la gsol loXmachod doḥhoḥyang yang gsol zhing mchod pa rgya chen po'i bskang lags naXdeng 'dir sngags 'chang dam ldan sgrub pa po rnams kyis lha dkon mchog gsum la blo phug gtadaḥmi tshe phyi ma la 'dun phug drilaḥzab gter chu bo bdun ldan gyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas nas sems can gyi phan bde sgrub pa laḥdam nyams pa'i dgra bo che ge mo 'di yis bsgrub tu ma ster bsaḥyid la brnag pa'i yul du than gyi char ba phob cigaḥmatshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor cigaḥnd kyi skyal ba rdob cigaḥmakhon nas nang dme slong zhigaḥ'aphrul nas 'gags sri thongs shigaḥkha g.yas su gcus shig mig ltag par 'then cigaḥnyes pa dran du chug cigaḥdran nas smra ru chug cigaḥ rang sha la za ru chug cigaḥ rang sgog la brnyab tu chug cigaḥ'o dod gnam la 'bod du chug cigaḥlag pa gnyis brang brdung du chug cig shi 'phro zad med du ston cig phung thal yo log tu

thongs shig ro thog la bya mi 'bab par gyis shigaḥ shi shul du mi mi 'khor bar gyis shigaḥ bsad na rtags thon par gyis shig mthar gyi 'chi ba ni sems can kun la yod pas lo zlar ma 'khyangs bar myur du sod cigaḥ mi bdag la lha med zer baḥ lha khyod la mthu med bsnyams nasaX mthu bu lon bzhin du bsnyegs pa gtad rta pho bzhin du nyo bas dgra bo che ge mo' snying khrag dmar po stob kyi drongs shigaḥ tsit+ta la hab zas kyis shig myur ba nyid du drag po mngon spyod kyi las rab 'byams yongs su grub par mdzod cig de ltar rgyugs mchod phud gtor rnams bsangs nang phul nas dmod pa bor des na dgra dpung rdul brlag 'byur mngon spyod lhun gyis grub par 'gyuraḥ sa ma māḥ ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma he ru ga'i thugs bcud man ngag zab pa'i bskor pad+ma rak+ta bde chen klong dbang mdzod sgrom rgyar rgyas btab pa dus su thugs sras dpa' bo yis bstan pa'i dpal du gsal bar shog sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya bdo thamaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin kun bzang nas bkra shis lha reg gos dar bzang po'i skyes bcas bskul ngor/ 7 kho bo bdud 'joms khyu drag rtsal gyis spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam̐/

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ gter bdag dang srung ma'i gsol mchod dgra bgegs rdul rlog bzhugs soX bsnyerdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ka ni ya /gzung )ka sha khrag gtor ma da chang skyems bshams la dgra bgegs 'gugs bstims bya dbyings las mtshon char spros nas mthar zag med bdud rtsir sbyangs brgyur spel rang nyad drag mo' nga rgyal dang ldan pa 'i nga nas 'di skad doḥ bh+yoḥ chags bral bde chen dbang gi gzhal yas nasaḥ lha klu dri za 'byung po mu med pa'iḥ tshogs kyi dbang phyug 'dod rgyal glang po'i gdong chags pa'i zil 'khrigs dbang gi 'od khyims g.yoḥ khros pa'i nga ro char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i skuḥ dbang drag ma nges gar bsgyur chen po niḥ zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas 'od 'bar 1 ཿ pakru ma tram̐ bsnol ba'i khri steng nasaḥ nyi ma'i 'od zer 'byugs bzhin gnas 'dir byonaḥ dga' bde'i dgyes sprin 'dod yon rgya mtshos mchod mnga' gsol dbu 'phang chos kyi dbyings su bstodaX zab gter snying po'i thog mtha' bar gsum duḥ bskyed rdzogs sgom sgrub gegs med mthar phyin mdzodaḥ ma chen kun gyi

dbang phyug bdud 'dul ma'iX bka' rtags dpral ba'i me tog tshom bu'i dbusaḥ 'od ldan rdo rjer ngom pa'i grogs gcig maX sha za chen mo mi snying rlon 'phrog maḥ phyag brnyen chu srin gdong dang dred gdong ma sha za ro langs srin mo gyad chen sogasaḥ ma thogs sngon nas dam tshig gcig pa bzhin brtse bas zhal bzang mtshungs bral rin chen noraḥgazigs bzhin stsal ba'i dpa' skyems gtang rag tuX yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo'i dbang lnga dang rnal 'byor yid la mdza' ba'i zas dang noraḥ bdog pa ci mchis ma chen rnams la 'bulaḥ brtse bas srung skyob mel rtse mi g.yel b.raḥ dam chos thugs gter 'dzin srung dar rgyas mdzodaḥ sgo 'di gcod 'dod nag phyogs bdud kyi sdeX smang phob zil gnon pha mtha' ring par bskrodaḥ chos mdzad bla ma yab sras brgyud par bcasaḥ ngan sngags 'bum gyi 'khor lo bskor ba las rtag tu srung skyob byad mar rang gshed phob srid na ya mtshan che ba'i grags pa sgrogs gter gyi zab mdzod sgrom rgya'i dbus tshud pa'iḥ yang snying 'dus pa'i 'khor lo zhes grags te dam pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan la bsngags

—8rdo: pa'i brin las ma g.yel ma chen dam tshig canaḥ sgo 'di'i gdul bya las can rig 'dzin ni 'bum phrag bsam yas skyel bsu 'tsho skyongs bzhinaX bde chen mkha' spyod gnas su byang chub mdzodaX bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yuḥ gtor skyems mchod la phrin las bcol srung ma lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nyer 'tshe'i phyogs kun zha bar ngesaḥ phanabade'i legs tshogs 'byor bar 'gyuraḥ sa ma wāḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyiḥ zhes chos bdag rigs can du mas bskul ngor/kho bo bdud 'joms nam mkha'i rjes rtsub 'khrugs kyi nyams snang du ma zhi phyir sogs dag par smras te gsal byed dam pa dharma dha dzas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam̐/

btsasdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las dam can lha lnga'i gsol mchod me rlung 'tshubs ma bzhugs soḥ———: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni ya zlas skyo rdoni mkha' 'gro sgrub pa' rnal 'byor bas phrin las thogs med 'grub pa'i phyir rin chen snod du dkar gtor lngaḥ bshams la 'gugs bstim sbyangs bsgyur spel rang nyid drag mo'i nga rgyal da ldan pa 'i ngang nas 'di skad do kyeX phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi naḥ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi naḥ 'o yug ljon shing brag skyibs nasaḥ zangs lcags 'dres pa'i sku mkhar slong mon pa pho mo bgos pas srasaḥ skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa niḥ dmar smug dge bsnyen khros pa'i skuḥ rdo rje dgra snying phyag char 'dzin sku la dar dmar ber chen gsolaX dbu la sag zhu dam rtags bcingaX chibs su me bya rlung gshog bcibs rdzu 'phrul sprul pa rtobs dang ldanaḥ skad cig yud tsam 'dir byon la sha khrag dmar gtor skyems phud bzhesaḥ sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig kyeḥ dam can skyes bu chen po yiḥ mdun gyi phyag brten bka' sdod pa bdud po zu ra ra skyes niḥ mun pa'i gos can khro zhing

gtum phyag g.yas dgra stu ngar ma phyar0 g.yon pas bdud zhags nag po bsdomasaX mi lpags go bgos stag sham klubs me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong bdud dmag 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir byon la sha khrag gtor ma skyems phud bzhesaḥ dgra la than gyi char ba phobaḥ mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ—3 dam can skyes bu chen po yiX g.yas kyi phyag brnyen bka' sdod pa dmag dpon the'u stong sde ni sku mdog thal skya 'jigs gzugs can chibs su ra skyes mdzang dmar bcibasaḥ dgra snying 'byin pa'i lcags kyu g.yasaX dgra khrag skem pa'i klad khrag g.yon sku la skyin dkar thul ba gsolaḥ lcags kyi ral ba gnam du gzengasaḥ skra gseb thog dang skar mda' 'bebs the'u rang 'bum gyi mkhor dang bcasaḥ rlung las mgyogs par 'dir byon la sha khrag gtor skyems mchod pa bzhesaḥ dgra la nang dme shi chad thong mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod kyi dam can skyes bu chen po yiḥ rgyab kyi phyag bsnyen bka' sdod pa btsan dmar stong gi gtso bo niḥ dmar nag me yi 'od zer 'baraḥ

gtsasdo: zangs rmog zangs khrab rgyan du klubasaḥdabang gi dar ber dmar po mdzesaḥstag ral g.yas la gzig shub g.yonaḥbatsan rta me g.ye ga chibs su bcibs phyag g.yas dgra gsod mdung dmar phyaraX g.yon pas btsan zhags dmar po bsdams me rlung thog ser 'khrigs pa'i dbusaXbatsan dmag 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcasaXskadacig yud tsam 'dir byon laḥsha sna gtor ma khrag skyems bzhesaḥdagra bo thur thum rgyug 'gyes sodaḥmangon spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥkyiḥdam can skyes bu chen po yi g.yon gyi phyag brten bka' sdod paḥmon pa nag po sgra 'then niX khro gtum srin po 'khros 'dra'i skuḥphyag g.yas lcags kyi spar shad 'dzinaḥgayon pas nad kyi skyal babasdams sku la ber nag rnam par klubasaḥdur phag nag po ro zan bcibasaḥnyi ma'i zhags dang glog gi zhagasaḥgayas g.yon gru mo la brten zhingaḥgang la dmigs pa de'aching byedaḥdug rlangs nad sprin 'khrigs klong nas mon pa pho mo 'bum dang bcas skad cig tsam gyis 'dir byon laḥdagra sha khrag skyems gtor ma bzhesaḥyid brnag pho mo

rdul du rlog mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ kyi dam can lha lnga mthu rtsal canaḥ sngon tshe pad+ma he ru ga'iḥ spyan sngar khas blangs dam mnos bzhin mdo sngags bstan pa rin chen srungs0 zab gter sgrub pa'i grogs po mdzodaX mtha' yi dmag dang bstan pa'i dgra: mngon spyod drag pos tshar chod cig: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa yiḥ bstan pa yar ngos zla ltar spelaX bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe bsrengasaḥ bshad sgrub phyogs bcu'i pha mthar spelaḥ 'phrul gyi ngan sngags gtong mkhan rnamasaḥ 'phrul mi rdzas sngags nus mthu bcas rtsa phung skam la me mched bzhin rjes shul med par brlag mdzod cigaḥ bdag gis 'di phyi'i bcol las kun thogs pa med par grub pa'i las0 dam can lha lnga (1da kyis ma:rdodaḥ ma bul ma 'gyangs sa ma yāḥ zhes brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs phrin las ga bcol thogs med 'grub sa ma yuḥye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma' thugs bcud skor dbang chen zla gam e klong nas dus su ma chen ḍak+kis sprad sngon smon dag pas gsang rgya grol mi srun sha za gcag gas sgol 'khru zhing 'khrugs pas cho 'phrul ston mkha' 'gro bskang ba'i thabs kyi 'grol yon tan yar ngos zla ltar 'phel

—8rdo: sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'angalung zen kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang phrin las mthar phyin rdo rje zung gi bskul ngor/kho bo bdud 'jams nam mkha' rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'igs mdzod las zhal bshus te dag ra phab pa'iya gepa nilung zin pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam̐/badz+ra: gtor skyems bshams la 'di skad do kyeḥ dgebasnyen chen po dam can rdo rje legs mu bdud the'u btsan sprul pa 'bum 'bum bcasaX 'dir byon dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor skyems bzhesaḥ zab gter dpal srungs byad phur rbod gtong zlogaḥ dgra dang bgegs la bka' yi chad pas chod ༷ mngon spyod phrin las grub mdzod dam tshig canaḥ zhesagrangs bsog go rnal 'byorakun bzang mthar phyen ngor/nusaldan pas smrasapad los bras/ maṅga lo/

badz+ra cha dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasasakha' 'gro 'bum gyi bskul ba thogs med rdo rje'i mda' rnon bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki na yaX cu144 sha khrag dmar gyi gtor chen bshams dgra bgegs 'gugs bstam nan du byaḥsha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor dmi gsaḥ gdung shugs dad mos tshad med pas rol jo snyan pa 'i dbya sa bcas te hūṃ sgi yul gyi ming ni rang bzhin o rgyan yulaḥ gnas gyi ming ni mkha' spyod gsang chen gnas: rtsub 'gyur 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po na: ri bo ging rus rtsi shing mtshon cha'i tshalaḥ chu 'beb rak+ta sgra skad pāṭa dang pho ཿ rdo rje can yang shin tu 'jigs pa'i saX ging dang la sa bro gar bsgyur bar byedaḥ dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbusaḥ thabs shes nyi zla rtog med ro gdan kharaḥ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso mo seng ge'i gdong sku mdog nag mo mun pa'i gos can laḥ nga bdag gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod mkha' 'gro 'bumaX ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khyal ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX span gnyis g.yas g.yon hrig ger gzigs pa yasaḥ

pho rgyud mo rgyud dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stongagator ma 'ad bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod dbus kyi spyan zlum nam mkhar gzigs pa las dregs pa zel gnon mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag 'gyed ro mnyam bde stongagator ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ shangs nas drag po'i hūṃ glu sgrogs pa lasaḥ sgra tshig rang grol ston pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stongagator ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ mnyam nyid zhal gyi hom khung 'bar ba lasaḥ dngos mtshan thal 'byin byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaX ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes la 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX tshad med mche ba gangs ltar gtsigs pa las rū tra'i sha khrag srog 'dren mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ ljags dmar glog 'khyugs lta bu'i 'od zer gyisaḥ mnyam nyid ro gcig don ston mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong 'khrul ba g.yu ral nam mkha'idabyings su

/'di: gzengs pa yisaḥ sprul pa rdul ltar 'gyed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka na sgra gseb seng chung skar ltar bkra ba yisaX legs nyes shan drang 'byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laX 'khrul mdzodaḥ thod rgyan rdo rje rtse lnga'i byas pa lasaḥ 'pho med rdo rje'i srog ldan mkha' 'gro 'bum ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ngamadzodaḥ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan cod pan bcing pa lasaḥ sku lnga ye shes lnga ldan mkha' 'gro 'bum0 ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes la 'a( las mdzod snyan cha nyi ma zla ba las byas pas gsal stong zung 'jug ston pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥphrin las mdzodaḥphyag g.yas nyon mongs rgyun gcod gri gug phyar snang ba dbang du sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaX ro mnyam 'khrul ba g.yon pas

grag bsnams0 shes rab stong pa'i rgyas 'debs mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX bde chen gsang banu pad rgyas pa lasaḥ chags bral bde stong dpal sbyin mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur bam gdan 'khyangs ba yis 'khrul grol shan drang 'byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laX 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod sku rgyan rus pa'i rgyan drug spras pa lasaX pha rol phyin drug don ston mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laX 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX zhe sdang rang grolagazig sham mnab pa las sdang sems bdud sde 'dul ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong 'khrul ba 'dod chags rnam dag mi skrags sked chings las zhen 'dzin dam sri bcom pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes la 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod nga rgyal

—8rdo: gzhir grol glaja gos klubs pa lasaḥ khengs sems gdon chen sgrol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaX ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nasadag pa'i brin las mdzodaḥgatai mug mun sel sbrul gyi do shal lasaḥ a 'thas gdon phran dbyings sbyor mkha' 'gro 'bum ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laX 'khrulab ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod khrag mdzag mi mgo brgyad cu'i phreng ba lasaX kun rtog dbu mar bsre ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaX ro mnyam 'khrul ba phrag dge rtsad gcod rlung gshog g.yo ba lasaḥ mtshan ma'i g.yang sa gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laX 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥgamaja ska ren chen dril chung mdzes pa lasaḥ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid ston pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bumaX ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin lasamadzodaḥrdo dzomirlung 'od zer spro bsdu lasaḥ khams gsum 'khrul ba dbyings sgrol mkha' 'gro 'bumaX ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ zhabrul ba ka nas dag pa'i

phrin las mdzod thabs mchog mtshon phyir kha ṭ+wāṃ brten pa lasaḥ dbang phyug 'khrul ba ru zlog pho nya 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laX 'khrul ba ka nas dgapa'i phrin las mdzod nyid kyi thugs rje zhi ba'i rnam 'gyur lasaḥ rdo rje seng gdong las mdzad dkar mo 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nasadag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX rnam rol shin tu rgyas pa'i gzi mdangs lasaḥ rin chen seng gdong bka' nyan mkha' 'gro 'bum: ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes la 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ mdzad tshul chags pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba lasaX pad+ma seng gdong dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum ro mnyam bde stong gtor ma 'dibazhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod nga ro khro gtum drag po'i gad rgyang lasaX garma seng gdong bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro 'bumaḥro mnyam bdestonge gtor ma'adi bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod lhun grub sgo brgyad gzigs tshul thabs mkhas pasaX sde brgyad mkha' 'gro rang rang las byed 'bum ro mnyam

badz+ra: bde stong gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥ rlung sems taing 'jin rnal 'byor dpal bskyed pasaḥ nyid kyi rnam rol dbang phyug 'khor g.yog 'bumaḥ ro mnyam bde stob gtor ma 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod dug gsum gdon la za ba'i 'jigs rngams can gtso mo'i bka' yi las byed sha za gsumaḥ ro mnyam bde sto gtor ma 'di bzhes la 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i brin las mdzodaḥ hūṃḥ ma cig mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong pa can drag tu bskul lo ma g.yel da tshur byon 'dod lnga rang grol dpal gtor 'di bzhes laḥ 'khrul ba bdag gir 'dzan pa'i rū tra sgrolaX bdag med mnyam pa'i dgongs rgyudabu la sporaḥ nyon mongs ma rig 'khor ba ka dag steḥ grol gzhi'i klong du thams cad rgyas thob cigaḥ mkha' 'gro ma mo ma g.yel mthu ma chu ཿ bdag gis rtse gcig sgrub pa chud ma gsanaḥ dgra dang bgegs la bka' chad rtsal ma zhanaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las lhun grub mdzodaḥ bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāX gtor skyems gshan phyogs mchod cing

brdabasaḥ dmod bor skra bsigs thal mo rdebaḥ dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jigs shin tu zab po rdo rje' bka'aḥ sa ma yāḥ ye ma dbang chen gsang ba gsung gi gnas pad+ma rak+ta bde klong da 'brel ba'i 'dod rgyal bla mtsho nas dus bab mkha' 'gro'i brda bstan tshe sngon smon dag pas gsang rgya grol sred len bral ba' dgongs ba da rdol rtog ger 'dzer kyang bdag blo bde skal ba can rnams 'dir spyod cigaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang chosabadag kun bzang dang mthar phyin zung gis bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du ma dang bcas te bskul ba dang nye char grog gisanan bskul ngor/ kho bobadud 'jom nam mkha'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brna mdzod las gsal bar byed pa'i ma ge pa ni chos nyad rang grol gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo la/

ga6/8: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ mkha' 'gro'i dmod sbyor bsgral las mtshon cha'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ka ni yaḥ 11sna1/ཿ ma 'ongasasnyigasam dmu rgod dus sems can las ngan sdug la spyod mi dge kho nar g.yer zhing 'da' dam tshag sdom pa than du brtsa zhing bcu nges par tshang ba rnams mngon spyod drag po sa ma bsgral na bstan pa 'i che ba nyams pa dang rgyu 'bras bslu med mi 'thad pa sa de phyir de la nan tan mdzod sa ma yu gser skyems 'bul ba ni re ye dzaḥ gser skyems gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyuraḥ ma āḥ(ཿ kyiX gson cig dgongs shig dkon mchog rin po che lung rtogs dam chos 'phags tshogs dge 'dun sde rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnamasaX gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod grub par mdzodaḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo seng ge'i gdongaḥ drag mo rigs bzhi rdo rje phra men brgyad dbang byug nyer brgyad phrin las bzhi sgrub pasaX gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod brin las stsolaḥ dur khrod sha za ma chen rnams gsum dang dbang byug chen po 'dod rgyal

glang po' gdongaḥ dgra bgegs brlag mdzad dam can lha lnga yisaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod phrin las sgrubasaḥyul gzhi'i bdag po dkar nag gnyis skyong ba dregs pa pho mo ma ning rigs gtogs dngaḥ rnal 'byor bdag la 'go ba'i lha srung gisaḥ gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod brin las sgrubasaḥ sangs rgyas bstan dgra dkon mchog spya yi bdudaX rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe ba'i dam sri rnamasaX ri bo'i rtse dang rgya mtsho'i gting la sogasaX gang na gnas kyang rang dbang med par khugaḥ thal ba rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzodaX ma khyen gzu ni gser skyems gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyuraXsnyen āḥ/ ha ho ༷ kyi rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma gzu dang dpangaḥ yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho gzu dang dpang 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro gzu dang dpang ma nyes drang por gnas pa bdag la dgongs las su lha sgrub mgon du dkon mchog brten grogs su mkha' 'gro chos skyong gsol na yangaḥ dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di yis ma ster roX 'jig rten blos dor phyi ma dang du blangasaX dge bcu'i

—— snye: khrims srung mi dge sdig pa bor0 yang dag bskyed rdzogs zab mor brtson na'ang nyes byed 'di yis legs sgrub ma ster roḥ nyi ltar gsal kyang sprin ltar 'tshubs te 'byungaḥ ri ltar brjid kyang chu ltar shwa 'ud rdol gangs ltar dkar kyang rdza ltar 'khrugs byung ba'iḥ 'de la kun mkhyen mgon po'i dpang po mdzod nges pa'i don brtson 'bras bu chud ma gsanaX ma dang mkha' 'gro med dam ra mdar bzlogaḥ legs nyes shan phyes dgra la chad pas chodaḥ sngon gyi thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāḥ zhes gtoraskyem sa mchod che bskyed ni bye hūṃ bye nga ni bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdo ཿ sku la gnas yul he ru'i dpa' bo dngaḥ ma sring mkha' 'gro til gong phyur bzhin rdzogasaḥ snang ba mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa'i gnasaḥ srid pa rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dalaḥ brda skad pāṭaḥphe sgrogs pas sa gsum g.yoḥ 'jigs byed mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'jubs las byed sgrol ging mang po glog ltar 'khyugasaḥ shin tu rngam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por sharaḥ log 'dren 'byung po gang gis glags mi rnyedaḥ hū hūṃ hūX 'jig rten srid

pa'i che btsan can rnams kunaX ma chen nga yi dbang du ma gyur med kun kyang grogs mdzod sdang ba'i dgra la rbadaḥ ming tsam med pa'i drag rtsal khyad chos stonaḥ sa hūṃ saX pāṭa pāṭa pāṭaḥ phur bskul ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ mi mngon chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nasaḥ mngon spyod stobs rdzogs bdud 'dul seṅge'i gdongaḥ drag rtsal rngam pa'i mngon spyod las la bzhengasaX sku stod thub pa nag po khro tshul can phyag na srid pa mthar byed las phur 'drilaḥ dbal phur 'bar bas dug gsum 'byung po 'dar sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i las la drag tu rngams: nyes byed bdud sde yongs kyi sgog snying 'byinaḥ drag rtsal srid na mtshungs bral bdud 'dul maḥ dbyings nas skur bzhengs srid pa'i phur bu bskulaḥ sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i las la ma g.yel cigaḥ sha khrag tshogs su bsgyur cig ki la ya rnam shes rten dang phrol zhig gī la ya sa rbaḥsedha shāk+ki ni badz+ra ki la ya mā ra ya pāṭaḥ gnas spar niḥ.e maḥ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyamos pa'i sems can rnamasaḥ yang dag gnas lugs ma rtog snying re rje bdag gi snying rjes bsgal ba'i dam tshig gisaX mnar bcom gsad

—8rdo: gcod gzir ba ma yin teḥ phung po 'gyur med rdo rjer gtam byas nasaḥ rnam shes rta phag yab yum dgongs par bsreḥ āḥ gho dhi tsit+ta spa ra ṇa pāṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa (ཿ zhes bde sto rta phag yab yum gya dgo sa nyams su bsre'o gtso brdung niḥ hūṃ hūṃḥ chos nyid 'gyur med rdo rje phag mo'i mkha'aḥ chos can rig pa dbang gi gtun bu yisaḥ nga bdag dū tra'i phu khams phye mar brdungaḥ sha khrag dmar nyog bde stong bdud rtsir bsgyuraḥ sa badz+ra a ko ṭa ya ta tha ya ta tha ya phye ma phye ma tshal bar rbadaḥ bh+yo gdab ni bh+yoḥ ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byad stong khams dmod zor dam nyams dgra la bh+yoḥ lha 'dre yo log 'byung bzhi'i byad gtad kunaḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams 'di la bh+yoḥ than rigs sna tshogs 'chi ltas byung ba sogasaX mi 'dod phyogs kun dam nyams 'di la bh+yoḥ bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra rnams dum bur gtubasaḥ bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs thal bar rlogaX bh+yo bh+yo mi 'dod phyogs kun bzlogs bskyar cigaḥ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlog bzlogaḥ gtor ma zor bsgyur niḥ hūṃ dza bh+yoḥ ma chen lha tshogs gzu dang dpang por bzhugasaḥ leg nyes shan phye sdang

ba'i dgra la chosaḥ gtor ma las kyi mtshon cha bsgyur byas teḥ mda' mdung mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshubasaḥ yungs dkar mtshe thun rbab rdo thog ltar 'bebasaḥ rdo rje phur pa khrag thun char ltar 'bebasaḥ las kyi pho nya mang pos ku bso sgrogasaḥ gsod byed shan pa'i tshogs kyis lag cha brdaraḥ kun kyang sdang ba'i dgra la dmags su chosaḥ dmag sna dug gsum rtsad gcod sha zas drongs gsod gcod shan pa dam can lha lnga'i mdzod rdul brlag nus mthu 'dod rgyal nag po'i bskyed0 bsgral 'dren dgongs pa ma dang mkha' 'a17sa mdzodaX dgra la bab na dpa' rtsal stobs ma zhanaX bgegs la bab na za rngam yus ma chung sri la bab na phung brlag mthu ma sdug drag rtsal srid na ya mtshan bsngags gyur pasaḥ mngon spyod phrin las rgya mtsho grub par mdzodaḥ ḍak+ki ni sed+ngha mu kha (ཿ sarba duṣ+ṭi ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bha3 skṛsto e dza bh+yo hūṃ pāṭaX dmod pa bor bam gtor zor rdebs dgra dpung thal ba rdul brlag 'gyur bgegs dpung ming gi lhag ma ra byed nus mthu yon tan bsam mtha' yas sa ma yu ye maḥdrag sngags rno ba' mtshon cha 'di dbang phyug 'dod rgyal bla mtsho nas dus bab sha za'i brdas bskul

—6sno: tsha nam mkha' rnal 'byor he ru na'i smon lam 'bras bzang gdul byar smin sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyiḥzhes pa 'di' lung zen kun bzang dang mthar phyin zung gis bskul ba dang /nyer char rasgo'i ming gis nan bskul ngor/kho bo bdud 'jomasanam mkha'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa 'iyi ge pa rna chos nyid rang grol gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅka lam̐/

bsnyerdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ bsgral las spu gri ka ma la zhes bya bzhugs soX —8rdo: na mo tswa na ḍak+ki ni ya 0na4)(ze ma rtog a 'a sa 'byul ba'i gdon thabs dang thugs rjes ma btul na ngan song 'khor ba gting ring ste rnam mkhyen 'bras bu g.yel zhing 'khyangs sa ma yuḥsnying rje chen po'i gdengs ldan pas zhi la khros pa 'i rnam 'gyur bskyed mkha' 'gro 'bum bskul nus mthu brdalaḥ de nas brub khu ling bskyed ni skad cig gas mdun du e nag po yongs su gyur pa lasaḥ brub khung nag po kha dog la mthil yangs pa sra brtan lci zhing 'thas pa bros thar gab yul dang bral ba phyi na zhe sdang gi rang bzhin me 'bar baX bar na phrag dog gi rang gshed rlung nag 'tshubs paḥ nang na 'dod chags 'thas pa'i khrag mtsho khol baX phyi nang kun tu gti mug gi rang bzhin mun nag 'thibs paḥ bar bar na nga rgyal rgyas pa'i brag ri snyil zhing mtshon cha gzengs paḥ rtag tu 'jigs pa'i sgra sod sod dang tshod chod zhes sgrogs paX steng bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba bkram zhing mtshams bla 'dzin gyi sha zung dgug paḥ sha zan gyi lce

spyang 'ur zhing dgra gsod pa'i spu gri 'tshubs pa de yi dbus suḥgroḥdang tri yongs su gyur pa lasaḥ thar lam gcod pa'i dgraḥ tshe srog rku ba'i bgegs rnams kyi ru pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa skya ba reng pa nyam pa sgog ma chad cam 'dar phri li li byed bzhin rkang lag lcags gzer gyis theb bzhinaḥ bu ga dgu nas snag khrag 'dzag pa shin tu nyam thag pa snying rje skye ba'i gnas su bsam moḥ de'i snying gar dṛḥdang triḥgasal ba las 'od 'phros pas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkugs nas ru pa la yang yang bstam moḥ bdag mdun gnyis kyi sku las khro mo bdud 'dul khrag 'thuja nag mor gsal ba'i gnas lnga nas pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas srid pa gsum na gnas pa'iḥ dgra bgegs dam sri 'byung po thams cad rang dbang med par bkug ste gzugs rten la yang yang bstims 'gugs pa ni na moḥ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dngaḥ yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dngaḥ gnas gsum ma

bas: rgyud mkha' 'gra'i bka' bden pa dngaḥrdo rje skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dngaḥkhyad par du bdud 'dul nag mo seng ge'i gdong pa can gyi bka' bden pa da ཿma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' don dam chos nyid ngo bo ka nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa chen po de dag gi mthus sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom par byed pa'i 'byung po gzugs can gyi dgraḥgazugs med pa'i bgegasaḥtshe len gyi bdud bar chad kyi rkyen byad ma rbod gtong lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad pho nya lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zungasaḥzhags pa can gyis mgul nas chings lcags sgog can gyis dbang po sdom dril bu can gyis myos su chugaḥmatshon cha can gyis rjes nas dedaḥlas kyi rlung gis zhabs nas gtegs teḥskad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cigaḥbastems shigaX dza2) be hoXgasum mam lnga bdun dgu sogs ga skabs brjod de nas 'gugs pa niḥhūṃ dzaḥdam

tshig thugs dam chen po'i dus la babaḥ 'jigs byed khro mo bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma'iX sku las spros pa'i lcags kyu ma tshogs kyisaḥ dgra bgegs snying nas zung la rten la bstimaḥ :ཿtriḥbadz+ra e ku sha ya dza dza bcing ba'i las niḥ dza: dam tshig thugs dam chen po'i 'jigs byed khro mo bdud 'dul gsung las sprul pa'i zhags pa ma tshogs kyisaḥdagra bgegs dbang po sgo lnga 'ching rgyas thobaX groḥtriḥmā ra ya chings ching thum ri li li pa sha hūṃ sdom pa'i las niḥ dzaḥ dam tshig thugs dam 'jigs byed khro mo thugs las sprul pa'i lcags sgrog ma tshog kyisaX dgra bgegs yan lag sdom la spyo ru chugaḥ dgra bgegs dz+wa la pa ya baṃ baṃḥthum ri li li rbad drag tu sdoms shig spo ṭa bam0 myos pa'i las naḥdza dam tshig thugs dam 'jigs byed khro mo yon tan las sprul dril bu ma tshogs kyis dgra bgegs dran pa nyams nas myos su chug dgra bgegs mā ra ya skyugs shig sgo gsum spyo 'bog su chug cigaḥ dran pa nyams par gyis shig gharnye hoḥ dbye ba' las niḥ dzaḥ dam tshig thugs dam 'jigs byed khro mo phrin las las byed kha kha hu lu mas

—8rdo: dgra bgegs skyob byed lha srung kun dang phrolaḥ adṛX trag rak+ka mā ra ya phye phyeḥ ma ma shig rū dra mā ra ya phye phyeḥ badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ bsgral las ni bdag nyid khro mo bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma'i phyag gis phur pa mgar gya so mal nas phyung ba lta bu'i dmar zeng nge ba de nyid dgra bgegs kyi spyi bor btab pas klad pa dkrug par bsam mgrin par btab pas ngag gi 'ching rgya gtor bar bsamaḥ snying gar btabs pas yid rnam shes kyi rten dang bral bar bsamaḥ gsang bar btab pas 'khor ba'i skye rgyun bcad par bsamaḥ rkang mthil du btab pas gnas ngan rigs drug gi sa bon stong par bsam mo spu gri thogs la hūṃ / las ngan 'khor ba'i bag chags rgyun gcod phyiraḥ shes rab rang mdangs mtshon chen rnon po yis dgra bgegs phubhe khams dum bur gtubs byas teḥ ye shes tshogs su byin gyis brlabs par byaḥ badz+ra khaṅga dz+wa la rū tra pra we sha ya phaṭa dmar spring niḥ (ཿ lcang lor bcas pa'i bhasto yangs pa na nyon mongs rgyun bcad rten 'brel khrag chen bskyil ma dang mkha' 'gro'i thus/sa dam bskang phyir 'bulaḥ khams gsum

'khor ba ka nas dag par mdzod mahā rak+tasha ram̐ khā hiḥ bstab pa niḥ hū bh+yoḥ ma rig gsum gyibag chags las bskyed pa'iḥ phung po dbang yul khams chen bco brgyad dang yan lag bzhi dang rtsa rgyus rus pa rkang ma chen bdud 'dul khrag 'thung nag mor bstabasaX mahā me sarak+ta tsit+ta ko ni ri ti la khāhi bzlog pa na rdo chos nyid gdod nasaka dag kun bzang moX ma rtog kun gzhi'i bag chags 'thas pa bzlogaḥ rang bzhin 'od gsal ma 'gags wa ra hiḥ ma rtog rnam shes rang mtshan bltas pa bzlogaX so so rang rigaye shes khros ma'i zhalaḥ ma rtog bdag 'dzin sems su 'thas pa bzlogaḥ dri bral me lo rdo rje seng gdong dang0 ma rtog zhe sdang rang mtshan bzung ba bzlog0 chos kun mnyam nyidarin chen mkha' 'gro'i klongaX ma rtog nga rgyal mtshan mar bzung ba bzlogaḥ chags bral bde stong sor rtogs pad+ma'i rigs ma rtog 'dod cing chags pas 'ching ba bzlog ye nas dag grol garma seng gdong zhalaḥ ma rtog log pa'i phrag dog rtog pa bzlog lhun grub sgo brgyad sde brgyad mkha' 'gro'i gsang ma rtog tshogs yul mtshan mar bzung ba bzlogaḥ
