btsasdo: tshad med rang bzhin ye shes phyag rgya bzhi ༷ ma rtog rtag chad mu bzhir gol ba bzlog dug gsum rang grol dam tshig mkha' 'gro gsumaḥ ma rtog gsod gcod rang gar 'khrul ba bzlogaḥ sna tshogs snang ba thogs bcas bdud du bzungaḥ yul med zang thal stong pa nyid du bzlogaḥ bdag tu 'dzin pa thogs med bdud du 'thasaḥgazhi med rtsa bral chos kyi dbying su bzlogaX re dang dogs pa nyer len dga' bro'i bdudaḥ zang thal dri med ye shes klong du bzlogaX snyoms byed rtog pa sna tshogs lu gu rgyud gzhi rtsa dag pa'i ka dag dgongs klong bzlogaX skye ba'i snang ba lta ba'i klong du bzlog rga ba'i snang ba 'od gsal chen por bzlogaḥ na ba'i rgud pa rnam rgyal spyod par bzlog 'chi ba ka dag sku gsum klong du bzlogaX bzlog dang bzlog par bya ba gnyis 'dzin sems thams cad spros bral ma chen dgongs par bzhagaḥ 'khor 'das ro mnyam rtogs pa mngon gyur te0 rdo rje btsun 51'i gsang gsum 'ub chub thegagaX de ltar mngon spyod las byas pa sa dgra dpu pa lam yin kya 'jigs gdon rnam thal ba rdul du rlog rno nus lag tu longs da gsalaḥ sa ma māḥyemaḥ

rgyal ba kun gyi gsang mdzod 'di 'dod rgyal yab yum bla mtsho nas dus bab mkha' 'gros brda yi bskul sred len bral ba'i zab gsang dpal rin chen shog skyar pheb pa'oḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa'adi'ang drag sngags dbang phyug rnam gnyas dang / shes rab grogs kyis yang yang bskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'jomasanam mkha' rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos nyid rang grol rgyas bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel/ sarba ma le/

—8/de cha dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ mngon spyod drag po'i bsgral las spu gri reg gcod zhes bya bzhugs soḥ—8rdo na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ka mi ya rgyal ba kun yum bdud 'dul ma mi 'bral snying dbus pad+mor rol mkha' 'gro sgrub pa 'i rnal 'byer pa sa sgom bzlas bsnyen sgrub tshad 'khyol tsheḥ gzhan donadrag 'a sa byed 'dod na snyi rje gzhung lam dam pa ste rdzong 'phrang srog gi yon tan bskyed tshe khrus gnad spar gnas ldan pa'i mngon spyod gnad kyis grol ba thob sa ma yu thog ma ra sras phur bskyed pa mi bdag je lag pa g.yas pa 'i dal la sor mo rnams rigs kyi yab lngar bskyedaX g.yon pa nyi ma'i dal la sor mo rnams rigs kyi yum lngar bsgomaḥ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde stong byang chub sems kyi bskyed pa'i sras phur sku ste da thub pa nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis sgrol phur 'dril baX sku smad mgar gyi so mal nas byung ba lta bu lcags phur zur gsum dmar zang nge ba me yi tsha tshwa 'phro baḥ zur gnyis la pho nya mtshon cha thogs paḥ log la lce spyang sna tshogs bu yug ltar 'tshub par bskyed doḥ lha de'i gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa

bon las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros pasaḥ rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dbang byin dngos grub ma lus pa bsdus te sib sib bstim mo de nas bdag gso ba ni bdag nyid bdud 'dul drag mor gsal ba'i thugs srog beḥyig gsal ba las 'od zer 'phros 'khor 'das brtan g.yo thams cad srog baṃḥyi ges rnam par 'od du zhu ste bdag nyid bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku gsung thugs su thim pas spyi dpal las kyi khro mo rngam brjed ltar mi bzod pa'i dkyil 'dor du bzhengs par dmigs laḥ o baṃX badz+ra kro ti kā li sedha mu kha ma hā rwa dza hūṃ pāṭaḥ brgya rtsa brjod sras phur gso ba niḥ bdag nyid drag mo'i phyag gi phur pa las rang 'dra'i tsha tshwa nam mkha'i gar khyab tu 'phrosaḥ khams gsum sgod bcud thams cad la reg pas kun kyang lan tsha chu ru zhu ba bzhin du sras phur gyi sku gsung thugs dang 'dres pasaḥ phyar ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar yed yed byed cing btab pa tsam gyis stong gsum brlag par byed nus pa'i rang bzhin du gsal la sa gurgya dz+nyā na sed+ngha mu kha badz+ra ki

de'adi: li gī la ya hūṃ pāṭaḥ brgya rtsa brjod dgra gso ba ni skad cig gi zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra sde thams cad gnyid btsan thabs kyis skrog pa bzhin du liṅga la sib sib tu 'dus shing thim par dmigs laḥ du tra a mu ka sarba 'dus 'dus dzaḥ brgya rtsa brjod bla lung ni sras phur bdud 'dul drag mo'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba nyid dgra bgegs kyi snying gar btab pas bla'i ngo bo 2༷ dngatre+eyig dkar po'i rnam par drangs te sgrol phur la thim pas sras mchog gi sku ngang mer gyis song bar bsam mo tshe lung ni yang sras phur dgra bgegs kyi snying gar btab pas tshe bsod nams kyi ngo bodṛḥdangatre+eḥyig ljang gu'i rnam par drangs te khong gseng nas ma dag pa'i dri ma nyes skyon sbyangs gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo las byung stebadag steru ga'i sku gsung thugs su thim pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor bkrag mdangs yon tan thams cad rab tu rgyas par bsamaḥ khrus lung ni bdag nyid dang sras phur rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer mu tig lta bu bab ste gzas pa po'i lus ngag yid kyi nyon shes kyi dri ma thams cad sangs bar bsam mo gnas lung ni yang phur

pa dgra bgegs kyi snying gar gdab pas rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba khrag gi rkyal ba 'dra ba de mar la lcags sreg phob pa ltar dmar sob sob khol zhing skem par bsamaḥ yang gdab pas yid kyi rten thig le sngo skya bye'u leb ma'i mgo tsam gnas pa la reg pas na bun nam mkha' la thim pa ltar yal bar bsam ༷ yang btab pas rnam shes kyi rten nyi zla'i ga'u rgya sran gyi gong bu tsam pa la reg pas rnam shes āX dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam par 'ub kyis bsdus te khong seng nas nyon shes kyi dri ma sbyangasaḥ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo nas thonate 'og min na bzhugs pa'i rta phag yab yum gyi thugs gar phogaX bde ba chen po' sgras bskul te mkha' gsang nas sras he ru ga'i rnam par ldang bar bsam laX ā phuṭaḥ ā pāṭaḥ ā pāṭa: thun gdab niḥ snyigs ma'i phung khams la ye shes kyi rang gdangs mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab pas gzas pa po'i kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i dngos mtshan stong par bsamaḥ khrag thun thogs te hūṃ bh+yoḥ nga ni bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdongaX srid pa 'di na 'gran zla gzhan med pas ma rig rtsad gcod khrag thun rlabs ldan

—8rdo: bskulaḥ nga bdag 'byung po'i bdag lta'i rū trar phobaḥḍasko nihṝ kā la nag mo dun bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs kyi phung khams la rbad rbadaX mtshe thun thogs teḥ / bh+yo nga ni bdud 'dul mkha' srid pa 'di na 'gran zla gzhan med pas ma rig rtsad gcod mtshe yi thun zor 'diX nga bdag 'byung po'i bdag lta'i rū trar phobaḥḍāsko gidṛ kā la nag mo dun bh+yoḥ dgra bgegs kyi phung khams la rbad rbadaḥ dug thun thogs teḥ/ bh+yoḥ nga nibadud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdongaḥ srid pa 'di na 'gran zla ma rig rtsad gcod dug thun khol ba 'diX nga bdag 'byung po'i bdag lta'i ḍak+ko gihṝ kā la sogs rbad rbadaḥ yo thun thogs te hūṃ bh+yoḥ nga ne+e bdud 'dul ma rig rtsad gcod nyung thuna'ab ba 'di: nga bdag 'byung po'i ḍāk+ki ni shra sogs rbadaḥ mda' thun thogs te hūṃ bh+yoḥ nga nai bdud 'dul srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad gcod mda' yi thun zor 'di nga bdag ḍasko ni hṝ sogs rbad rdo thun thogs teḥhūṃ bh+yoḥ nga nibadud 'dul srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad gcod rdo yi thun zor 'diḥ bhe bdag ḍagli ni sogs rbad gtor

thun thogs te 〉 bh+yoḥ nga ni bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad gcod gtor thun rngam pa 'diḥ nga bdag ḍak+ki ni sogs rbad gri thun thogasateḥhūṃ bh+yo nga nibadud 'dul srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad gcod spu gri ngar ma 'diḥ nga bdag ḍak+ki ni sogs rbad rbad phur thun thogs teḥ/ bh+yoḥ nga ni bdud 'dul srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad gcod phur thun ngar ldan 'diX nga bdag ḍak+ki ni sogs rbad rbadaḥ sa thun thogs rteḥ/ bh+yoḥ nga ni bdud 'dul srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad gcod sa thun 'thas pa 'diḥ nga bdag ḍāk+ki ni sogs rbad chu thun thogs teḥ/ bh+yo nga ni bdud 'dul srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad gcod chu thun gsher ba 'diḥ nga bdag ḍak+ki ni sogs rbad me thun thogs teḥ hū bh+yoḥ nga ni bdud 'dul srid pa 'di na ma rig rtsad bas da me thun 'bar ba 'di nga bdag ḍak+ki ni bṛ sogs rbad rbad rlung thun thogs te hā spyoḥ nga ni bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdongaX srid pa 'di na 'gran zla gzhan med pas ma rig rtsad gcod rlang thun g.yo ba 'di nga bdag 'byung po'i bdag lta'i

bas: rū trar phobaḥ ḍāk+ki ni shrī kwa la nag mo dun bh+yo ༷ dgra bgegs kyi phung khams la rbad rbad ༷ bstab pa ni bdag nyid bdud 'dul drag mo'i sku sprul dkar mo grangs med pasaḥ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku mnyes pa'i las byed par bsamaḥ yang gsung sprul dmar mo grangs med pas lha tshogs rnams kyi gsung mnyes pa'i las byed par bsamaḥ yang thugs sprul lha mo mthing nag grangs med pasaḥ lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs kyi dgyes pa bskang ba'i las byed par bsam laḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ ma chen mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can ma'iḥ chos nyid mi 'gyur gsal ba'i zhal phyes laḥ log rtog rū tra'i phung khams dgyes par bzhesaḥ ma rig gzhi la sangs ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ hūṃḥ ma chen mkha' 'gro rdo rje seng gdong ma'iX chos nyid mi 'gyur gsal ba'i log rtog rū tra'i phung khams ma rig gzhi la sangs ba'i /༷ ma chen mkha' 'gro rin chen seng gdong ma'i chos nyid mi 'gyur log rtog rū tra'i ma rig gzhi la hūṃḥ ma chen mkha' 'gro pad+ma seng gdong ma'iX chos nyid mi 'gyur log rtog rū tra'i ma rig gzhi la hūṃX ma chen

mkha' 'gro garma seng gdong ma'iḥ chos nyid mi 'gyur log rtog rū tra) ma rig gzhi la sno ma chen mkha' 'gro dur khrod brgyad srung ma'iḥ chos nyid mi 'gyur log rtog marig gzhi la hūḥ ma chen mkha' 'gro zhi rgyas dbang drag ma'iḥ chos nyid mi 'gyur log rtog ma rig / ma chen mkha' 'gro sha za spun gsum gyi chos nyid mi 'gyur gsal ba'i zhal phyes la0 log rtog rū tra'i phung khams dgyes par bzhesaX ma rig gzhi la sangs ba'i brin las mdzodaḥ ḍāk+ki ni sedha mu kha kro ti kā li ha0 riḥniḥsaḥdz+nyā na ḍak+ki bhi sha ḍāk+ki sarba ḍāk+ki lo ka ḍak+ki sa pa ri wā ra mahā me sa khāhiḥ mahā rak+ta khāhiX mahā tsit+ta khāhiḥ mahā ko ro tsa na khānyiḥ mahā skru ni ri ti khānyiḥ mahā ba su ta khātīḥ mahā tsa khug khahi mahā lpags shā khahi mahā ghan khaṃ khāhiḥ zhes rdo rjes skyog gis la tshogs kun la bstabs po de ltar mngon spyod las byas pasaḥ dgra bgegasapha lam yin kyang 'jigs bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal mthu yis gragasapas sa steng khyabaḥ sa ma yuḥye ma dbang chen 'dod rgyal bla mtsho nas dus bab mkha' 'gro'i brda glus bskul snying las 'pha yang bstan 'gro'i phyir rin chen shog skyar pheb pa'oḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyi zhes

— sno: pa 'di' sngags skyes rnam gnyas kyas bskul ngor/kho bo bdud 'jomasanam mkha'i rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod dag pa ra phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos nyid rang grol gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba ma le/
badz+ra: dam tshos thugs gter 'dus pa las: mkha' 'gro seng ge gdong ma'i drag bzlog mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bzhugs so:

—8/snye: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ tsha sgoze rang bzhin rnam dag dbyings nyid las rol ba 'gags med ye shes sku bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal dadaldan sgrub la snying rus can mos gus bsod nams nor 'byor rnams gsang chen 'di la spyod pa'i tshe brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su longasaḥ sa ma māḥ gtor gzhong gzhi la ma dre bkod snying gar najiḥbris pa'i steng mkha' 'gro gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyas dpal gtor brjid ldan zur gsum pa rtsang mtshe dug khrag legs par byugs ke tshe shing tshe yungs dkar gzhugs me ri ru dar kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzug zhing lngags gzhi ma'i steng du bkod rtsang gi dra ba mig mang bkram byad thag sngo dmar chings kyis bcing gtor gdugs rtse brgyan khyung gis mdzes de nas ma tram̐ bskyed pa ni e ma tram̐ rū dra maṇ+ḍal sbyo 0 dur khrod rngam brjed 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas su ༷dṛX'am triḥlas gzung 'dzin rang mtshan du gol bas rū tra thams cad nyam thag pa'i gzugs can rkang lag lcags gzer gyis bsdam pa bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'jeg cing nyam thag dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar khril li li byed par gyur bden brjod ni na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal loḥ ma tshogs skya 'phrul mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag yangs

—'di: pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dngaḥ bden gnyis bskru ba med pa'i mthusaX zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs bzung 'dzin rang mtshan du gol ba'i rū dra thams cad khug cigaX dṛXtriḥ badz+ra e ku sha dzaḥ bdun nam nyer gcig brjodaḥ du dra pra wesha ya pāṭaḥ du tra'i khog pa kha 'byed pa'i snying dkar nag mtshams su khro mo bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma nag mo mun pa'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa smin ma me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro zhing khrag gi ral ba nam mkha'i dbyings su 'khyil zhing sgra gseb nas seng chung thog ltar 'bebs paḥ snyan cha nyi zla las byas shing seng zhal mdun thad g.yas g.yon du gzigs pas khams gsum gyis dregs pa can thams cad dbang du sdud paḥ dur khrod dpal chas dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gi mdzes pa'i dug lnga rang mtshan du 'dzin pas 'byung po dam la 'dogs shing rdul du rlog pa phyag g.yas bzlog pa'i khrag zor dang g.yon bhan dmar dku la brten paḥ zhabs gnyis gar stabs su bsgyur zhing ye shes kyi me dang bskal ba'i rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i 1nga du

ju ma brjed 'jigs su rung bas sku ru bskyed doḥ de yis shar du rdo rje bdud 'dul ma mthing nag bzlog pa'i khrag zor dang dug gi skyal ba 'dzin pa lho ru rat+na bdud 'dul ma 4thing nag bzlog pa'i khrag zor dang mtshe thun drag po 'dzin paX nub tu pad+ma bdud 'dul ma mthing nag bzlog pa'i khrag zor dang mtshon 'khor 'dzin pa byang du las kyi bdud sdasal ma mthing nag bzlog pa'i khrag zor dang nyung thun drag po 'dzin paḥ de rgyab phra men sde brgyad gtum rngam 'jigs su rung ba'i rnams 'gyur dang ldan pa'i phyag g.yas na guzlog pa'i khrag zor dang g.yon na dpal gyi gtor chen thogs pa kun kyang cha lugs gtso mo dang 'dra bar bskyed doḥ gzhan yang dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'bum phrag yangs /'i mkha' 'gro ma tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi phyag na bzlog pa'i mtshon cha dang thun rdzas sna tshogs pa thogs te dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du brlag pa'i nus mthu dang /na par gsal gdabaḥ thams cad kyi thugs sgog 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i bskul te 'og min mkha' spyod gsang chen rol ba nas bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs spyan

—8rdo: drangs la bstim moX sha za gyis gsur dud btang zhing gi g.yab mo da mad pa glu yi mtho nas 'di skad doḥ / nyi mkha' spyod gsang chen 'jigs su rung ba nas ma mo'abum phrag gtso mo bdud 'dul maḥ 'jigs rngam seṅge gdong can nam mkha'i mdogaḥ che btsan yon tan srid na mtshungs dpe bralaḥ dam ldan bu yi 'bod do da tshur byon0 nyonamongs dgra bgegs ma lus zhi mdzad pa'i rdo rje bdud 'dul drag mo gshegs su gsolaḥ snang srid legs tshogs dpal yon rgyas mdzad pa'iḥ rat+na bdud 'dul drag mogashegs su gsol dregs pa che btsan 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur ba'iḥ pad+ma bdud 'dul drag mo gshegs su gsol ma rungs dam sri 'byung po brlag mdzad pa'iX garma bdud 'dul drag mo gshegs su gsol ༷ rgyu brgyad sems kyi dbang gyur gnyis snang canaḥ 'dul mdzad phra men sde brgyad gshegs su gsolaḥ legs nyes stong 'dzin zhing bcu'i sgog dbugs sdud ma chen dbang phyug 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol ༷ rlung gi shugs can dam nyams dgra bos gshed ༷ mi srun sha za spun gsum gshegs su

gsolaḥ bka' yi 'khor na gnas pa'i bstan bsrung baḥ dam can lha lnga 'khor bcas gshegs su gsolaḥ sgrub pa po la mthun rkyen dpal stsol ba'iX dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar nag gshegs su gsol0 sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol sems can phan bde spel phyir gshegs su gsolaX mtha' yas dmag dpung bzlog phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrug bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol byad phur rbod gtong bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol mi mthun nyer mtshe bkra mi shis pa kunaX zhi bzlog phrin las bsgyur ba'i dus la babs de dag 'khor dpung gis phyon par bsam la mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskul ba btangaḥ karma ḍāske seng ha mu kha sa pa ri wā ra mahā me sa khāhi mahā rak+ta khāhiḥ mahā tsit+ta khahiḥ mahā ko ro tsa na khāhi mahā kau ni ri ti khā hiX mahā ba su ta khā hi du tra bsgral ba'i dga' ston bstabs de nasabazlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni dar nag g.yab ci rak+ta spring lagasur dud bto nas 'ad skad doḥ sa hrī: gsang chen o rgyan mkha' spyod rol ba nas 'bum phrag 'kha' 'gro'i tshogs rje bdud 'dul ma gnas yul nyer gzhi'i ma tshogs 'khor

ga6/sdo: dang bcasaḥ dam tshig sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da tshur byonaḥ dur khrod pad nyi bam gyi gdan la bzhugasaḥ 'dod yon lnga yi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la ma rig 'khrul ba bdag tu 'dzin pa rnams bdag med mnyam pa nyid kyis ngang du bzlogaḥyang cig bzlog pa'i phrin las niḥ steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar bzlogaḥ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan bzlog0 bar nas sde brgyad g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaX dri za'i mig 'bur bcug pa bzlogaḥ gshin rjes tshe la rku ba bzlogaX chu lhas dreg grum gtong ba zlogaX gnod sbyin rgyug 'gyel slong ba bzlogaX me lhas tshad nad gtong ba bzlog ༷ srin pos 'bog brgyal byed pa bzlogaX rlung lhas pad gan 'byed pa bzlogaḥ dbang ldan gyis ni gnod sbyor bzlog ༷ rgyal pos spyo 'bog ston pa bzlogaḥ ma mo'i khrag nad rims yams bzlog0 klu yis mdze grum gtong ba bzlogaḥ bse rag thabs tu nyal ba bzlogaḥ mu ges bkrag mdangs rku ba bzlogaḥ 'byung pos ngan gtong nyes 'gyed bzlogaḥ chos kyis chos zor dgra la bzlogaX bon gyis dmod zor dgra la bzlogaḥ mu stegs btso zor dgra la bzlogaḥ

nang ba chos kyi bden pa bzlog phyi rol mu stegs ngan sngags bzlogaḥ rig sngags dmod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzlogaḥ mthu gtad byad zor thams cad bzlog sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la bzlogaḥ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la bzlog za bar byed pa'i 'dre la bzlog phung bar byed pa'i sri la bzlog bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las niX bdud 'dul nag mos sgrub par mdzod aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsayin daḥraX saḥmā rā ya phaṭaḥ kro ti haḥriḥniḥsaḥḍāk+ki ni hūṃ phaṭaḥ du tra dgra bgegs mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog e ka bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ dgra bgegs byad ma'i ngan gtong cho 'phrul ltas ngan thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaX hū ༷ shar phyogs dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba nas rdo rje bdud 'dul mthing nag rngams pa'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod phyag rgya bsgyuraḥ gdug rtsubs sku las mtshon thun char ba 'bebs rdo rje bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor dang bcas dam tshig sgrub pa'i sogs bzlog byang gong bgo 'gres soḥ hūḥ lto phyogs dur khrod rab rngams brjed pa nas rat+na bdud 'dul nag mo mun pa'i gzugs

—8snye: rno ba ra mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams sku las mtshon thun dug gi char ba 'bebs ༷ rin chen seng gdong drag mo 'khor dang bcasaḥ dam tshig sgrub pa'i sogs 'gres soḥ hūṃḥ nub phyogs dur khrod 'bar 'khrugs 'khyil ba nasaḥ pad+ma bdud 'dul nag mo char sprin gzugs rngam pa'i sku las gdug rtsubs mtshon cha 'dzinaḥ rab 'jigs sku las thun gyi char ba 'bebasaX pad+ma seng gdong nag mo gtso 'khor bcas dam tshig sgrub pa'i sogs 'gres soḥ (ཿ byang phyogs dur khrod rab tu g.yo ba nasaX garma bdud 'dul mthing nag rngam pa'i sku rab 'jigs zhal bzang gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzinaX rno ngar 'bum rdzogs thun gyi char ba 'bebasaḥ karma seng gdong nag mo 'khor dang bcas dam tshig sgrub pa'i sogs 'gres so 〉ཿ rab 'jigs rngams pa'i dur khrod gnas brgyad nasaḥ mi srun sha za chen mo mched brgyad niḥ phag gdong nag mo rmongs sems gdon la gsheḥ gti mug 'khrul ba'i dgra bgegs bzlog par byedaX stag gdong nag mo khengs sems gdon la gsheḥ nga rgyal 'khrul ba'i dgra bgegs bzlog par byedaḥ chu

srin gdong can chags pas gdon la gsheḥ 'dod chags 'khrul ba'i dgra bgegs bzlog par byedaḥ gzig gdong nag mo 'khrugs pa'i gdon la gshe phrag dog 'khrul bami dgra bgegs bzlog par byed shar lto khye gdong nag mo khros shing gtumaḥ nyon mongs me ltar 'bar ba'i dgra bgegs bzlog lto nub khra gdong nag mo gtum rngam skusaḥ nyo mongs mun ltar 'thibs pa'i dgra bgegs bzlogaḥnub byang spyang gdong sngon mo khro gtum skusaḥ nyon mongs rlang ltar 'tshubs pa'i dgra bgegs zlog byang shar 'ug gdonganag mo rab 'jigs pasaḥ nyon mongs chu ltar khol ba'i dgra bgegs bzlogaḥ rdo sdephra men mkha' 'gro sde brgyad poX rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul ba sa ya 'bumaḥ dam tshibasgrub pa'i sogs 'gres so ྅༷ rnal 'byor bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i dam tshig canaḥ dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad niḥspug nag chen mosasrin mo'i dmag dpung bzlogaḥ sbru'agadong ser mos tshangs pa'i dmag dpung bzlogaḥ gzigs gdong ljang gus lha chen dmag dpung bzlog sprel gdong sngon mos gtogs 'dod dmag dpung bzlogaX dred gdong

de'adi: dmar mos gzhon nu'i dmag dpub bzlogaḥdakar mo dom mgos brgya byin dmag dpung bzlogaḥrdo rje pha waṃ nyon 'khrul dgra 'gegs bzlogaḥchu srin mgo can chu lha'i dmag dpung bzlog sdig gdong mthing nag laṅga'i dmag dpung bzlogaḥza ba bya rgod ma yams dmag dpung bzlog rta gdong dkar mos dga' byed dmag dpung bzlogaḥ khrung gdong dkar mos stobs rngam dmag dpung bzlogaḥ khyi gdong spug nag gnam sman dmag dpung bzlogaḥ pu shud mgo can king gi dmag dpung bzlogaX sha ba'i mgo can rlung wa'i dmag dpung bzlog spyang gdong ljang mos btsan gyi dmag dpung bzlog skyin gdong dmar mos me lha'i dmag dpung bzlogaḥ phag gdong nag mos sa bdag klu gnyan bzlogaX kha gdong dmar mos dri la za ba bzlog glang chen mgo can sha za'i dmag dpung bzlogaḥchu lha sbrul gdong byad ma'i dmag dpung bzlogaḥ dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtswa bzhi poḥ rang rang phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon rnon 'dzinaḥsha za lce spyang sprul ba glog ltar 'khyugaḥlegs nyes ltong sgog 'dzin pa 'i ma chen rnamasaḥdam tshig sgrub

pa'i gnas sogs 'gres soḥ/ཿshar gyis srung rdo rje khu byug mgoX zogs bcas bdud kyis rgol ba dbyings su bzlogaḥs yisgo srung rin chen ra gdongs mas thogs medabadud kyis rgol ba rang sar bzlog nub kyisgo srung pad+ma seng gdong mas dga' brod bdud rnams mnyam pa nyid du bzlog byang gis srung sbrul gdong ljang mo yis snyemasabyed bdud rnams ka dag dbyings su bzlogaḥrang rang rigs drug chos kyi dbyings bzhugs kyang rnams pa bzhi 'di thabs kyi sgo mar shar phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'igrogs mo cheX tshad med thugs rjes skyong ba'i tha tshig can dam tshig sgrub pa'i sogasa'agres soḥ/ alas byung ba'i lha yi ma tshogs kyis drag po lha yis cho 'phrul gdugartsubs bzlogaḥkatshogs byung ba'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro yis dri za grul bum gdug rtsubs dgra la bzlogaX satshopas byung ba'i sa bdag bstan ma yis sa bdag gnyan gyis gdugartsubs dgra la bzlog mayas byung ba'i ma mo mkha' 'gro yis ma yams dbang phyug chad pa dgra la bzlog ralas byung ba'i drang srong ma tshogs kyisaX gza' dang 'byung po'i

—8sde: dmag tshogs dgra la bzlogaḥtsaḥlas byung ba'i btsan gyi ma tshogs kyis ༷btsan dmag 'bum gyis shwa rdel dmag dpung bzlogaḥshaḥlas byung ba'i gnod sbyin ma tshogs kyisaX yaka srin pos cho 'phrul dgra la bzlogaX daḥlas byung ba'i dam can ma tshogs kyis 'gong po the'u rang gdug rtsubs dgra la bzlogaḥraX las byung ba'i dge bsnyen ma tshogs kyisaḥm yams gnam sman gdug rtsubs dgra la bzlogaḥs las byung ba'i sha za ma tshogs kyisaḥgrong rgyug mo 'dres gnod 'tshe dgra la bzlogaḥkun kyang ye shes dbyings las 'jigs rten tshulaḥzo dor dregs pa'i dmag gi gtso mo cheḥrang rang rnam 'gyur sprul ba sa ya 'bumaX dam tshig sgrub pa'i sogs 'gres soḥhūṃḥm chen mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi las byed pa'iḥsha za mkha' 'gro'i mi snying rlon 'phrog maḥphyag bsnyen zung dang las mkhan sha za bzhiX yang g.yog sprul ba nying sprul bsam mtha' yasaḥkun kyang 'dir byon sha khrag gtor ma bzhesaX gnod byed dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod ༷chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa'i bde ba'i dpal sbyin dbang phyug 'dod

rgyal niḥ sbyor sgrol mdzad pa ma nges ston pa'i phyiraḥ sku mdog dmar nag glang po'i gdong ba canaḥ gdug pa'i mtshon rnon ye shes phyag char 'dzin: rngam pa'i chas rdzogs khrosapa'i rnam 'gyur ldan rang rang sprul ba g.yog 'khor bsam mtha' yasaḥ dam tshig sgrub pa'i sogs 'gres soḥkakanyi kakaka 'dul drag mo 'i spyi bo'i rgyan bzhugs pa'iḥ yeshesakhyung dmar me yi gshegags pa canaḥ rlung gi shugs ldan klu gnyan gtod kyi gshedaḥ rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i phrin las canaḥ sngags pa'i drag tu bskul tshe las la myuraḥ dmatshig ldan pa'i ye shesag ru ṭa gsang chen gnas 'dir 'bod do da tshur byon skye med nam mkha'i dbyings su gsal bar bzhugs bdud :sman raka gtor mchod 'di bzhesalaX gti mug rmongs 'khrul sa bdag klu gnyan dngaḥ byad phur rbod gtong bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzodaXyang cig bzlog pa'iphrin las ni steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar bzlog 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan bzlog bar nas sde brgyad g.yo 'khrugs bzlogaḥ dri za'i mig 'bur bcug pa gshin rjes tshe la rku ba chu lhas dreg grum gtong ba gnod

—8sde: sbyin rgyug 'gyel slong ba me lhas tshad nad gto ba srin pos 'bog brgyal byed pa rlung lhas pad gan 'byed pa dab ldan gyis ni gnod sbyor rgyal pos spyo 'bog ston pa ma mos khrag nad rims yams klu yis mdze grum gtong ba bse rag thab tu nyal ba mu ges bkrag mdangs rku ba 'byung pos na gtong nyes 'byed chos kyis chos zor dgra la bon gyis dmod zor dgra la mu stegs btso zor dgra la nang pa chos kyi bden pa phyi rol mu stegs ngan sngags rig sngags dmod pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzlog mthu gtad byad zor thams cad sdang bar byed pa'i dgra la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la za bar byed pa'i 'dre la phung bar byed pa'i sri la bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las ni khyung chen 'bar bas sgrub par mdzodaḥ ma pad+ma khro ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭaḥ rū dra dgra bgegs mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ e ka bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog dgra bgegs byad ma'i na gtong cho 'phrul ltas ngan thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ de ltar drag mo'i gtor bzlog 'di byas pas

ga gsum 'byung po brgyalaḥkhamasagasum gdug pa'i yo log bzlog mo rtsisam ltas ngan pa sel bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub ze tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā de nas sgrub pa grol ba'i tshe gtor bzlog bya ba'i ma pa niḥ hūṃ trīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas gzu dang dpang bla ma yi dam gzu dang dpang0 ma mo mkha' 'gro gzu dang dpang pho nya dam can gzu dang dpang mngon spyod sgrub pa'i 1gas mdzod cig ༷ sno shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srungaḥ dri za'i sde 'khor dpung bcas pas gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes laḥ mngon spyod sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod stegaḥ gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la phob las kyi zor sgo dbye bar mdzod lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po grul bum sde 'khor 'bangs bcas pasaX gser skyems rgyug dung 'di bzhes laḥ mngon spyod sgrub pa'i grogs su chos gtor zor dgra dang bgegs la phob las kyi zor sgo dbye bar mdzod nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzangaḥ klu dbang sde 'khor dpung bcas kyis bdud rtsi skyems phud 'di bzhes la drag po sgrub pa'i grogs su chos las kyi gtor zor dgra la phobaX legs nyes shan 'byed zor sgo dbyesaḥ

—8/sde: sbyor sgrol 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzod byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos srasaḥganod sbyin sde 'khor 'bangs bcas pas drag po'i skyems mchod 'di bzhes laḥmangon spyod sgrub pa'i grogs su chosaḥgator zor dgra dang bgegs la phobaX drag po'i phrin las sgrub pa'i phyiraḥgadug rtsubs cho 'phrul bstan par mdzod gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dngaḥsnang zhing srid pa'i la 'dre rnamasaX gser skyems rgyug chang 'di bzhes laḥdagra bgegs bsgral ba'i grogs su chosaḥgadug rtsubs mtshon rnon gtor zor dbalaḥdagra dang bgegs la 'bebs par mdzod ༷dus la bab so sa ma yāḥ.e bskyed 'gugs bstem bsgral chog bya de nas gtor zor gdab pa niḥhū ༷snyen rgyan gsang chen dur khrod rang byung nasaḥmakha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso mo seng ge'i gdongaḥbadud 'dul nag mo las mdzad pho nyar bcasaḥdo nub dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung ༷do nub bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhanaX do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdugaḥpho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byungaḥnye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du rlogaḥdakor nor longs spyod phung thal ming med mdzodaḥthugs dam

dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ shar phyogs thugs rje'i rang bzhin dur khrod nasaḥ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso mo seng ge'i gdongaX rdo rje bdud 'dul nag mo 'khor dang bcasaḥdo nub dgra la rbad do mthu ma chungaḥ do nub bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan ༷ do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdugaḥ pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byung nye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du zlogaḥ dkor nor longs spyod phung thal ming med mdzodaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sam yā lho phyogs byams pa'i rang bzhin dur khrod nas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso mo seng ge'i gdong rat+na bdud 'dul nag mo 'khor dang bcas do nub dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung do nub bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhanaḥ do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdugaḥpho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byung nye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du rlogaX dkor nor longs spyod phung thal ming med mdzodaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma āḥnub phyogs dga' ba'i rang bzhin dur khrod nas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso mo seng ge'i gdongaḥ pad+ma bdud 'dul nag mo 'khor dang bcasaX do nub dgra la bod do mthu ma chungaḥ do nub

bsnye/da: bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhanaḥ do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdugaḥ pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byungaḥ nye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ dkor nor longs spyod phung thal ming med mdzodaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā byang phyogs btang snyoms rang bzhin dur khrod nasaḥ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gtso mo seng ge'i gdongaḥ karma bdud 'dul nag mo 'khor dang bcas do nub dgra la rbad do mthu ma chungaḥ do nub bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhanaḥ do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdugaḥ pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byung nye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ dkor nor longs spyod phung thal ming med mdzodaX thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yā gsang chen 'jigs pa'i dur khrod gnas brgyad nasaX rdo rje phra men las mdzad mched brgyad poḥ rang rang sprul ba g.yog 'khor 'bum 'bum bcas do nub dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung donub bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhanaX do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdug pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byung nye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ dkor nor longs spyod

phung thal ming med mdzodaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yāX rnal 'byor bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i dam tshig can dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad niḥ rang rang sprul ba g.yog 'khor sa ya 'bumaḥ zab gsang gnyan gyi bstan pa sprung mdzad pa'iXsha za spun gsum 'dod rgyal dmar nag sogasaḥ rang rang las mdzad bka' yi pho nyar bcas do nub dgra la rbad do mthu ma chungaX do nub bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdug pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byungaX nye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ dkor nor longs spyod phung thal ming med mdzod thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma māḥ zhes mdun bskyed lha zor dgra bgegs kyi phung khams la gdab de nas thun zor gdab pa niḥ hū bh+yoḥnyon mongs mun ltar gtibs pa'i dur khrod nas ༷ rak+ta khrag gi rba klong 'byel ba'i klongaḥ dgra bgegs pho mo gcal tu bkram pa'i steng sha za lce spyang rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i dbusaX hū phaṭa sod rgyob 'brug ltar sgrogs pa nasaḥ ma mo 'bum gyi gtso mo seng ge'i gdongaḥ drag rtsal rigs bzhi rdo rje phra men brgyad ma sring dbang phyug bka' sdod pho nyar

06/sdo: bcas do nub dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i grogs su chos ༷ sko yongs kyis khrag zor khol ma 'di drang sgong yongs kyis mda' zor ngar ma 'di bsnyen yongs kyis rdo zor 'bar ba 'di mthu ldan yongs kyis gtor zor brjid ldan 'di bdud po rnams kyis mtshe zor ngar ma 'di ma mo yongs kyis dug thun khol gnod sbyin yongs kyis gri thun mtshon rnon 'di dregs pa yongs gyis phur thun rab 'bar 'di 'byung po tshar gcod yungs dkar thun zor 'di sdang byed gra bo'i rwa dkyil du phobaḥ 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo chos kyi dbyings su rlog 'khrul med rig pa sku gsum mngon gyur 31gaḥ gnod byed bgegs kyi ma rig gzhi la phobaḥ a 'thas 'a( snyems rtog dbyings su chodaḥ nyon mongs lī shes dbyings su grol bar mdzodaḥ thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las grub par akasamangatsa shadangasaX mā ra ya pāṭaḥ kro ti nyari niḥsasarba ḍāk+ki sa ma yāḥ du tra dgra bgegs mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥm mocas ka tsa ti sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo

bzlogaḥ btsan badz+ra du tri sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yo bdud pra ma ni sa ma ya ga na dze+eya ma ra tsa sa ma ya gnod sbyin yaka e nyag sa ma ya gza' snyirna ra tsa sa ma ya rgyal po dang ka ratri sa ma ya klu nā ga ra tsa ling sa ma ya srin po dha sha ru lu sa ma ya mu stegasajidu sa ma ya snang srid lha 'dre byad kha rbod gtong thams cad byad ma gnod byed kyi thog tu bh+yobh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ byad kha phur kha dbal kha bzlog bzlogaX gtad mnan phung sel sna dgu bzlog bzlog gnod byed byad ma'i steng du e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ e dza bh+yo bh+yobacho ga bachogag thal mo brdab cing dmod pa bor maro na spyod drag lasanan du bya dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jigs bgegasadapung rdo rje yan kya bar+shag nusamathu byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas rig 'dzin yongasakyis dgongasargyas btabaḥ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byin gyas brlabs dam can srung ma'i phran las rdzogs drang srong rnams kyi bden tshag btabaḥ phra men bzlog pa'i nus mthu ldan byad phur bzlog pa'i mthu stobs 'dzom dbul phung selaba'i nor lta bu 'di las zab pa srid na dkon bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal skal ba can gyi dpa la du shog nyamasapa can la 'di ma shor dam can la lngas thubs par sru ཿsha za gsum gyi gces par skyongs 'dod rgyal

—rten chen po sa mel rtse mdzodaḥs ma yuḥye ma dbang chen gsang gsagasung gi gnas pad+ma rak+ta 'khyil ba'i klong de dang nye ba'i gnas mchog gis 'dod rgyal dmar pos bla mtsho nas dus su mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe zab mdzod yid bzhin nor lta bu rgyal mchog bshad pa rtsal gyis rnyed bstan 'gro'i phan bde dpal rgyas phyir rin chen shog skyar pheb pa'o sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥbarda thim snyiḥzhes pa 'da'ang lung zinadharma ku mu tas bskul ba dang /lu zinasoman ta bha dras bskul ba don dang ldan phyir nas bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag rtsal gyis mkha 'gro'i brda mdzod la sa zhal bshus te dag pa ra phab pari yi ge pa nimakhye bha bras bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel/sarba masko le/

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasas chen mkha' 'dza bdud 'dul masaḥ gtor bzlog bsdus pa 'jigs tshogs zil gnon bzhugs soX —8rdo: na modz+nyā na ḍa ni yaḥ gro thozhes mdun bskyed dmar gtor rjid ldan bshams ru dar mtshe yungs dug snas brgyan rtsang gi drwa ba gtor thag sogs spyi dang mthun par phun tshogs bya bdag mdun sgom sgrub bzlas pa da bskang tshogs mchod gtor rgya cher 'bul bskul ba mkhyen gzu gser skyems dang ཿ 'gugs bsgral bstab pa yongs rdzogs mthar ma chen mkha' 'gro'i bzlog pa ni gtum rngam gdu ba'i dbyangasabacas teḥ / spyo dbus mtha' med pa chos kyi dbyings nyid nas bde gshegs rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum chen mo ༷ bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong ba canaḥ dam ldan bu yi 'bod do da tshur byonaX 'dod lnga rang grol mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥ dug lnga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems can niḥ ma rig las nyon spyod pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnams rig pa ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaḥ ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byad than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs paḥ mi 'dod 'tshubs ma mi mthun phyogs rnams kunaX chos nyid stong pa nyid

kyi ngang du bzlogaḥ hū bh+yoX shar phyogs zhi ba lhun grub dkyil 'khor nasaḥ rgyal kun sku mchog bskyed pa'i dbyings chen moḥ rdo rje bdud 'dul sprul ba 'bum dang bcas dam ldan bu yi 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ 'dod lnga rang grol mchod pa 'di bzhes laX dug lnga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems can niX ma rig las nyon spyod pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnamasaḥ rig pa ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaX ban byad bon byad lha klu mi yi byadaX than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs paḥ mi 'dod 'tshubs ma mi mthun phyogs rnams kunaḥ me long ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlog hū bh+yoḥ lho phyogs rgyas pa rmad byung dkyil 'khor nasaḥ rgyal kun yon tan bskyed pa'i dbyings chen moḥ rat+na bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor dang bcasaX dam ldan bu yis 'bod do 'dod lnga rang grol dug lnga bdag tu ma rig las nyon rig pa ye shes ban byad bon byad than dang ltas mi 'dod 'tshubs ma mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaḥ hā bh+yoḥ nub phyogs rab 'bar dbab gi pho brang nas rgyal kun gsu gsang bskyed pa'i dbyings chen moḥ pad+ma bdud 'dul drag mo 'khor dang

—8/sde: bcasaḥdam ldan bu yis 'dod lnga rang dug lnga bdag tu ma rig las nyon rigs pa ye shes ban byad bon byad than dang mi 'dod 'tshubs ma sor rtog ye shes chen pa'i ngang du bzlogaḥ/ zlu byang phyogs mngan spyod drag po' dkyil 'khor nasaX rgyal kun phrin las bskyed pa'i dbyings chen moḥ karma bdud 'dul drag mo'akhor dang bcasaḥdam ldan bu yis 'dod lnga rang grol dug lnga bdag tu ma rig las nyon rig pa ye shes ban byad bon byad than dang ltas ngan mi 'dod 'tshubs ma bya grub ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaḥhū bh+yo rab 'bar dur khrod chen po brgyad slong nas rdo rje phra men chen mo rnam pa brgyadaḥ dbang phyug yongs kyi sgrub pa'i grogs gcig maX rang rang sprul ba 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcasaḥdam ldan bu yis 'bod do da tshur byon 'dod lnga rang grol mchod pa 'di bzhes la dug lnga bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems can niḥ ma rig las nyon sgod pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnamasaX rig pa ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaḥ ban byad bon byad lha gla mi yi byad than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna

tshogs paḥ mi 'dod 'tshubs ma mi mthun phyogs rnams kun chos dbyings spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang du bzlogaḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ he ru ka yi gnas yul kun srung ba'i las mdzad dregs pa zil gnon mkha' 'gro bcuḥ rang rang sprul ba 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcasaḥ dam ldan bu yi 'dod lnga rang grol dug lnga bdag tu ma rig las nyon rig pa ye shes ban byad bon byad than dang ltas ngan mi 'dod 'tshubs ma chos dbyings spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang du bzlogaḥ / bh+yoḥ dkyil 'khor yongs kyi mtha' skyongs dam tshig canaḥ dbang phyug chen mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad niḥ gdug pa'i mtshon rnon zhing bcu'i snying la 'bebs rdzu 'phrul thogs med khams gsum mnga' dbang bsgyur las mdzad sprul ba bsam yas dpung dang bcas dam ldan bu yis 'dod lnga rang grol dug lnga bdag tu ma rig las nyon rig pa ye shes ban byad bon byad than dang ltas ngan mi 'dod 'tshubs ma chos dbyings spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang du bzlogaḥ hūṃ bh+yo phrin las rnam pa bzhi la mnga' brnyes pa'i ma chen mkha' 'gro'i bka' nyanasgo smong bzhi dbang sprag

ga6/sdo 'dod rgyal glang po'i gdong ba canaḥ dbang drag ma nges mdzad ston sku mdog kyang dmar ser rā ga'i mad sa dang char sprin mdog gang yang gdul bya'i yul la thogs med gzigasaX dam tshig can gyi pho nya g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ dam ldan bu yis 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ 'dod lnga rang grol mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ dug lnga bdag tu 'dzan pa 'i sems can niḥ ma rig las nyon spyod pa'i 'khrul 'khor rnamasaḥ rig pa ye shes chen po 'i ngang du bzlogaḥ ban byad bon byad la klu mi yi byadaḥ than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ༷ mi 'dod 'tshubs ma ma mthun phyogs rnams kunaḥ chos dbyings spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang du bzlog: / bye dgongs pa de bzhin nyid du byang chub kyangaḥ rnam rol bstan dgra'i gshed mar khros pa'i skuX sha za chen mo mi snyi rlon phrog maḥ phyag brnyen pho nya chu srin dred kyi gdongaḥ dur byed nag mo kha kha hu lu dngaḥ shwa na spyang gdong bka' nyan pho nyar bcasaḥ dam ldan bu yis 'dod lnga rang grol dug lnga bdag tu ma rig las nyon rig pa ye shes ban byad bon byad than dang ltas ngan mi

'dod 'tshubs ma chos dbyings spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang du bzlogaḥ gzhan yang bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad sna dang stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs tshogs ma lus pa gdon chen bco lnga gdon bran bsam mtha' yasaḥ mtha' bzhi'i dmag gis ru 'dzing g.yo ba dang dregs pa sde brgyad 'byung po'i gnod 'tshe sogasaḥ thams cad ma lus chos kyi dbyings su bzlogaḥ tha snyad shes ngorasnang ba'i rgud pa kunaḥ don dam ye stong dag chen ngang bzlog nasaḥ bde sdug gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba ka dag steX ma chen mkha' 'gro'i gsang gsum mngon gyur regagaḥ de ltar drag po' bzlog pa yasaḥ dgra bgegs 'byu po tshar gcod cas mi mthun phyog rnams ma lus pa chos kyi dbyi sa su stong bar 'gyur 'di la ze tshoms byar ma dgos bden rdzun lag tu lo sa dang gsalaḥ sa ma yuḥ e ma rgyal kun gsung girdo rje che pa d+ma dbang chen he ru ma'i gas ba gsung gi bla mtsho nas dus su mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe rin chen sgrom rgya las bkrol nas phun tshogs lnga yi zhing sar bkod gdul zhing yongs las khyab pa ra spel 'brel tshad mkha' 'gro'i gral dbus su bde sto spyod — 'i rgyu ru smon sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gurgyaḥ brda thim snyi zhes pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bskul ngor/ kho bo nus
ra mi ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ma dzod las zhal bsas te dag par phab 'i yi ge pa napubyebha bra'i ming gas bgyis pa dge legs 'phe la/ sarba maṅga le/

bsko: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥmakha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo'i drag sgrub rdo gtor spu gri'i 'khor lo bzhugs soḥs/rdo: na moto na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ ba'i/〈〈ཿ'arjegasargyagasa'abyung po mthar mdzad pa'i bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro la mthon mthing ral bas btud de 'dud las ldan bsgrub la zhugs pa'i tshe maro na spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i phyar bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdo ma'i rdo gtor spu gri'i 'khor lor brtsonaḥs ma māḥde pang sgog ge 'jigs pa 'i brag gam pha 'ong dum bu da ཿyang na yirigs gru gsum du bcag pa la dug sna lnga dang khrag sna byug ma tshal gyis byad zorabazlog rdo yang gri bdag nyid bdud 'dul drag mo' bskyed rim da ldan pas yin su bha wa sogs rkyas stong par sbyangs che nga pa'i ngang las rdo gtor rnams mtshon rtse ltar rno ba shin tu lci zhibhe 'thas pa gang gzas pa'i yul rnams thal bar brlag nus pa'i rang bzhin du gsal gdabaX de yang nang khang gsang chenarang byung gi dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas su rtogs med ro yi gdan laXmakha' 'gro bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma sku mdog nag mo mun pa'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag

gnyis shin tu khro zhing gtum pa dur khrod dpal chas kyis mdzes par spras shing ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing zhabs gar stabs su bsgyur baḥ yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul du kha ṭ+wāṃ ka rtse gsum mchan khung g.yon du brten paḥ rang 'dra ba'i mkha' 'gro ma bye ba sa ya'i phyag nas bzlog pa'i khrag zor dang mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin par bskyed doḥ mkha' spyod o rgyan gsang chen rol ba'i dur khrod nas bdud 'dul khrag 'thung nag mo 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpung gi spyan drangs te bstim mo ༷ zhing sgrub skabs su spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod drag po 'a tshe na 'bum bskul dmar spring bya skabs su bzlog pa'i phrin pas bcol ba ni hūṃ bye mi dmigs chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nasaX rgyal ba kun yum bdud 'dul seng ge'i gdong0 'jigs lta zil gnon spyan zlum sdang mig bsgrad snying po'i bstan skyong thod rgyan rdo rje bcingaḥ rigs lnga'i dbang rdzogs rtags su cod pan 'phuraḥ chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i zhal gdang shingaḥ tshad med rnams bzhir mtshon pas mche bzhi brdaraX 'khor 'das mnyam par rol ba'i ljags

—6sno dmar 'khyugs: khams gsum g.yo 'gul byed pa'i brda glu sgrogasaḥ ma rig mun sel smin mar glog 'od 'khyugs 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'gyed pa'i g.yu ral mdzesaḥ dug gsum gdon 'dul seng chung zog ltar 'bebasaḥ phyag g.yas sna ba dbang bsdud gri gug phyaraX g.yon pa stong nyid mnyam sbyor thod khrag rolaḥ 'khor ba'i sa rnams brtse ba'i zhabs kyis gnonaḥ ye shes pa rnams bde ba'i gar gyis 'gyedaḥ tshogs brgyad rang grol dur khrod chas brgyad daja ཿ pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rus rgyan sprasaḥ bya ba lhun grub dar ljang dpyangs pa bskyodaḥ dug lnga'i gdon 'dul ye shes me lnga 'khyilaḥnyid kyi sku la rigs dang dkyil 'khor rdzogasaḥ gnas yul dur khrod he ru'imakha' 'gro 'gyedaḥ mtshan ma bral ba'i bdud 'dul seng gdong maḥ mtshon tsam thabs kyi phyag rgyar rab bzhengs teX gsang chen rdo yi dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs nas gnyis med don dam rtogs pa'i phyag mchod dngaḥ gang shar rang grol mchod gtor dgyes bzhes laḥ mos ldan bu yi re 'dod skong du gsolaḥ gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i

dgra sde bzlogaḥ gsang sngags bstan la 'khru ba'i zhing bcu bzlogaḥ bshad sgrub dam tshig bshig pa'i chom po bzlogaḥ ri rgya klong rgya bkrol ba'i shan pa bzlogaX nyes med yongasal 'tshe ba'i chom po bzlog gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs bzlogaḥ zhe sdang rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i rgyal gdon bzlogaḥ 'dod chags rang mtshan 'dzin pa'imo gdon bzlog gti mug a 'thas 'khrul ba'i klu gdon bzlogaḥ phrag dog mtshan mar bzung ba'i 'byung po bzlogaḥ nga rgyal rang mtshan gol ba'i dam sra bzlogaḥ snang bdangos por 'khrul ba'i phyi bdud bzlog snang mkhan 'dzin par 'thas pa'i nang bdud bzlogaḥ gnyis med gnyis su 'thas pa'i bdud bzhi bzlog bsam sbyor smon lam logapa'i mtha' dmag bzlogaḥ rnams mkhyen dngos mtshan lta ba'i yar bdud bzlog 'khor ba rang mtshan rlom pa'i mar bdud bzlogaḥ don la bzlog dang bzlog bya gnyis 'dzin sems gzhi rtsa ka dag sems nyid rang grol klong rang ngo shes na 'khor 'das bde sdug grol ma chen khyed kyi dgongs pa'i mchog gsang steḥ rig mchog bdag gis spros pa

—8/sde: kun bral bar0 de bzhin nyid kyi klong du mnyam par bzhagaX de lta ra bzlog pa 'i las byas pas mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grubaḥs ma mā de nas gtor zor 'phen pa niḥgaser skyems mchod la 'di skad doḥ hoḥ dgongs shig bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsumaḥ gson cig bdud 'dul drag mo seng ge'i gdong rtsal las shar ba'i mkha' 'gro sa ya 'bum mos ldan bu yis bskul lo da tshur bzhengasaḥ 'dod lnga rang grol skyems gtor 'di bzhes laḥ mngon spyod drag bo'i mdzad pa dgra la stonaḥ do nub mkha' 'gro'i mtshon thun rdo zor 'di sdang ba'i dgra la rbad do mthu ma chungaḥ gnod pa'i bgegs la gzor ro rtsal ma zhan dam sri'i snying la bskul lo stobs ma chungaX bdag gi dam dang yid la 'gal ba'i dgraX stong gsum gang du gnas kyang thal bar rlogaX dkon pa'i tshe srog bla dbugs 'du ba phrolaḥ rnams shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral 'dren mdzodaḥ yul der thun mtshon nad kyi char phob laḥ ming tsam med par thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ drag po'i dus la bab po sa ma yāḥ atsho/tshog4 5mingamomom dar+shardotshogaḥmā ra ya phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs mi dang mi ma yin

pa'i tshe bla grogs gsum la thun bh+yo thun bh+yo mā ra ya rbad sodaḥ ma chen mkha' 'gro las la bskul drag sngags sgrogs shi rdo zor rdeb dgra dbung pha lam yan kyang 'jigs bgegs dpung spu gri'i 'khor lo 'thor rno nus byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal mkha' 'gro'i gas mdzod zab rgya can dam nyams lag tu ma shor cig sa ma yu0 ye maḥ dbang chen gsang ba gsu gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta'i mtsho gling dang nye ba'i sbas yul bla mtsho nas lha chen 'dod rgyal dmar nag dang ma chen sha za'i brdas bskul tsha mkha' 'gro'i zab mdzod zhal phyes nas bstan 'gro'i nyi ma gsal bar byasaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥlhaḥ zhesa'adi'ang lung zin kun bzang dang pa d+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho gnyis kyis bskul ro ra sngagasargan bdud 'joms khyung drag rtsal gyas mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las zhal bdus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pusabha drasabagyisapa dge legs 'phel/ sarba make le/

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ ma chen bdud 'dul drag mo'i sngags sgrub khrag gtor me yi 'khor lo byad ma myos byed zhes bya ba bzhugs soX badz+ra: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni ya 41rje)(17 bde stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin can ma chen mkha' 'gror gus phyag 'tshal sngags kyi dab phyug rnal 'byor gyis bsnyen bsgrub lhur len byed pa 'i che bar chad dgra yis rgol gyur na sngags sgrub 'di la brtson — ra byaḥ sa ma yāḥkhrag skong sgod du khrag gtor bca' dug sna khrag yungs mtshe yis brgyan rtsang drwa bkram la dal dbus bkod rnams lnga nyer spyod mdzes pas brgyan drag mo' las gzhu bsrang ba' rjes mdun bskyed khrag gtor sgrub ba ni bla su bha wa sogs kyi stong pa ra sbyang sa stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod khrag gi rba 1nga drag tu 'phyo ba'i dbus su khro mo bdud 'dul khrag 'thung ma sku mdog dmar nag khro gtum khros pas gad rgyang can: g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa seng zhal rngam pa'i nga ro sa gsum g.yo byed kyi sgra sgrogs pa: mthing nag ral ba'i gseb nas seng chung bu yug ltar 'tshubs pa: mi lugs g.yang gzhi thul ba klum pa dar dang rus pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs mdzes par spras

pa: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur mdzad pa rtog med ro yi gdan la rol ba ye shes kyi me dang 'ja' 'od bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phro bar bskyed do: de rgyab rigs bzhi'i phra men sde brgyad dbang phyug nyer brgyad la sogs ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho thams cad kyi phyag g.yas na bzlog pa'i khrag dang g.yon na dug khrag gi thun snod thogs pa: kun kyang gcer mo mi sdug 'jigs pa'i rnam 'gyur can mar bskyed doX rang rang gi sgog dam tshig gi lcags kyus bskul te o rgyan mkha' spyod gsang chen rol ba'i dur khrod nas khro mo bdud 'dul khrag 'thung nag mo gtso 'dza ra sprul ba dang bcas pa spyan drangs la bstim moḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod ci bstod yang na drag mo'i 'bum bskul gtong dmar sbra bya zhing mnyes pa bskangs skabs su bzlog las bcol ba niḥ ( bh+yoḥ o rgyan mkha' spyod gsang chen rol ba nas mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku mchogs seng ge'i gdongaX rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i dbyings chen moḥ sku lus gcigs la bkod pa bsam mtha' yasaḥ rig sngags zhing skyes yongs kyi gtsug gis gtugasaX gzung 'dzin bdud bgegs 'dul ba'i mthu mo cheḥ rnal 'byor

bas: dad dam ldan pa'i 'bod bskul naḥye shes gzigs pa'i zhal bzang mngon sum stonaḥdam tshig rten gyi dkyil 'khor chen por bzhugs0gnyis med ro gcig gus pa'i phyag bgyi'oḥ'adod lnga rang 17la dpa' ston 'bul lo bzhesaḥganyis med gnyis su bzung ba'i 'khrul 'khor 'di rig pa ka dag chen po'i dbyings su bzlogaḥgati mug rmongs pa'i sems can log rtog canaX dbyings dang ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaX zhe sdang rgyas pa'i sems can bsam sbyor rtsub me long ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaḥ'adod chags 'khrugs pa'i sems can rngams sems canaḥsor rtog ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaX phrag dog 'tshubs pa'i sems can log rtog canaX bya grub ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlogaX nga rgyal 'thas pa'i sems can khengs pa can mnyam nyid ye shes chen po'i ngang du bzlog rtag par bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'byung po rnamasaḥbadag med mnyam pa chen po'i ngang du bzlog 'ga' zhig yul la re zhing chags pa rnamasaḥyul med zang thal chen po'i ngang du bzlogaḥkha cig re dogs gnyis 'dzin che ba rnams bya

ba ro snyoms chen po'i ngang du bzlogaX lta ba ma rtog sems can blo rtog can rnal 'byor lta ba rtogs pa'i stobs kyis bzlogaḥ sgom pa ma rtog a 'thas 'khrul ba rnamasaḥ ting 'dzin 'od gsal chos sku rtogs pas bzlog spyod pa'i gnas med blang dor rmongs ba rnams0 rnam rgyal spyod pa yang dag rtogs pas bzlog 'bras bu mngon rlom 'bad rtsol byed pa rnamasaX 'bad med ye rdzogs sku gsum dgongs klong bzlogaḥ smon lam log pa'i byad phur rbod gtong kunaX chos nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i slong du bzlogaḥ gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra dpung bzlogaḥ gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs bzlog0 na tsha sdug bsngal spros mtha' bral bar bzlog rten 'brel phongs rgud nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bzlog bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ de ltar gtor bzlog byas pa yis dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar gcod 'gyur byin rlabs rno nus bsam mtha' yas bdenardzun lag tu lo sa da gsalaḥ sa ma yuḥ de nas sgrub pa grol ba'i tshe gtor zor dgra la 'phen pa'i dus rnal 'byor la sngags gde sa wan pa saḥ phud skyems mchod la 'di skad do kye rtedaX dbashangs regag rtsa brnamad bla ma

da'adi: bka' drin can gson cig yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogasaXgazigs shig ma sring mkha' 'gro sa ya 'bumaX thams cad skye med dbyings las ma g.yos bzhinaḥ'agags med sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs teḥdo nub mngon spyod sgrub pa'i grogs su chosaḥbadud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥgadug rtsubs drag rtsal sdang ba'i dgra la stonaḥdo nub sdang ba'i dgra la dmag cig 'byedaḥdo nub drag po thun gyi zor gcig 'debasaḥdo nub mngon spyod drag po'i mdzad pa ston bdud 'dul ma sring mkha' 'gro rtsal ma zhanaḥdapa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams stobs ma g.yelaḥsha za ging gi tshogs rnams mthu ma chungaḥmangon spyod mdzad pa ston pa'i dus la babaX bdud 'dul khrag 'thung nag mo seng ge'i gdong rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul pa bsam yas pa'iḥphyag na bzlog pa'i khrag zor mtshon cha thogasaḥzor sna sdang ba'i dgra la da ston cig dgra bo'i snying khrag gtor la rdul du rlogaḥzor sna gnod pa'i bgegs la da ston cigaḥbagegs rnams mi tsam med par rdul du rlogaḥzor sna bar chad byed pa'i sri la bzlog

sri yi rigs rnams skye med dbyings su rlogaḥ drag rtsal 'gran bral srid na grags pa sgrogs mthu rtsal med byung dam nyams dgra la ston mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzodaḥ aX gaḥsaḥmaX ra tsamigaX da raX saḥmā ra ya phaṭa dgra bgegs gdug pa can gyi snying la sob sobaḥ rak+ta khol kholaḥ tsit+ta gtubs gtubaḥ sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya thun bh+yo rbad rberngod dmod pa bor zhing dgra yul rdeb des na mngon spyod lhun gyis grub mthu rtsal nus pa 'gran zla bral bden rdzun lag tu longs da gsalaḥ sa ma yāḥ ye ma rgyal kun gsang ba gsung gi mdzod pad+ma rak+ta bde ba'i klong de dang nye ba'i gnas mchog nas dusasu mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe rgyal mchog zlos gar dpa' bo yis ran chen mdzod bzang skal bar brtes rang gzhan phan bde spel ba'i phyar rin chen shog skyar gsal ba'oḥs ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda zimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ltasabaskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pusabha dras bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lo/

bsko/: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥtham chen mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo yiX bka' sdod khyung gi bzlog pa sa bdag klu gnyan zil gnon zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ 'am: na mo gu ru pa d+ma ka ra ya shā176 mas smo ma go mkha' 'gra'i bzlog gtor ste :khyung nag ri mor bras ta bkod de nas bskyed chog bya ba na oṃ mahā shu bye ta dz+nyā na sogs ko3nyaḥmadun bskyed bdud 'dul drag mor gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu yi ge khro mthing nag las 'od zer spro bsdus yongs su gyur ba lasaḥlcags kyi khyung nag dug zer 'phro ba'i sgro gshog can spyan mig g.yas pa nyi ma las byas shing gser chu 'khyil baḥgayon pa zla ba las byas shing dngul chu g.yo baḥlcags kyi rwa las me 'bar zhing shang nas rlung nag g.yo baḥsbrul rigs lnga zhal dang phyag gis dam du bsdams paḥsgro gseb nas rdo rje'i thun char lcags kyi ser ba 'bebs pa rab 'bar gyi me dang bskal ba'i rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i dbus su kring hring sgra sgogs bzhin du bzhugs par gsalaḥthugs sgog sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs

la bstim moḥ hūṃ trī bde gshegs thugs kyi bstan pa srung mdzad cingaḥ dab chen gsung gi bstan pa gtsug bkur ba'iḥ khro rgyal khyung chen pad+ma ga ru ṭaḥ dam tshig dag pa'iganas 'dir da tshur byonaḥ tsho badz+ra ga ru ṭa sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥhrīḥ sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi gdan khri laX 'jigs rngams thugs kyi khyung chen bzhugs su gsolaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ na mo sdom gsum dam tshig 'chang ba'i rig 'dzin laX lha phyag 'tshal lo brtse bas rjes su zungasaḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoX hūṃ nyi ye shes khyung la mchod pa 'bul ba ni dgra bgegs dbang lnga'i me tog tshil chen spos zhun me mkhris pas chab dang sha rus zasaḥ rkang gling thod rnga mchod sprin rgya mtsho yisaḥ drag po khyung chen khyod la mchod pa 'bulaḥ mahā pañtsa pū dza ho hrīḥ gtum rngam rab 'jigs thugs kyi khyung chen la rmad du byung ba gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bulaḥ dam rdzas sman dang rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bulaX dgyes bzhes mngon spyod brin las lhun grub mdzodaX o pañtsa a pra ta rak+ta bha lirnya khāhiḥ hūṃ trīḥ bzhugs pa skye med dbyings la dbang bsgyur zhing mdzad pa phrin las klu gnyan

'am/ gdon la gsheX rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi sgog gcig pa'iX ye shes khyung chen sku gsung thugs la bstodaX hrīX khyung chen sprul ba glog ltar 'byugasaX rdo rje'i gad rgyang kring hrīng sgrogs: sa bdag klu gnyan gshed du cheḥ mngon spyod drag po'i 'dzab mchod 'bulaḥ yo dug khyung ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa ༷ rtsa sngags smra bcad ci lasab brjodaX oṃ dug khyung ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le rma bya khyung bar zhig trig trig oṃ phuṭa pāṭa sodaḥ phug phug sod gnyan bar ba ta sodaḥ gags 'bras srin sodaḥ dmu chu skyal rbab sodaḥ ya ma rgya 'brum sodaḥ lhang lhang tser tsaraX trig trigaḥ shag shagaḥ shel shel ༷ thum thum gas par nan sodaḥ sarba ro ga nan sodaḥ bisnan ta kṛta sodaX sa nā ga rā dza mal malaḥ'agul 'gulaḥ tsag tsag gtubs gtubaḥ khrol khrolaḥ chom chomaḥ sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bzung ba thongasaX bcing pa khrol cig phyungs phyungaḥ las sngags 'ad nyid ci rigs brjod gangal btab kya don kun 'grub sa ma rwa ༷ rgya rgya rgya skabs su bzlog pa 'i bcol las niḥkhrag skyems sbrengs la 'di skad rdo hūṃ bh+yo ye shes khyung chen rab 'bar khro bo'i rgyalaḥ sa 'og gdon gyi tshogs rnams

mthar mdzad pa'iX las byed 'bar ba thugs dam las la bzhengs rgyan pa'i mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la rgyal rigs klu yis nad rims gtong ba bzlogaX rje rigs tshogs kyis nad rims bram ze rigs kyis nad rims gdol ba'i rigs kyi klu chen brgyad kyis gnyan gtod tshogs kyis mdze rigs bco brgyad nad rnams dgra la bzlog dreg dang grum bu'i nad rnams dgra la bzlogaḥ gags 'bras srin gyi nad rnams dgra la dmu chu skya rbab nad rnams dgra la bzlog khrag dang chu ser nad rnams dgra skom pa g.yem pa'i nad rnams rtsa rgyus 'then sleb nad rnams skrangs gzer lnga ba'i nad rnams thams cad ma lus bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzodaX ye shes khyung chen 'bar ba chen po yiX sgro gshog g.yas g.yon brdab pas rten 'brel lasaḥ ma rungs than ltas sna tshogs dgra la bzlogaḥ mjug sgro rgyal mo gdong mo'i rang bzhin gyisaX srid pa'i shwa khram rtsis rdil 'debs pa bzlogaḥ gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rwa rtse brdar ba yis rwa co can gyi ltas ngan dgra la bzlogaḥ spu gri ngar ma'i mche ba gsang thabs 'dzinaX mche ba

gas/— can gyi ltas ngan dgra la bzlogaḥ gnam lcags sgro btagag rdo rje'i char 'khrugs pasaḥ 'dab chags yongs kyi ltas ngan dgra la bzlog sen mo lcags kyi rno ra ra 'bum ldan pa'i sder mo can gyi ltas ngan dgra la bzlogaḥ rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa'i phrin las kyisaḥ rnal 'byor yongs kyi gnod 'tshe'i rgol ngan bzlogaḥ phyi bdud masal ba chos kyi dbyings su bzlogaḥ nang bdud 'dzin pa ka dag chen por bzlogaḥ gnyis 'dzin a 'thas dmigs med chen por bzlogaḥ thams cad spros bral de bzhin nyid co bzlogaḥ khro ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭaX sa ma ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlogaḥ e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlogaḥ e ka bh+yo bh+yo0 bzlog bzlogaḥ de ltar drag po khyung bzlog gis byad phur rbod gtong mas cad thub sa bdag klu gnyan gdug rtsubs zhi ban bon kla kle'i rdzas sbyor thub mthu ye grags pa sa sa steng khyabaḥ bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ e ma rgyas kun gsang ba gsung mdzod lasaḥ dus mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul tshe kho bo dbang chen te ru gas bskal ba chu lug lo la rted rnam dkar shi pho sprel la spel 'gro don phrin las mtha' rgyas phyir yi ge'i ris byed pukhye 'o/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasal chen bdud 'dul drag mo'iḥ gtor bzlog dang 'brel ba'i rtsang bzlog mngon spyod lhun grub bzhugs sresaḥ gtsasdo: namo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni ya shā 44pho/ dpal gyi gtor chen mtha' skyong ba'i rtsang la gnas pa'i dab phyug ma rang ra g.yog 'khor dpung da bcas tha tshig bsgrags shing gtor mas brngan bzlog pa 'i phrin las bcol ba ni hūṃ bh+yoḥ bdag tu lta ba'i rū tra 'dul ba'i tshe yul med zang thal ston pa'i he ru ga'i ༷ bka' dang 'khor du gnas pa'i dbang phyug ma ༷ gsang chen sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da bzhengs laḥ 'dod lnga rang grol dpa' ston skyems gtor bzhesaḥ ma rig 'khrul ba'i dgra dang bgegs tshogs bzlogaX gnyis su snang ba gnyis med chen por bzlog re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog nyer len a 'thas chos dbyings ngang du bzlogaḥ bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag chen por bzlogaḥ bzlog bsgyur don dam mtha' bral mngon gyur shogaḥ hūṃ0 bdag tu rtog pa'i du tra 'dul ba'i tsheḥ bar med ro mnyam ston pa'i he ru ma'iḥ bka' 'khor dam la gnas pa'i dbang phyug ma gsang chen

sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir da bzhengs la 'dod lnga rang grol dpa' ston skyems gtor bzhes ma rig 'khrul ba'i dgra dang bgegs tshogs bzlogaḥ gnyis su snang ba gnyis med chen por bzlog re dang dogs pa ro snyoms ngang du bzlog nyer len a 'thas chos dbyings ngang du bzlog bde dang sdug bsngal ka dag chen por bzlogaX bzlog bsgyur don dam mtha' bral mngon gyur re gaḥ stsa bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rū dra 'dul ba'i tsheX gzhi med rtsa bral ston pa'i he ru ga'iḥ bka' 'khor dam tshig 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug maḥgasang chen sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir sogs gong bzhin 'gres soḥ hūḥ kun rdzob chos la rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i bdud don dam dbang chen he ru 'dul ba'i tsheX ye grol gnas lugs gzigs pa'i dbang phyug ma legs nyes stangs 'dzin bka' yi 'khor dang bcasaX gsang chen sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir sogs nas mngon gyur re gaḥ hūṃ bh+yoḥ rtsang gi ngo bo chos kyi dbyings nyid las rnams pa ye shes lnga ldan mig mang ris yar rtse mthing nag ka dag chos dbyings zhal don dam rang mtshan 'dzin pa dbyings su sbyor rtsang dbal

bam/ cha dmar nag bde ba chen po'i nga ཿ kun rdzob rang mtshan 'dzin pa dbu mar sgrolaḥ yar gyi rtse la ye shes me chen 'baraḥ gzugs med khams kun chos kyi dbyings su bsregasaX lte ba zlum por las byed pho nya 'tshubasaḥ gzugs khams gnas rigs de bzhin nyid du bsreḥ mar gyi rtse la bskal ba'i dug rlung 'tshubasaX 'dod khams brtan g.yo dbu ma chen por brdalaḥ las byed lcags kyi bung ba ser ltar 'tshubasaḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i snying khrag 'jub la rgyuḥ wa sprel sbrul dang gla ba rdul ltar 'tshubasaḥ dgra bo'i yul du than gyi char ba 'bebasaḥ ma tram̐ lus la srin mo'i 'gros su gnasaḥ rtogs na don dam 'khor 'das dgongs mnyam sbyoraḥ ma rtog gsod gcod sbyor sgrol kun rdzob ngangaḥ ma chen dbang phyug mdzad phrin de lta buḥ rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa'i mthong lags pasaḥ tshogs drug rang grol 'dod lnga'i dga' ston stobasaḥ ye nas gnyis med dgongs pa gcig tu bsreḥ gnyis 'dzin bdud bgegs 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs pa rag pa ka dag chen po'i ngang du bzlogaX maro na spyod phrin las grub mdzod dam tshig canaḥ ma

ma sarba dhaka ḍak+ki ni e rda bha ling ta kha kha khāhi khāhi ayamanas dzagaso shazha gaḥs rarkushanyakhri mi dang mi ma yin pas byad kha phur kha zor kha mi mthun pa'i phyogs ngan rbod gtong thams cad mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yoḥ bzlog bzlogaḥ e ka bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog e sa bh+yo bh+yo bzlog do nub dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung do nub bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan do nub sri la bskul lo mthu ma sdug pho rgyud rtsad chod mo rgyud drung nas byungaX nye 'khor rtsa lag thal ba rdul du rlogaḥ dkor nor longs spyod phung thal ming med mdzodaX thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma yāX bacho gaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya dbang chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs gisaphyag rgyas btab pa'i brda ris lasazhal bshus te kho bo bdud 'jomasakhyung drag pasadag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni mkhye' ming gis bgyis pa'o/ sarba maṅga le/

badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX mngon spyod drag po'i las mtha' sgo dbye zor bskul rim pa bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nya na ḍak+ki ni yaḥ rnartsa mi mja spyod drag polilas byas te sgrub pa grol dus nang mtshams kyi sgo dbye bdud rtsi'i phud mchod de shā dza pho brang 'od gsal mtha' dbus bral ba yiḥ mnyam nyid don la phyogs ris mi dmigs kyangaX gdul byas re skong phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgoX tshad med rnam bzhi'i mdzad pa mtha' yas phyir dam tshig phyag rgyagasal ba'i brda sgo dbye chos nyid zhibarke bdud bzhi'i mtshan ma grol ye shes rgyas pa'i nyams rtogs lo 'bras sminaḥ dbang sdud rtogs pas sems snang rang sar grol tsharagacod lta bas gzung 'dzin dbyings su sgrolaḥ las bzhi lhun grub bkra shis dam pa stsol lha rnams gnas spor gzu dpang shan drang bzhugs gtor ma las kyi mtshon cha bsgyuradu gsolaḥ dzatshwa rba ho pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ dkar skyems gtsang sar mchod dngos grub niḥ hūṃ ni miganas dag pa chos sna'i smong yangs nas ye shes gzigs tshul thabs mkhas seng

gdong ma'iḥ bdud bzhi rang grol lta ba'i dngos grub stsolaḥ rlung sems blo bral rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol0 bde stong ye shes 'bar ba'i dngos grub stsol: lhun grub phyag rgyachen po' dngos grub stsolaḥ gsang chen mkha' la spyod pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ ma chen thugs kyi klong du byang chub shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sirnyi pha la a la la hoḥ phyi sgo dbye ba niḥ.a ka ros gtor skyems bsangs sbyangs byas teḥ hū dzaḥ sgrub pa chen po'i dam tshig zab mo'i sgoX rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rgya phrin las thabs mkhas byed po glog ltar 'khyugasaḥ 'jigs rtenadregs pa pho mo dam la 'dogs: nga bdag mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'byung po 'dul zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thogs pa med myur mgyog pho nya rgya mtsho gtor mas brngan bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes laḥ sgo bas sgo phyes phrang pas 'phrangs rnams solaḥ gtor sgo zor sgo mtshon sgo thams cad phyesaX nad sgo gdon sgo rims sgo thag gis chod mtho ba'i zhabs bskum dma' ba'i dbu khum laḥ g.yas g.yon mdun thad 'dug pa thams cad bzuraḥ gal te sku la gtor zor phog gyur na ngas ni ma nyes dgra dang 'byung

—8rdo: po'i nyesaḥ bka' chad gdug rtsubs dam nyams rnams la phobaXsnye a ka nini ka niḥ a bhi laX maṇ+ḍal ma ye swāhāḥ gtor lam phyesaX zor lam phyes yasalam phyesaḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams ma shor myur du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig srid pa hu ya phyag rgya bstan noḥzor bskul ni hūṃ spyo mkha' spyod gsang chen rol pa'i durakhrod nasaḥ shin tu 'jigs pa'i bdud 'dul khrag 'thung maḥ do nub mngon spyod drag po'i zor la bskulaḥ dgra dang bgegs dpung gzhom la mthu ma chungaX shar phyogs mi'agyur gtum drag rol ba nasaX rdo rje seng gdong dkar mo 'bum dang bcasaḥdo nub mngon spyod drag po'i zor la bskulaḥ dgra dang bgegs dpung gzhom la mthu ma chungaXlto phyogs rdul bral lhun mnyam ya sa pa nasaX rin chen seng gdong ser mo 'bum dang bcasaḥdo nub mngon spyod dgra dang bgegs dpung nub phyogs chags bral pad+ma 'khyil ba nas pad+ma seng gdong dmar mo 'bum dang bcasaḥ do nub mngon dgra dang bgegs byang phyogs gtum drag rab 'jigs 'bar ba nasaX garma seng gdong ljang nag 'bum dang

bcas do nub mngon spyod dgra dang bgegs dpung shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod gnas brgyad nas mi srun sha za chen mo mched brgyad po do nub mngon dgra dang bgeg bde stong mkha' la thogs med bgrod pa can dbang phyug nyer brgyad rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas do nub dgra dang grin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub mdzad pa'i las byed mkha' 'gro sha za mched gsum gyis do nub dgra dang mngon spyod mthu ldan gsod gcod las la myuraḥ dam can lha lnga 'dod rgyal dmar nag sogs do nub dgra dang pho rgyud skyes pa thog gis phog bzhin rlog mo rgyud bud med lhug phran brngas bzhin thong chung gsum me tog sad kyis khyer bzhin skem dgra sde ming gi lhag tsam ma lus paraḥ phung thal ltas ngan cho 'phrul sna tshogs pas drag rtsal ya mtshan ston mdzod mā ra yā khrag skyems mchod lha zor dang thun zor drag tu rdeb dgra dpung rdo rje pha lam yin kyang 'jigs par gdod mi za'oḥ sa ma yuḥ.e ma pablo'i tshal gyi dga' ba'i dbyig bde chen 'khyil ba'i dbang rdzong nas 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dpal skal ba can gyi nor du shar log par lta ba'i rigs la sdoms dam gtsang

—8mi: mos gus ldan la sprod 'gro don phrin las nya ltar gsal 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'god sa ma yuḥye maḥkairti ka riḥsgra 'dzan bu mo khyim no ki dz+wa la ma med yul nasa'abyedaḥphro kā laḥyid bzhin nor ltar gsal da rba sha ra bstan pa' gsal byed dam pa'oḥs ma yāḥrgya rgya rgya gurgya brda zimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa 'di'ang lung zan pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang kun bzang mthar phyin rnams kyis bskul ba dang nye char grogasagyis bskul ro ra kho bo bdud 'joms nam mkha' rdo rjes dag par phab pa' yi ge pa ni chos nyid rang grol gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo la/

bas: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las bdud 'dul drag mo'i gtor bzlog gi mtha'aḥ srin mo za lam gyi gtor sgo dbye ba mngon spyod lhun grub bzhugs soḥ —8rdosnye na mo tswa na ḍak+ki na yaḥ zabasnyenadza) rnal 'byor lta ba' gdengs bskyed cang dpa' rngams shugs byung 'di skad doḥhūṃ hūṃ hūṃḥ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoX 'jigs rngam srin mo za lam niX dregs pa yongs kyi sring gcig maḥ sha za kun gyi gtso mo cheX sgrub pa po yi grogs gcig puḥ sngags 'chang yongs kyi bran mo cheḥ do nub mngon spyod las la chosaḥ bdud rtsi skyems phud 'di bzhes laḥ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las mdzod cigaḥ khyod kyi 'khor na gnas pa yiḥ ma chen sha za 'dre mo'i tshogasaḥ sngon gyi tha tshig dran mdzod laX mngon spyod sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cigaX bh+yoḥ dkar mo nyi ma'i thod rgyan canaḥ lha yi dmag dpung bran du bkolaḥ rnal 'byor dbang phyug grogs su chos mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ smoḥ ser mo blo ba'i thod rgyan canaX gnyan gyi dmag dpung bran du bkolaḥ rnal 'byor dbang spug grogs su chos mngon smod phrin las grab par mdzodaḥ smo dmar

gsal skar ma'i thod rgyan can btsan gyi dmag dpung bran du bkolaX rnal 'byor dbang phyug mngon spyod brin las bh+yoḥljang gsal pad+ma'i thod rgyan can: sa bdag dmag dpung bran rnal 'byor dbang mngon spyod brin bh+yoḥsna tshogs rat+na'i thod rgyan can drang srong dmag dpung rnal 'byor dbang mngon spyod bh+yo dmar nag zhing gi g.yang gzhi can srin po'i dmag dpung rnal 'byer mngon spyod bh+yoḥskrug nag sbrul chun mgo phreng can gnod sbyin dmag tshogs rnal 'byor mngon spyod bh+yo sngo nag re sde'i lwa'u can gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnal 'byor dbang phyug grogs bsngags mngon spyod bh+yoḥkhrag mdog stag lngags thul ba can gnod sbyin dmag tshogs rnal 'byor mngon spyod bh+yoX dung mdog pad+ma'i do shal can rgyal po'i dmag tshogs rnal 'byor mngon spyod bh+yoḥthal mdog dar gyi wā'u can the'u ring dmag tshogs rnal 'byor mngon spyod bh+yoḥsha za khro gtum srin mo'i gzugs ma yams gnam sman bran rnal 'byor dbang phyug grogs su bsngags mngon spyod bh+yoḥrnal 'byor dbang phyug bdag

—8rdo: cag gis mngon spyod phrin las brtsam pa 'diḥ dgra las gzhan du ma 'byams shigaḥ bgegs las gzhan du ma yo zhigaḥ bh+yo lha yibaka' chad ma ston cigaX gdug rtsubs dgra dang bgegs la stonaḥ bh+yo0 sdebargyad bka' chad ma ston cigaX drag rtsal khyad chos dgra la stonaḥ bh+yoX klu gnyan bka' chad ma ston cig rngams pa'i gdug rtsubs dgra la stonaḥ bh+yoḥ do nub sdang ba'i dgra bo sodaX dgra sde ming med thal bar rlogaḥ bh+yoḥ do nub za mkhan phung 'dre bzlog bgegs dpung ming tsam med par mdzodaḥ sa ma yā0 byed bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog bzlog mngon spyod las 'di brtsam pa na dgra bgeg ma lus rdul brlag 'gyur shin tu zab pa'i no nus yod bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ sa ma pāḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'di' lung zen pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho dngakun bzang mtshan can gnyis gyis bskul ngoraspyod bo bdud 'asdoms khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i zab mdzod kyi sgrom rgya las zhal bshul te dag par phabapa'i yi ge pa ni pukhye bha dras bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga le/

btsasdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ ma chen 'dus 'dul drag mo'iḥ tshe yi sgrub pa 'jigs med rdo rje'i go cha zhes bya ba bzhugs so ༷ba/rdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍak+ki na yaḥ tsamarte ste/ rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i dbyings ma mo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso bdud 'dul drag mo seng gdo ma bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs las ldan sgrub la snying rus can tshe bsring 'chi rkyen 'jigs bzlog phyir ma chen mkha' 'gro sgrub la brtson tshe 'brang bum pa tshe chang dang ral bu mda' dar legs par bkod de nas bsgrub pa 'i rim pa niḥ /snang pashugangang las snang srid kyi khams thams cad bde chen mkha' spyod rol ba'i zhing gi bkod pa yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i dbus suḥ chos 'byung dmar nag e klong brjed par pad nyi dang ro gdan la rig pa'i ngo bo hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rin chen seng gdong ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin cing gar stabs su bsgyur baḥ rus rgyan dang dar chas kyi mdzes par spras shing 'ja' 'od thig le'i klong du snang stong zung 'jug rol ba'i sku ru bsted doḥ diyithugs gar nyi ma'i dal sran ma gleb pa tsam gyi steng du rig pa'i ngo

bo /༷ mthing nag gi g.yas su sgog mi 'gyur ba'i yi ge āḥdakar bo g.yon du tshe yi rang bzhin zloḥljang sngon gsum gsal ba las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros snang srid 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dpal yon dang bcud ma lus pa yi ge gsum gyi rnam par bsdus te yang yang sgog rten yi ge 'byu gsum la bstim mo gzhan yang bdag mdun gyi sku yi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros bdag dang bsrung bya rnams kyi bla srog 'khyams pa yal ba chad pa gas pa thams cad rang gnas su bsdus shing sor chud par bsam khyad par bla srog gi dwangs ma gdon chen gyi phrog pa gdon phran gyis brkus pa byad ma lha srung gis bkugs pa thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnams par 'ab se 'ub se sib rug rug bsdus nas bdag dang bum gtor ril bu'i lha tshogs rnams la sib sib bstim pas 'gyur med rdo rje tshe yi rang bzhin du mos la a gaḥs maḥraX tsagaḥdaXr saXmā ra ya phaṭa tadu shāḥ a triḥzloḥ.ā yur pukhye sirnyi tshe sbyoḥ ḍāk+ki tshe sneḥ brgya rtsa la sogs ci rigs brjod la

—rten: sngags kyis mchod cang bstod pa niḥ ( nyi skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang0 'gags med ye shes gzigs pa can sgyu 'phrul 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro laḥ rab gus dang bas phyag 'tshal bstodaX lha rnams 'od du zhu nas dam tshig gi rdzas la bstim moX de nas mda' dar g.yab cing tshe 'gugs pa ni yon bdag mdun du 'tshogs par byas la 'di skad doḥ / ༷sarang snang mi shig bde chen zhingaḥ lnga ldan zangs mdog dpal gyi riḥ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nasaḥ o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung rje 'bangs lo pan sprin phung 'khrigasaX dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du 'phro 'gyedaḥ mdzad brin sprul pa'i gter ston dngaḥ thugs sras brgyud par bcas rnams kyis mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskuraX 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i dwangs bcud bsdusaḥ sgrub pa po yi dpal du stsol0 lus la 'chi med tshe dbang bskuraḥ ngag la 'gags med tshe rgyas thobaḥ 'gyur ba med pa'i byin chen phobaḥ phyi yi 'byung ba'i bcud bstus laX rnal 'byor nang gi lus la bsdim lus la bkrag mdangs bsted du gsolaḥ ngag la nus pa stsal du gsolaḥ sems la bde stong sbar du gsolaḥ ste 'chi med

pa'i tshe thob shogaḥ.aka.a la:ratsha shad rasapha ra ya phaṭaXtadu thāḥ aḥnyi rje0 ā yuḥpukhye sirnyi tshe hūṃ ḍāk+ki ni tshe spre hūṃ 〉 o rgyan mkha' spyod rol ba'i gnasaḥ gsangachen dur khrod 'jigs pa'i klong bdud 'dul mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdongaX 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcasaḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol mos palibu la dbang bzhi 'khor 'das 'byung lnga'i sgrub pa po yi lus la 'chi med ngag la 'gags med 'gyur ba phyi yi rnal 'byor lus la ngag la sems la skye 'chi aḥka los sogasaḥ ḍāk+ki ni tshe hūṃ hūṃ nyi tshad med thugs rje'i gter chen poḥ rab 'byams phrin las 'byung ba'i gzhiX rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i dbyings ma chen sengagadong rigs bzhi dngaX rdo rje'i las mdzad phra men brgyadaḥ dbang phyug ma sring bran g.yog bcasaX gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥmos palibu la dbang bzhi bskuraḥ 'khor 'das 'byung lja'i dwangs bcud bsdus skrub pa po yi dpal du stsol lus la 'chi med tshe dbang bskuraḥ ngag la 'gags med tshe rgyas thobaḥ 'byur ba med pa'i

la /sko: byin chen phobaḥ phyi yi 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus la rnal 'byor nang gi lus la bstimaḥ lus la bkrag mdangs bskyed du gsolaX ngag la nus pa stsal du gsolaḥ sems la bde sto sbar du gsol skye 'chi med pa'i tshe thob shogaḥ aḥka.aya:ratshasha dnga.am ra ya phaṭaḥ tadu shāḥ aḥnyin+niḥ.ā yuḥpukhye sidhi tshe hūṃ ḍāk+ki ni tshe hūṃḥhūṃ hrīX bka' nyan pho nya dam tshig canaḥ rdo rje ging gi tshogs rnams dngaX shugs chen mgyogs ma las mdzad rnamasaX rang rang g.yog 'khor sa ya 'bum dbang phyug ma yum sha za'i tshogasaḥ gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaX mos pa'i bu la dbang sogs nas ḍāk+ki ni tshe hūṃḥ zhes sngags bzla bzhin du tshe bum tshe cha rnams myang du gzhug go sla yang tshe rgyas gdab pa ni oṃ ni skyed med chos kyi dbyings sbyo ni lhun grub gzhal med khangaX tram̐ ni ye shes lnga yi sgogaḥhrīḥ yis 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bstimaX āḥyis 'gyur med tshe rgyas gdabaḥ hūṃ tra tra shagaḥ mu tra hoḥ tiṣ+ṭa lhanaḥ smon lam gdab pa na ma 'grar ba med pa'i bcom lngan 'dasaḥ tshe dbang rig 'dzin kun gyi bdag 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sma gsung thugs yon

tan phrin las ma lus pa skal ldan bu la legs thob nasaḥ don gnyis yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig lan gsum btabaḥ mkha' 'gro'i zab tig tshe sgrub 'di man ngag yongs kyi zab bcud de thugs srasarig pa 'dzan pa las skal med lag tu ma shor cig sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda zim snyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ta dang samarnya bha dra zung gi bskul ngor/ kho bo bdud 'jom khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha'a'agro'i 'phrul mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni puspyobha dras bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

—'di: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥ'adud 'dul drag mo seng gdong ma'i mngon spyod drag po'i sreg blugs dgra bgegs rdul rlog zhes bya ba bsdosags thegaX —8rdo: na mo dz+nyā na ḍazhi ni ya chos nyid zhi ba'i — nga nyid las log rtog 'dul mdzad khro mo'i sku 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sprin dpung 'khrigs bdud 'dul drag mo la phyag 'tshal de yang sgrub pa'i kha bskang phyar mngon spyod drag po las kyi gzhung bsrang nas phrin las lhun grub pa'i rab 'bar me ya las la brtsonaḥ sa ma yā bsreg dkyil rnams lnga nyer spyod dang sman gtor rak+ta nyer mkho'i rdzas thams cadam lus bsags par bya me thab drag po' shing gis brtsigs las mthun me dar rlung g.yab bkod slob dpon sngags kyi chas su zhugasaḥ bdag skyed gzhung bsrang tshogs bskang gto ཿ de nas mkha' 'gro'i 'bum bskul bya ragapa ngar bslang rtogs pa bskyed bgegs tshogs bsal la bsru gur phub bsregs sbya sa bsgyur la zad med spel de nas me thab sbar ba ni hūṃ ༷ bya grub ye shes rang bzhin 'bar ba'i me mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyi (1ba phyir sbaraḥ karma dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ḥ me bra ni drag po'i mi mtshan rtse ltar rno zhing kha dog ljang nag gi rnams par 'khyal zhing bdud bgegs rnams gzhob thul gyas bsregs pa' dbus su dur 11da lnga da

gtsasdo spyo dbyings nyid lasaḥ 'gags med gzugs sku'i phyag rgyar rab bzhengs teḥ mos ldan bu yi re 'dod skong ba'i phyiraḥ 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i las la bskulaḥ a dz+nyā na sedha ḍāk+ki ni sarba sa ma ya dza dzaX bzhugs gsol na dur khrod thod mkhar pad nyi bam gyi khar 0 ye shes me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil duX ma chen dam tshig bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lharaḥ ye shes lha tshogs 'bral med bzhugs su gsolaX badz+ras ma yatiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ phyag 'tshal ni na mo chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid lasaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pa'i bdud dang bgegs 'joms maX zil gnon drag mo seng ge'i gdong can la ༷ bskyang bskum 'gying bag gar gyis phyag 'tshal ma ཿ sarba.a2to pū ho pra ti dza hoḥ dragapo'i lha thams cad sku mdog mthing nag mun pa'i mad sa ldan gdug rtsubs kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing mngon spyod kyi las la dgyes par bskyed la bye mar phul teḥni byagrub yi shesachen po'i dgongs klong lasaX mngon spod mdzad pa sgrab pa'i dam tshig can zil gnon mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can la drag po sgrub pa'i

grogs su bdag gis bskulaX dz+nyā na ḍasko ni sarba dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ phyi mchod 'bul ba niḥhū sdi den dam spros bral chos sku'i dbyings nyid las gzhan don phrin las mdzad pa'i thabasamakhas pa zil gnon mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can la phyi yi mchod sprin nyer spyod sna tshogs 'bulaX dgyes bzhes sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsolaḥ mahā pañtsa sarba byu dza sa maya ho ༷rnal 'byor ba bdag gis mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir du dga' ston gyi mchod pa rgya chen po 'di bzhes la gang brtsam pa'i las te myur ba nyid dugrub par mdzod cigaX nang mchod 'bul ba niḥ hū nyi don dam bde ba chen pos dbyings nyid las rnams rol cir yang ngoms pa'i phrin las can zil gnon mkha' 'gro sengage'i gdong can laḥ nang mchod 'dod yon lnga yi dga' ston 'bul dgyes bzhes tshe dbang chos kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ.a ho mahā su kha pū dza sa ma ya ho sman mchod lasal ba naḥhū hrīrtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i a dṛ taḥ rigs lnga yab yum mnyam sbyor byin rlabs skyemasaḥ myong grol zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi 'di ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang phyir

gtsasdo: 'bulaḥ mahā pañtsa a dṛ ta khā hiX rak+ta 'bul ba niḥ hrīḥ nyon mongs chags pa bral ba'i dmar chen poḥ 'khor ba ka nas dag pa'i dga' ston rdzas sngags kyi dngos grub stsol byed dpa' ba'i skyemasaX ma chen mkha' 'gro'i dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bulaḥ o ma hā rak+ta la khā hiX gtor ma 'bul ba niḥ hrīḥ snang srid ro mnyam chen po'i ba lirnyaḥ'adod yon lnga yi 'od zer rab tu 'phroḥ snang srid ro mnyam ston pa'i dga' ston 'diḥ rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang phyir 'bulaḥ mahā bha lirnyi khā hiḥ de nas khrag zhag sa pho 'bul ba niḥ / hrīX nyon mongs chags pa bral ba'i khrag chen poḥ don dam ro mnyam ston pa'i tshil zhun gsosaḥ bde chen rdo rje'i dga' ston sha dang zhagaḥ ma chen thugs dam bskang phyir gus pas 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes rtogs pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsolaḥ zla mahā me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ko ro tsa na ki ni ri ti la khā hiḥ kun la 'ad nyid sbyar te rnal 'byor ba bdag gis mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i phyar du dga' ston gyi mchod pa rgya chen po 'di bzhes la gang brtsam pa'i las te myur ba nyid du grub par mdzod cig

'brog 'bring 'bul ba niḥ / nyi 'jigs pa brgyad sogs mi mthun zhi ba dngaḥ 'byor ba drug sogs dpal yon rgyas pa dang mos pa bzhi sogs dbang du 'du ba dngaX dgrabagegs rdul rlag drag mo'i phrin las kun lhun gyis grub phyir ma chen mkha' 'gro laḥ 'brog 'bring bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhesaḥs mahā a dṛ ta ra sa byu dza khā hi rnal 'byor ba bdag gis mngon spyod sogs 'gres la mdzod cig bsregs rdzas 'bul ba niḥ/ nyi sangs rgyas bstan la 'tshe zhing rgol ba yiḥ zhing bcu tshangs ba'i dgra bgegs malus paX myur du sgrol phyir drag po'i bsreg rdzas 'diḥ gus pa'i 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes su gsolaḥ bzhes nas sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang sems can yongs laphan bde spel du gsolaX bla kro tiseng ha mu kha nyariXniḥmasasnophaṭa gnod byed dgra bgegs sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya dz+wa la ram khā hiḥ brgya rtsa la sogs ci rigs brjod bar bar 'dod gsolagadab pa ni hūṃḥ gzhan snang zel gnon bdud 'dul drag mo'i lha tshogs 'khor da bcas pa rnams kyis bdud rtsi bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs
