bdud 'dul seng gdong mas bu yi rtogs pa bskyed pa'i phyir yang snying bzlas pa'i rgyas po 'di sprogs pas rlung sems rang dbang 'gyur skyes seng ha kā li ḍak+ki ni pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sa ma dhi tsit+ta sirnyi pha la (ཿ bla na med pa'i yang snying 'di sgrogs pas rnal 'byor nyams rtogs 'phelaḥ sa ma yuḥ ma chen bdud 'dul seng gdong mas bu la mkha' spyod dpal ster phyir gsang gsum gcig dril bzlas pa 'di rin chen srog dang sbrel nasa'achong ces o o dz+nyā na dhartu bud+dha ḍāk+ki ni badz+ra be+e ro tsa na ni pradz+nyā wazlo ni sa ma ya ḍāk+ki ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ mahā su kha sirnyi pha la a a ā dgongs pa mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang bsre rtags tu ma go zhal ras la ro gcig bsre ba'i dam tshig gas mkha' spyod gnas su byang chub 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ ma chen bdud 'dulaseng gdong mas bu la grub brgyad ster ba'i phyar o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i brda sngags 'di bzlasapas don gnyas 'grub phyir zungs snyen ka ṭā kha ṭ+wāṃ shrī 31 ki ni sa ma ya sirnyi pha la /༷ 'di bzlas mkha' 'gros bu bzhin skyongs grub pa brgyad la dbang 'byor 'gyuraḥ sa ma shāḥm chen bdud 'dul seng gdong mas bu la rtag tu snying nye zhing 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'grogs pa'i phyar sngags rdzong rdo rje'i 'bru bcu bzha a gaḥs ma raḥtsamigaḥdaḥr saḥmā ra ya phaṭa a nas bos pa'i dam tshig gis lha yi ma sring rgya mtsho 'grogs kaḥyis gnyan gyi ma sring 'khoraḥ sa yis

— mi: rin chen lcam sring nye maḥyis pad+ma'i ma tshogs 'duḥr yis las kya ma sring 'dud tsaḥyas gnas yul ma sring gdung sha yis dam tshig mkha' 'gro 'grogs da yis jag rten mkha' 'gro 'khor ra yisardo rje phra men 'duḥs yis rdo rje ma tshogs 'dud mā ra ya yis las la bzhengs ga yas don kun mdzad phyir du ṭaḥyis dgra bgegs rdul brlag gtor don dang ldan pa'i bzlas sngags 'di sgra cher bsgrags na dregs tshogasa'adar smra bcad bablos pas byad phur gzhesaḥ shub bur sgrogs pas mkha' 'gro nye yi dam la brten dngos grub thob don gnyis 'grub par gdon ma zaḥ sa ma yuḥm chen bdud 'dul seng gdong ma'i drag sngags yi ge 'byu bcubazhi dngos gnyen tshul du sgrogs shes na gang 'dod don rnams yin bzhin 'grubaḥḍa4)dzaga.amigag shig phyung phyung khrol khrol swāhāḥ 'ad la nus pa thob gyur na byad phur rbod gtong thams cad thubaḥ sa ma yuḥ ḍak+kini gaḥs ma thon thon swāhāḥ 'di la gnad du bsnun nus na mi phyugs sha ma bsdam pa thonaḥ sa ma yāḥ ḍā4gagika saḥ tri hrī stum bha ya sod 'di la nus mthu thob gyur na gza' grib la sogs grib rigs thubaḥ sam yāḥ ḍasko ne+e maXbase rasmo bhan+ta na sha ya ram̐ḥ 'di la nus mthu theng gyur na mo 'dre spun dgus gnod pa zhiḥ sa ma yuḥḍatshuganiraḥhu ra tri 'gong bse rag ram̐ ram̐ḥ 'di la grangs tshad 'byel nus na 'gong bo

spun dgu'i za kha gcodaḥ sa ma māḥ ḍak+ki ni tsaḥtri shi bo yakru bisnan ram̐ ram̐ḥ 'di la bzlas rga grangs 'byol na dri btsan gdug pa'i rgol ba zhiḥ sa ma yuḥ ḍāsko ni sha bhe the waṃ rog na 'dre rum tsa ya bisnan takṛta ram̐ ram̐ḥ 'di la bzlos grangs gnad theng na dus kyi 'byung po' rgol ba zhi sa ma pāḥ ḍak+ki ni da phe ram pra dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭaḥ 'ad la bzlas grangs gnad theng na dug gsum 'byung po sa sgol ba gzhomaḥ sa ma yuḥ ḍasko ni raḥsarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ni swāhāX 'di la 'bum bzlas rgyun disnyen na rims yam gdug pa kun thub 'gyuraḥ sa ma māḥḍāsko ni sa tsi tsi dz+wa la sarba bar zhum mā ra ya phaṭa 'di la bzlas grangasatshad 'khyol na mdzes dregs grum bu chu ser thubaḥ sa ma yāḥḍak+ki nai da shad sadzā 11 ga swāhāX nad brgya sngags gcag 'di bzlas pas gang la dmigasapa de gzhom 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥye ma mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i thugs khrag 'di zab pakun gyi yang ba da te skal ba can la gcig rgyud las ma du spel na bka' chad 'ong rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i tshe thugs kyi sras dang 'di 'phrad shogaḥ sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ snying norapad+ma chosa'agel ngor/snying tig mdzod 'dzin khyu drag pa sa/ snying bcud yi ge bsal byed pa/ snying slobabarje'i mang ge so/ sarba ma le/

ga6sdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasal chen bdud 'dul drag mo'iḥbasdus don sngags kyi gnad byang gsal ba'i lde mig zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ badz+ra: na mo dz+nyā na ḍasko ni ya 291151 ma cig bdud 'dul seng gdo ma'i phyi sgrub gnad kyis gzir ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du ba dang phrin las rab 'byams 'grub pa'i phyir gnadasngags thugs kyi ga'ur ni yin a re a re nyol nyol phud phud swāhāX'adi nyid 'bum phrag bzlas gyur na dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin gyis brlobs ma dang mkha' 'gro lus bston 'gyur sa ma wāḥnang sgrub gnad kyi gziraba'i tshe 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'grogs pa dang dbang byin daro sa grub stsal ba dang nyams rtogs bsod nams nor 'byor phyir gnad sngags zab pa 'a mde'u thu ni yin nig nal naig nalaḥpra mo thun pra mo thun dbang po dmigs dbang po dkrugs sems rtsa myos sems rtsa myosaḥkhug khug dza dzaḥ'adi nyid 'bum phrag bzlas gyur na ma sri mkha' 'gro 'grogs pa da ཿzas nor long spyod char ltar 'bebs mchogathun dngos 'grub thob par 'gyuraḥs ma yuḥgasang sgrub gnad kyi gzir ba'i tshe ma sring mkha' 'gro bran khol zhing bsod nams 'byor ba thob pa'i phyir gnad sngags pad+ma'i lcags kyu niḥyin bha ba nanaḥbha sa nanaḥbhi

sa nan rag ti nan rug tu nan tor tor phud phudaḥḍak+ki ni aḥgyi2ཿsems rtsa dkrugs sems rtsa dkrugs mngal gyi grong khyer dkrugs mngal gyi grong khyer dkrugs yang yang phud phud swāhwa ā raX ya dza dza 'di nyid 'bum phrag bzla gyur na lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'gyur skyes pa pho mo'i blo yid 'gugs zas nor long spyod char ltar 'bebs rnam thos sras dang skal ba mnyam sa ma māḥnor sgrub gnad kyis gzir ba' tshe bsod nams 'byor ba thob pa dang mnga' thang yon to rgyas pa'i phyir gnad sngags 'od zer 'khor lo niko'u thā malja gdug ta hūṃ dzaḥ.a nyi2 sarba dung dung tsit+ta hrī hrī dza hrīḥha sri pha la ba su na de puṣ+ṭa ku ru hūṃḥpu sa na ka na pa la hrī hro ཿmahā de wa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa rat+na sirnyi pha la bdag la 'dus 'dus swāhāX 'di nyid 'bum phrag bgrang byas na ma sringamakha' 'gro bran du 'khol srid gsum dkor nor dbang du ra nor bdag tshogs kyis snying nye'oḥshan tu zab pa'i rno nus yodaḥsam shāḥtshe sgrub gnad kyisagazir ba'i tshe thugs gar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng mkha' 'gro sde bzhis bro gar bsgyur 'od zer pad+ma'i lcags kyu yisaḥ'akhor 'ad dwang bcud tshe yi dpal 'byu gsum rnam par bsdus te bstim tadu shā aji41ཿā yuḥpukhye sirnyi tshe hūṃ ḍak+ki ni tshe hūṃ bzla pa 'bum phrag sgogs

ga6rdo: gyur na mkha' 'gros bu bzhin srung ba dang 'chi med tshe yi dbang chen thobaḥ don gnyis lhun gyis grub par 'gyur yem 'chi med rig 'jin pa da 'byung ngas skal ldan smin cing grol ba'i phyir thugasakyi man ngag zab rgya can 'gyur med ra bsrel rgyar bcug nas mdo khams gsung gi gnas su sbas tshogs smon las 'phro dus 'dzom tshe skyabs mchog sprul ba'i dpal du sharaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgyaḥ dam can lha lngas thub parasrungs gurgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥzhes pa 'di'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ta dang sa man+ta bha dra zu gis bskul ngor/kho bo bdud masdomasakhyung drag rtsal kyis mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'ayi gepa nipukhye bha drasabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba make lam̐/
badz+ra: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX gter bdag sha za'idrag sgrub mde'u thung dug gi ngad zer can bzhugs soḥ

ba rdo: namodz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni paḥ cas zas ma 'ongs las ldanasnying rus can bsnyen sgrub lta spyod gnad 'a nga la bar chad dgra yisargol sbyor tshe drag po' mde'u thung gnad la brtsonaḥ sam māḥ drag po'i dkyil 'khoramada' gang ba dug khrag phung shul sa sbyar bca' lding khrir sha za'i gtor ma la rtsang mtshe brgyan cing dug khrag byug gams g.yon las mkhan rnams gnyis kyiḥ gtor ma zhal shes ltar du bya phyi rim drag 'khor rtsibs bzhi'i nang sha za mched bzhi'i gtor ma bca' lte bar gru gsum sum bskor nang dgra ling ming rus mkhan gsum dang zag rdos byugasanas bkod par bya phyi ram rtsang rwa ke yungs mtshe phun sum tshogs par byaganas su bdag bskyed mkha' 'gro'i bskyed bzlas rjes mdun skyed ba ོma pa'i rim pa niḥ yo swā bha wa sogs nas shuzlo3nyaḥ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du zangs thang dmar po dbang gi 'od chen 'byugs paḥ rak+ta'i mtsho chen po 'khyil ba las rba rlabs kun tu g.yo baḥ sha za dang ro langs lce spyang gi tshogs rnams kyis dgra bo'i sha khrag la hab thob byed pa phyi me rlung rab tu 'tshubs ma'i dbus su king rus dang 'byung po me khyer rnams rgyu zhing 'phro ba dur bya king ka dang sha gtsug can dang bla dor can la sogs pa mang po 'phur ldings dang

gtsasdo tsa mdur rngams byed paḥ de lta bu'i rak+ta'i rba klung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su mi ro dang rta ro bsnol ba'i khri yi khar bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin chen mo zhing bcu sgrolaba'i dpa' rngams can zhing khang dang gtsug lag gnas kyi srung ma rnal 'byor ba yongs kyi dkor srungag za mi snyeng rlon 'phrog chen mo niḥ khrag mdog zhal gyi sogs mngon rtogaraltar/ sib sib bstimaḥ spyan 'dren ni hūṃ hrī byang phyoges 'a༄yul zangs brag ldem pa nasaḥ sha za chen mo 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ rgya gar dur khrod tshang tshab 'khrugs pa nas ༷ bstanasrung chen mo 'bod do da tshur byon bad yul rdzangs lnga pad+ma'i mtsho gling nasaX dur khrod 'dre mo 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ rnal 'byor gar bzhugs gsang spyod pho bra nasaX dam ldanam chen 'bod do da tshur byonaḥ dgra la rbad do nus mthu rtsal ma zhan bgegs la bzor ro rno ngar stobs ma chung mngon spyod phrin las sgrubs shig dam tshig canaḥsgro ma hūṃ tsa sar mu kha snyi kha rasmo dung dub 'dus 'dus dza dzaX bzhugs gsol ni two stso shing bcu shan pa lag dmar gzugs bkod stengaḥ dam tshig ma chen sha za'i dkyil 'khor dang

gnyis med rol pa chen por dgyes bzhugs nas grub rtags phrin las gang bcol stsal du gsol spyo ma hū tsatu mu kha snying kha rasmo dung dung 'dus 'dus dzaḥ/ bam hoḥ phyag 'tshal niḥ na moḥ dpal chen kun dngosapad+ma thod phreng rtsal gang gi bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pa'iX dur khrod 'dre mo yongs kyi gtso bo che srog 'dren dmar mo 'khor dang bcas la 'dudaḥ bh+yo ma hūṃ tsa tur mu kha snying kha rasmo sarba sa ma ya na mo na ma hoḥ mchod 'bul ni smyoḥ sngags bdag chen mo sha za'i dmag tshogs laḥ dgyes bskang dgra bo'i sha rus brag gsum dngaḥ rnam lnga'i longs spyod ja chang rak+ta'i skyems0 nal bu'i sha gsur rkang gling thod rnga sogs thugs mthun sgrub rten mchod bskang rdzas rnams kyisaḥ sha za chen mo mi snying rlon 'phrog ma phyag bsnyen zung dang dmag 'gyed rgyal mo bzhiḥ dur khrod 'dre mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangasaḥ mngon spyod phrin las lhun gyis grub par mdzodaḥ bh+yo ma hū tsatur mu kha snying kha rasmo sa pa ri wā ra me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha ram khāhiḥ pañtsa a pra ta bha listo ga ṇa tsakra la khā hiX gnyer bcol ni ho dgongs su gsol loḥ ma chen sha za ḍāk+ki

gtsasdo: mi snying rlon 'phrog nag mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol de gi gnas mchog dam pa 'dir bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsrengs shigaḥ dpal bskyed cigaḥ lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa dang phrin las gang brtsam kyang de dag thams cad thogs pa med par sgrubs shig sku che dang chos grwa la 'tshe ba'i dgra dpung rtsad nas chod cigaḥ bgegs dpung rdul du rlog cigaḥ rnal 'byor ba'i mthun rkyen zas nor longs spyod 'byor ba thams cad srungs shigaḥ med pa thams cad thogs med du stsol cigaḥzab gter gyi sgron me phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cigaḥ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrogs shigaḥ chos mthun gyi mdzadapa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyis shigaḥ lta log sgro btags mkhan thams cad mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis tshar chod cig ma ma yak+ka dung dung tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma yā bstod pa na hūṃ 1 gru gsum gshin rjelisto ba mun pa'i glingaḥ 'jigs pa'i rgyar tshud sdang dgra pho mo'i stengaḥ dug khrag me rlung 'tshubs ma 'khyil ba'i dbus dam tshig mkha'

'gror shar la phyag 'tshal bstod li yul gsang sngags bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin maḥ rgya gar paṇa grub yongs kyi srang gcig mo bod khams sbas gnas yongs kyi gnyer 'dzin pa'i sha za ḍāk+ki'i gtso mor phyag 'tshal bstod re 'ga' zhing skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs grwal rgyugaX re 'ga' rig dang sngags kyi dga' ston spyodaX phyi nang gnyis su rgyu ba'i shan 'byed maḥ ma chen srog gi bdag mor phyag 'tshal bstodaX rgya mtsho chu la dbang bsgyur chu srin gdong ri rab zom la 'jug pa'i dred gdong ma ltas ngan phung 'gyed dbang ba'i ma chen bzhi bka' 'khor yongs rdzogs bcas la phyag 'tshal stodaḥ gtso mos nam mkha'i khams nas legs nyes gzigasaX phyag bsnyen zung ni bar snang khams nas rgyuḥ sha za mched bzhi sa gzhi'i steng du bstenaX khams gsum bya ra byed la phyag 'tshal bstod dgongs sngon dbyings las gza' dang skar mda' 'phenaX bar snang khams nas thog ser bu yug 'tshubasaḥ 'degs pa'i gzhi nas spyo 'bog ltas ngan 'gyedaḥ ma chen rdzu 'phrul can la phyag 'tshal bstodaX bzlas dmigs ni bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i

de'adi: dbyibs can 'phros pas ma chen 'khor bcas la phogaḥ sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas rnal 'byor bas ci bcol ba'i las byed zhes zer zhing sgog snying phul bar bsam laX bh+yo ma hūṃ tsa tur mu kha snying kha rasmo dung dung 'dus 'dus dza dzaḥ smra bcad byas la bdun zhag gi bar du bsgrub tshe bud med kyi tshogs 'du ba dang sgo brdung zhing sgra thug chom du sgrogs pa dang me stag 'phro zhi ma nges pa 'i dra 'thul ba gzhan yang khyad par ba'i rtags sna tshogs 'byung tshe dam bsgrags kyi gzir zhing las chu bran la srog gcag tu bsre'oḥ sa ma ma ga'aX/ yang nam mkha'i khams nas 11ga gi dbang phyug mo dngaḥ sa khams nas sra ba'i dbang phyug mo dngaḥ chu khams nas rlan gyi dbang phyug mo dngaḥ me khams nas 'bar ba'i dbang phyug mo dngaḥ rlung khams nas bskyod pa'i dbang phyug mo gtso 'khor sprul ba dang bcas pa thams cad zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dus dang bstun nasaḥ dkar mo'i tshogs dngaX ser mo'i tshogs dngaḥ dmar mo'i tshogs dngaḥljang ku dang mthing ga'i rnam pa'i tshogs dpag tu med par bun ling ling byon nas bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa la sib sib bstim nasaḥ bzlas pa bya'oḥ yang bar skabs su rang gi thugs

kyi thugs sgog gis bskul teX li yul nas sha za mo rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rnam par spyan drangasaḥ rgya gar nas dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i rnam pa rdzong lnga mtsho chen brgyad nas mi srun drag mo khros pa'i rnams 'gyur can dpag tu med pa bskul te byung nas dam tshig pa dang ro gcig tu bsres laḥ dgongs pa' gzir bzhin sngags bzla'oḥ dam tshig ni tsa tur mu khas ma bos na mkha' 'gro gnad la 'du ma nus snying kha rasmo ma bsgrags na mkha' 'gro'i snyi yang nye mi nus dung dung 'dus dza ma bsgrags na mkha' 'gro las la 'jun mi 'gyur grog snyeng rnam gsum ma gzhug na gsang ba'i dngosagrub sbyan la g.yel de dag sgrub pa'i dam tshag go 'od zer dra bsam bcing na sha za'i tshogs ni nas la rkyen grog chu len la ma mkhas na snyi nga ya nye bar ma 'gyur ro tshogasaston mchod pasam brngan na zas nor longs spyod mi ster ro mnol bsang gtsang sbra ma brtson na mkha' 'gro 'khur rtags cho 'phrul ston rnal 'byor dam tshag ldan pa rnams blang dor gnas la zhab rgyas brtsonaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya de nas 'bod pa'i bskul ba ni gtor skyems 'gugs bstim sbyangs bsgyur spel lha gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags 'di skad do bh+yo dzaḥ li yul dur khrod e shi gaḥ dri thang zangs brag dmar bo nasaḥ pha ni bdud la ma ni klu klu

badz+ra: bdud yongs kyi sring gcig moḥ sha za rdo rje drag rtsal dpal 'bod cing bskul lo da tshur byonaḥrgya gar dur khrod tshang 'khrigs nasaḥ rig 'dzin yongs kyi sring gcig moḥ dam tshig mkha' 'gro bzhad pa canaḥ'abod cing bskul 'o da tshur byonaḥbod yul rdzong lnga mtsho brgyad nasaX sngags kyi dbang phyug grogs mo cheḥsha za mi snying rlona'aphrog maḥ 'bod cing bskul lo rgya mtsho chu yi klong dkyil nasaḥ klu gnyan sa bdag gtod kyi sringaḥ las mdzad chu srin mgo brnyan canaḥ 'bod cing bskul ri rab chen po'i khong seng nasaX dregs pa yongs kyi lcam gcig moḥ bka' nyan dred kyi mgo brnyan canaḥ 'bod cibhe dgra sha za ba'i mthu mo cheḥ dur byed nag mo mun pa'i mdogaḥ phung 'byedaphag dkar cho 'phrul mkhanaḥ 'bod cing bskul lo dgra snyeng 'byen pa'i mthu mo cheḥ kha kha mthing nag bya rog gdong cho 'phrul sprel ser 'gyed pa moḥ 'bod cing dgra sgog gcod pa'i mthu mo cheḥhu lu smug nag 'ug pa'i gdongaḥ cho 'phrul gser 'phar 'gyed pa moḥ 'bod cing dgra dbugs sdud pa'i mthu mo che he le ljang nag spyang gdong ma

cho 'phrul khyi nag bla rkun 'byed 'bod cing dam tshig can gyi sha za moḥ gtso dang 'khor zung phyag brnyan bzhiX rang rang sprul ba 'bum 'bum bcasaḥ 'bod cing bskul lo datshur byon dgra la bab na mthu ma chungaḥ bgeg la bab na rtsal ma zhanaḥ mngon spyod phrin las dus la babaḥ bla rdo sgog 'khor rten la bzhugasaḥ rtags dang mtshan ma bzang poston thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yāX ma chen sha za mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa'i sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas 'bod pa'i phrin las la snying nye zhing bcol ba'i don thamasacad gegs med du 'grub par bsam laḥ bh+yo ka li mu kha tsa tur0 snying kha rasmo tsit+ta dung dung 'dus 'dus dza dza 'bod sngags chu bo' gzhung bsko bzla 'bod rtags sha za daro sa su 'o sa phrin lasasgrub pa 'a rtags mtshan gsal the tshom med do sa ma yuḥ skabs su rbad pa'i bskul ba ni gtor skyems 'gugs gzhug sbyangs bsgyur spel rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal rgyas drag mo las la rbad pa ni je ཿ ga/(5 drag 'jigs su rung ba nasaḥ sha za mi snying rlon 'phrog maḥ rbad cing bskul lo las la rgyugaX maro na spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ dpag med rgya mtsho'i klong dkyil nas za byed chu srin gdong

badz+ra— can maX rbad cing bskul lo mngon spyod phrin las ri rab chen po'i klong dkyil nasaḥ gsod byed 'bar ma dred kyi gdong rbad cing bskul lo mngon spyod chu khams bdag tu bzung ba moḥ dur byed nag mo 'khor dang bcasaḥ rbad cing mngon spyod 'byung ba sa la dbang 'gyur ba'iḥ kha kha mthing nag 'khor dang bcas rbad cing bskul lo mngon spyod me khams drod la gnas pa moḥ hu lu smug nag 'khor dang bcasaḥ rbad cing mngon spyod ༷ rlung gi khams la brten bcas pa'iḥ he le ljang nag 'khor dang bcasaḥ rbad cing mngon skye med dbying sa la dbang bsgyur zhing 'gags med sgyu ma'i brda chos ngomasaḥ ma tshogs sprul ba 'bum 'bum bcasaḥ rbad cing bskul lo las la rgyugaX mngon spyod brin las grub par mdzodaḥ dgra la dpa' rtags cho 'phrul stonaḥ than dang ltas ngan mig 'phrul zhigaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos ston re ranaḥ dus la bab so sa ma yāḥ ma g.yel ma 'khyangs dam tshig canaḥ bh+yo ma hūṃ tsit+ta ka li mu kha snying kha rasmo dung dung 'dus 'dus dgra la rbad smra bcad ti 'dzin gzir bzhin bzla de tshe rbad rtags dngos su 'byu ཿ

dgra dpung pha lam yin kyang 'jig bgegs dpung rtsad nas gcod par 'gyuraḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya de nas bsad pa'i bskul ba ni tshil gsur dud dang rol mo sgogs gtum rngams dbyangs kyis 'di skad doḥ / rje bas pa drag 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas: me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nasaḥ sha za mi snying rlon 'phrog maḥ gnad nas bskul lo las la bzhengs bsad rtags don snying mngon sum sprod rgya mtsho chen po' klong dkyil nas phyag bsnyen chu srin gdong can maḥ gnad nas bskul lo las la dgra bsad dpa' rtags mngon sum ston ri rab chen po'i steng klong nasaḥ phyag brnyen chen mo dred gdong ma gnad nas bskul lo dgra bsad dpa' rtags mngon sum stonaḥ chu khams dbang bsgyur sha za moḥ dur byed nag mo 'khor dang bcasaḥ gnad nas bskul lo dgra bo'i khrag gzhib skem par mdzodaḥ sa khams dbang bsgyur sha za moḥ kha kha mthing nag 'khor dang bcasaḥ gnad nas bskul dgra bo'i sha zo rus par gtugaḥ me khams dbang bsgyur sha za moḥ hu lu spug nag 'khor dang bcasaX gnad nas bskul lo las la bzhengasaḥ dgra bo'i drod zlog skye rgyud chod rlung

—8rdo: khams dbang bsgyur sha za mo: he le ljang nag 'khor dang bcas: gnad nas bskul lo las la bzhengs: dgra dbugs sdud cing 'bog brgyal sodaḥ yang sprul bye ba sa ya 'bumaḥ kun kyang thogs med stobs bskyed laḥ mngon spyod ston phyir las la bzhengasaḥ dgra bo'i yul du than sna stonaḥ phugs su wa mo brgyal du chug ༷ sgo la sprel dmag 'ong du chugaḥ khyim nang a tsa ra yis khongasaḥ sgyed po sbrul gyis spras su chugaX me 'bar rang thag 'khor du chug sbra gur chon thag sbir du chugaX pho gdong sked nas chag par gyisaḥ nang dme shi chad 'ong du chugaḥ 'gags sri phung 'thab sna dgu 'byedaḥ dmar bshal rgyug 'gyel gza' grib thongs me stag chu dang 'phrad pa bzhin dgra bo ming tsam med par mdzodaḥ dgra sha zan ltar zas su zo dgra khrag chang ltar skoms su 'thungaX dgra rus mar ba'i sla bar rolaḥ bsad rtags don snying dmar po teḥ ma 'khyangs mngon sum bdag la ston drag po mngon spyod phrin las teḥ myur du ston mdzod dam tshig canaḥ bh+yo ma hūṃ tsit+ta ka li snying kha rasmo dung dung 'dus 'dus dzoḥnyisha krung hur sum̐ dza mā ra ya rbad

thegadaX drag sngags shub bur bzlas pa yis dgra dpung thal bar brlag nus shing bgegs tshogs rtsad nas gcod par 'gyur rno nus byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya denas e bskyed ni bdag nyid bdud 'dul drag mor gsal ba'i mdun du e las gru gsum gshin rje'i bsha' khang nag po dug lnga rang gshed du dbab pa'i mtshon thun sna tshogs g.yo zhing 'khrigs pa'i klong du dṛ triḥyongs su gyur pa las rnal 'byor ba bdag cag la 'tshe zhing rgol ba'i dgra bgegs rnams kyi rus pa mdog sngo la mdangs nyams pa nyam thag dbugs dang bral la khad 'dar phri li li byed cing rkang lag lcags gzer gyis theb pa bu ga dgu nas rnag khrag 'dzag cing kha nas mya ngan gyi 'o dod tse re re 'don pa gcig tu gsal gdabaX de yi sa bon dṛ tri gsal ba las 'od 'phros pas dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas gzugs liṅga la yang yang bstim mo bden brjod niḥ na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal loX mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i mthusaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems

—rten— can gyi bde skyid 'phrog pa'i bdud sde dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cigaḥ bstim cigaḥdṛtre+em ba ya dzaḥbaṃ hoḥ nyer gcig brgya rtsa la sogs 'gugs rtags ma byung gi bar du bzla'oḥ'agugs thung niḥn 31 ༷mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dngaḥ bden gnyis bslu med nus mthus stobs khyangabadud 'dul seng gdong maḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dngaḥ ma chen sha za'i bden stobs kyis bdag la sdang ba'i tshegemoḥ phu nu nye 'khor rtsa lag bcas dbang med par lcags kyus zungasaḥ zhags pas chings la sgog gis bsdomasaḥ dril bus blo sems myos byas teḥ gzugs kyi rten dang dbyer med bstimaḥ dzahūṃ baṃ hoḥ ci ma'agugs 'ching sdom myos ni yin badz+ra o ku sha dzaX dgra bgegs mā ra ya thum ri li li chings chings dgra bgegs mā ra ya bhan+ta ya bhan+ta ya sgo ṭa baṃḥ dgra bgegs dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa yaḥ karma garnye hoḥ dgra bgegs dṛ tri pra we sha ya phaṭaḥ skyobs byed kyi lha srung kun dang phyes shig khrol zhig mā ra ya phaṭaX de nas dgra la khrag nad dbab phyir sgrul dang 'ug pa byi ba'i khrag

bsres te gri thod nang du chu yis nyams par sbyangs nas 'di skad doḥhū bh+yoḥ 'jigs rung srin mo khros 'dra'i sku dgra bsad shan pa lag dmar gzugasaḥ sha za mi snying rlon phrog maḥzung dang las mkhan bzhi yang g.yog 'bum 'bum bsam mtha' yasaḥ sngon gyi tha tshig bsgrags bzhin du 'bod do ma g.yel da tshur byonaḥ brgyan pa'i mchodabazhes laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i che ge moḥ phu nu nye ba g.yog 'khor bcasaḥ mar me rlung dang 'phrad pa bzhinaḥ ma mo'i mngal khrag nad rim gyisaX pho rgyud skyes pa rtsamo rgyud bud med drung nas byu chung gsum byis pa mngal nas skemaḥ nye 'khor rtsa lag gshed du bsgyur gri 'thab mtshon gyis char ba phob ltas ngan sna dgudakrugasaX phung brlag khrag gi char ba phob0 mngon spyod drag rtsal khyad chos stonaḥ dus la bab po sa ma āḥ sno raspo bh+yo yasmo bh+yo tsa tur mu kha tsit+ta ka li rbad dza ro ru puslong ro ru phu ru rak+ta dkrugs dkrugs ro ru phu ru rak+ta phob cig dzaḥ hū baṃ hoX dgra bgegs mā ra ya sodaḥ a mu ka myag dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya hur hūṃ rgyug 'gyelaḥ ba

—8rdo khrag la gzir de tshe khrag rul gyi dri ngan 'thul zhi tshag sgra da bcas te byung na grub pa 'i rtags tshad do do gal che na gnad la gzir ba ni bh+yo sha za mi snying rlon phrog maḥ shin tu khros pa'i rnam 'gyur stonaḥ gcer mo sbrul dang rgyu mas brgyanaḥ khragagi ral ba rgyab du 'phyings mche ba gtsags shing ha ha sgodaḥ spyan ni nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'khyugaḥ rak+ta'i zhal chu thor thor 'bebasaX 'ari gas rung srin mo'i khros nyams canaḥ zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur gsang ba nasaḥ rak+ta char rgyun bzhin du 'bebasaX yid la brnag pa'i che ge moḥ khrag rims nad sna glo bur ston srung bzlog gto yis mi bsgyur bar 'phrad dang gsod pa dus mnyam gyisaḥ tshang rlog shul med phung bar mdzodadrag rtsal khyad chos myur du stonaḥ ma mo sgrub pa chud ma gsanaḥ sha za bskul lo las ma g.yelaḥ mngag pa'i pho nya lag ma sdumaX gsod byed mtshon cha ngar ma zhanaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos stobs ma chu ཿ da lta nyid du dus la babs mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ ma mo nag mo dun bh+yo dzoḥtriḥ.a mu ka mā ra ya rbadaḥ raku a be sha ya a be sha yaḥ mā ra ya phob dza phob dzaX zhes brjod nas dgra bgegs kyi gnas

rnams su khrag zigs bkram la dgra bo khrag nad kyis gzer zhing 'bog nas brgyal te ming med du brlag par bsam moḥ de nas sha za'i gtor ma rnams gtegs te liṅga'i steng du bzer nas 'di skad doḥ rje ཿ ma chen ro/ za dam tshig can mi snying rlon phrog mthu mo cheX bka' 'khor sprul ba g.yog dang bcasaX do nub zor gyi dmag la chosaX gtor ma las gyi mtshon char bsgyur ngu 'bod bcas te dgra la rgyug sbra khyim 'dre mo'i dmag dgar thob bza' mi rnams kyi ming nas bosaḥ mgo skras 'then la nyes pa sgrogasaX glo bur spyo 'bog gzer nad phob 'gags sri mtshon sri nang dme ston nad rims shi chad glo bur thongs ming tsam med par rdul du rlog drag po mngon spyod las mdzod cig bh+yoX tsa tur mu kha snying kha rasmo dgra la rbad bh+yo sarba sha chung nyung rdu dza mā ra ya dṛ tri rbad sodaX ma mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyi sod sod chod chod kyi sgra sgrogs bzhin mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i char dbab te dgra yi dpung tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bsam moḥ gtor zor dgra lang ste du sdebs de nas tsher ma' hom gru gsum me sngar te reX srid gsum me yi dkyil 'khor chen po'i klongaX rngam brjid sha

gtsasdo: za mi snying rlon 'phrog ma sprul ba g.yog bcas khros pa'i rnam 'gyur canaḥ me yi tshwa tshwa glog gi 'od zer 'phro rngam brjid zhal gyi hom khung gdengs pa yisaXrno dkar mche ba ljags kyi sbu gu yisaX dgra bo'i tshe sgog drod dbugs chub kyis drongs rnams shes skye med dbyings su dgongs rgyas thobaḥ kun rdzob mtshang stong yul med rol bar bsgyur bh+yo ma hūṃ tsa tur mu kha snyi kha rasmo bh+yo dza dṛ a mu ga'i me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khāhiX hub ya rngub ya tshal ba dum bur gtub yaḥ rgyug 'gyel khrag rims phob dza rbad sod kha ram̐ khāhiḥ brgya rtsa brjod la lisgo bstabs bh+yoX ma chen mkha' 'gro de bzhin nyid du bsduḥ snyigs ma'i thal sol dgra ru dmigs byas teX klu bdud btsan gyi lto bar gtad du bcolaḥnam yang thar 'chor med pa'i dam tshig zungasaḥ tho aX hūṃ swāhā s+t+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ de nas dmod bcol gdab pa niḥ hoX dgongs su gsol loX ma chen sha za mi snying rlon 'phrog chen mo /byod o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng gi bka' tha tshig la gnas naḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo che ge mo blo ya gros rog dang bcas pa nye 'khor rtsa lag lhag lus med par lo zla bar mi

'khyangs bar khrag nad kyi char phob cigaḥ nang dme dang 'gags sri sna tshogs glo bur ston zhigaX gza' grib dang gdong thug sna tshogs ston cigaḥ dgra bo'i skyes pa la babs na brag dmar thog gis bshig pa bzhin du rlog cig: dgra bo'i bud med la bab na lhug bran zor bas brngas pa bzhin du thongs shigaḥ dgra bo'i dkor nor la bab na sran phung ber gas bsnun bzhin rlog cig dgra bo'i tshe srog la bab na mar me rlung dang 'phrad pa bzhin du thongs shigaḥ hoḥ ma chen khyod la mthu yod na da lta nyid du dgra la ston cigaḥdapa' rngams yod na bskyed cigaḥ nus pa yod na phyungs shig dam tshig dang ldan na myur ba nyid du mngon spyod drag po'i brin las mdzod cigaX dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' ma basmuḥ o rgyan pad+ma'i dam las ma g.yelaḥ rnal 'byer sgrub pa pos bsnyen sgrub chud zos su mi byed par sdang dgra che ge mo'i srog snying drod mor bzhes laX slo snying las rak+ta zham chu bzhin du mngon sum la sprod cigaḥ mthu yi grags pa rgyal khams yongs la sgrogs shing bstan pa'i che ba bskyed cigaḥ ma mo snying kha ra1 dgra la rbad bh+yoḥ de ltar dmod tshag 'di phyag

de'adi: brnyen zu dang ma chen bzhi la sbyar nas brdar ro de ltar bdud 'dul drag mo yi las mdzad sha za'i drag sgrub 'dis dgra da bgegs dpu thal bar rlog mthu che stobs ldan snyan pa rgyas bshad sgrub chos kyi gzhi 'aca ga cing khrel med ar cag byed rnams 'dul nag ro bdud rigs sma pha bas nus yon tan nam mkha' mtha' dang mnyam che btsan srid na mtshu sa dpe bral rno nus nam mkha'i thog dang mnyam bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsalaX skal ba can gyis da la du shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ye maḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma' gsang mdzod 'di zla gam dbang ga gzhal yas nas dus bab mkha' 'gros basprad pa 'i brda shin tu zab po bka' rgyas sdoms guh+ya brda zim snyiḥ zhes pa 'di'ang lung zan drag sngagasadabang phyug kun bzang nas bskul ngor/ nas po nus ldan khyung drag rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pubyebha dras bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo le/

— mi: gab pa'i gnad3ni: dred lcags las byas theb rgyugs la spre'u'i khrag gis 'ad ltar bri rku jag 'phrog par shom pa'i mgo la tsakra 'ur 'ur snying la tsakra 'ur 'ur 'gros la tsakra 'ur 'ur ces bris srog shing se ba' bya mkho ba'i dus su bskor bar bya nga ga nas 'ad nyid stong rtsa brjod da dgra ya le ya le swāhāḥ phyogs tha dad du dgra bo tsakra kyi li li rtsibs la bskyon nas byer dzaX brgya brjod khyi ra phag gsum gyis re ba'i khul 'ur bcug byas te dgra rnams ring nasanye mi nus gnod pas mi tshug sa ma yuḥ de yang mkha' 'gro la brten nas za sasog byed phran las bcol 'di la the tshom za mi dgos pad+ma'i gtan tshag min re gan su la ma shor bka' rgyas thob brda thim lha rkun ma mgo bskor gyi zab gnad rdzogs so

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaX gter bdag sha za spun gsum gyisaḥ drag bskul dgra bgegs tshar gcod bzhugs soḥ/'di: namodz+nyā na ḍak+ki ji yaḥ tsu tsam ma 'ongs las ldan sgrub mchog la nyams pa dgra yi rgol byung na mngon spyod las kyis tshar gcod phyir drag bskang 'di la 'bad pa ra byaḥ sa ma yāḥ gtor skyems dgra ru dmigs byas te dgra gegs 'gugs bstims mtshon char pha ba sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshor bsgyur de nyid zag med bdud rtsir spro rang nyid lhar gsal nga rgyal gyisaḥ bh+yoḥ dug khrag 'dres pa'i klong dkyil nasaḥsha za chen mo dgra la rgyugasaḥ nyams pa'i snying gi mchod pa bzhesaḥ dgra yul khrag nad char ltar phobaḥ thog ser 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nasaḥ chu srin gdong can dgra la rgyugasaḥ nyams pa'i khrag rtsa 'di bzhes laḥ dgra yul bud med 'ur sgras khengs me rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nas dred gdong dmar mo dgra la rgyugasaḥ nyams pa'i sgog rtsa 'di bzhes laḥ dgra yul a tsa ra yis khongasaX dur byed nag mo dgra la rgyugasaX nyams pa'i sha la dmar g.yos kyis kha kha mthing nag dgra la rgyugasaX nyams pa'i rus la

krum krum rolaX hu lu spug nag dgra la rgyugasaḥ nyams pa'i khrag la hub rol kyisaḥ he le ljang nag dgra la rgyugasaḥ nyams pa'i dbugs la dgyes bzhin spyod ༷ sha za'i dmag tshogs dgra la rgyugasaḥ nyams pa'i phung khams skye mched rolaḥ dgra la yo log ltas ngan thongasaḥ phag dkar mi ro 'phen du chug sprel ser nad skyal rdeb tu chugaḥ gser 'phar mtshon cha gtor du chugaḥ khyi nag bla la 'jab tu chugaḥ dgra yi ban la khrag nad thobaḥ dgra yi skyes pa mtshon 'khrugs sodaḥ dgra yi bud med 'gags srir chugaḥ dgra yi byis pa chung sri'i zoX nor phyugs phung thal glo ton thongasaḥ phu nu nye ba shul med mdzodaḥ mngon spyod drag pa'i phrin las mdzodaḥsha za bdud mo'i dmag tshogs rnams mngag pa'i las de ma byas naḥ da sngon sgrub pa don med pas khyod kyi sgog la gzir da reX nyams pa'i dbang gi phyi ma mnaraX rdo rje'i dmyal bar sa ma yāḥ de bas ma g.yel dam la 'dusaḥ dkon mchog bden pa chud ma gsanaX rgyu 'bras bslu med mgo ma skor spyo ma dza hū snying la dung rdo rje khrag 'thung nag po yisaX khyod kyi snyib la chad pa'i chodaḥ ma mo rak+ka raspo ya yaX

—8rdo bh+yo bh+yo ༷rgyugs rgyugasaḥsarba hṝ tri ga hūṃ mā ra ya rbad sod dgra phyogs gtor skyems brdab byas te dmod bor nyes bsgrags ral g.yab des ni dgra dpu tshar gcod 'gyur ze tshom med do sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya oṃm rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thug kya bcudaḥdabang mdzod sgrom rgyas btab pa nyid dus su ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bskul rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir rin chen shog skyar pheb pa lags sa ma māḥrgya rgya rgya gurgya brda thim snyi zhes sngags skyesakun bzang bstan 'arin dar rgyas nas bkra shis la reg ran chen gnyis pa 'i skyes bcas bskul ngor/kho bo bdud 'joms nam mkha'i rdo re sa dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba skyo 'a 34/

—8 : ba//la byang khrag mda' dmar lnga ni phung shul gya sa sna bsres pa sa khrag skong nang du dug shog la dug snas dgra bo' mi nga bris pa 'i sdong bu bcug dgra bo g.yul du shi ba'i rkang ga zhun marabaltarma la 'gugs gzhug mang du byas mthar dgra bo' tshe srog la me sbar te bya ཿ bskul man sha za mi snying rlon 'phrog maḥ rak+ta khrag gi rba 1nga 'khyil dbus nasaḥ rlung las myur ba'i bang rtsalarlabs po chesaḥ sha za'i dmag bsdus dgra bo'i yul du chos ༷ dpa' skyems bzhes la than gyi char ba phobaḥ kai bsī 'ur sgrogs 4 'bod sna tshogs bcasaḥ dgra yi sgo brdung khragagi rkyal ba thobasaḥ ming nas 'bod bzhin nyes pa sna tshogs sgrogasaḥ nang dme myur slong shi chad glo bur thong spyo 'bog ston bzhin rang sha za ru chugaḥ 'o dod 'bod bzhin khrag skyugs gdong dug sodaḥ nad kyi char phob bgegs kyi sgar thob laḥ shi shul mi stong ro thog bya g.yel nasaḥ drag rtsal mngon spyod ston pa'i dus la babaḥ ma g.yel ma mo sgrub pa'i don ma chung ma bul sha za ro langs mthu ma sdugaḥ nyes byed 'di la bka' chad mi gcod naḥ khyed rnams gnad la dbab cing shi sa bstan pad+ma'i bka' dang 'gal ba'i

nar gcod 'gyuraX de bas bka' la gnas mdzod ma chen tshogasaḥ dgra bo bsad rtags don snying mngon sum sprod bh+yo ma mo sha za ḍashā tho tshalas tshal pa dum bu dum bu shag pa shag pa myogs rbad myos rbad tsat+ta shag shag tshal rbad bh+yo mā ra ya sod ces drag tu bskul la dug sna rlag pa'i dmigasa'adun bya'o zag rdzas te lam chen gyi 'og du mnan des ni dmigasabya rtsad nas gcod par gdon mi za'oḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya skal ba can gyi dpal du shog/ bzang dang mtharaphyin gnyis dgyes phyir nus ldan pas smrasate yi ge'i ris byed pad losabagyisapa/ sarba maṅga lo/

—8rdo: dag snang lasaX chos skyong dgra bla'i bskul byang bsdus pa glog zhags 'khyugs ma bzhugs soḥgatsasdo: na mo gu ru we 'a rlar+shacas dmar gar+ṣa ༅mas la khrugs gas bya rol lo sgra sder ngar glu yis bas ma g.yel dgra bla mthu bo che ma g.yel chos skyocanaX ma g.yel dpal mgon drag shul bdag ma g.yel chos skyong dam tshig can bswo las myur mthu ldan gdung sems cheX dpal ldan brag lha mgon po dngaḥsras mchog yang 'khor dgu blon po sdong ra dgra 'dul rtsal btsun mo g.yu lcam be ta btsunaḥ lha sman bdun cu rtsa drug bcas bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chothaba'i dgra la chosaḥ 'gyogs pa zhon zhing rno mtshon thogs mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byungaḥ do nub nam gung tshun chod la bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye'am ‘ gnas kyang ming gis 'bod cing skra nas 'then bla dang sgog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brangs brdung cho nges chugaḥ drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'i

dpa' skyems dam rdzas niḥ gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥ bas las la myur ba'i drag rtsal can myes po rma rgyal spom ra dang 'khor tshogs stong dang dgu brgya poḥ lcam sring sum brgya rtsa drug dngaḥ lha sman lha mo lnga bcu brgyad yang 'khor bsam mi khyab dang bcas bskul lo rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sogs gong bzhin 'gres la ming med mdzodaḥ bsaḥ gnyan nas lha grogs brtse ba poḥ dge bsnyen che grags g.yu yi rtse blon po bzhi dang sdong ra brgyadaX gtso brgyad g.yog khri sprul ba 'bum thams cad nyid kyi cho rol steḥ bka' nyan sprul pa yang sprul bcas bskul ma rbad do las la sogs 'gres ming med mdzodaX bsaḥ dam tshig gcig tu bsre ba mo snye nam dpal gyi dbang phyug rgyalaḥ grogs mdzad ma chen bcu gnyis dngaḥ lcam mo bdun brgya nyi shu lnga lha sring gangs dkar phyug mo dngaḥ nye bstod mched lnga yang 'khor tshogasaḥ bskul lo rbad do sogasa'agres ming med mdzodaḥ bas bka' nyan las kyi pho nya baḥ ri bzang rdza bkra 'phan phyug rtsal shan pa rdo rje khyug drag dngaX rdza rgyal 'phan phyug

—8rdo: btsan mched bdunaḥ tha tshig gsum 'dzin stag rtse dang las myur brag dkar khra phyug 'phan bskul 'o/ rbad do las la yaḥchos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chos 'gyogs pa zhon zhibhe rno mtshon thogasaḥ mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byungaḥdo nub nam gung tshun chod laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye 'am rib ba gar gnas kyangaḥ ming gis 'bod cing sgra nas 'thenaḥ bla dang srog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chugaḥdrag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'iX brngan pa'i dpa' skyems dam rdzas niḥ gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaḥ mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaḥbs dgebasnyen dam can rdo rje legasaḥ mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu'i sde mgar nag spun lnga khyung 'phan rtsal: nor spel las myur lha rtse dang: tho len stag dkar shing lha moḥ ko shing jo ti dmar nag sogasaḥbaskul lo rbad do las sogs 'gres ming med mdzodaX bswo rgyal dbang pad+ma'i tha tshig 'dzin zo dor rnga la stag rtse dpalaḥ dgyes bskyed dngul dkar mdangs bzang maḥ dge bsnyen g.yu yi phreng ba can nor bdag sil bo yis

dmar dang a ti mthon po she ne+e dpal bskul lo rbad do sogs bgres ming med mdzodaḥ bas la rgang mthon po gnyan gyi rigs sbor bo gdong la brten pa'i btsan ri rgyal phyug mo bdud kyi sde gangs bzang mtsho mig klu yi dpalaḥ lcags gnyan stag gsum rtse 'dzin rgyalaḥ gzher gzhong khra mor zhal phyogs kun: bskul ma rbad do sogasa'agres ming med mdzod bas bkra shis rdzong chen sa spyod gnas mdzod lnga gsang ba'i dpal drug dngaḥ bco brgyad che ba'i khams srid skyongasaḥ dpa' bo'i rang bzhin thabs la mkhas shes rab mi mo gsang spyod 'byed rdo rje'i rgyugs ging skar ltar 'khrigs ma tshogs pho nya g.yog dang bcas bskul ma rbad do las la yaḥ chos shig sdang ba'i dgra la chosaX mgyogs pa zhon zhing rno mtshon thogs mthu rtsal bskyed la drag shul byung do nub nam gung tshun chod laḥ bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo de nye'am ring ba gar gnas kyang ming gis 'bod cing skra nas 'then bla dang sgog dbugs dus gcig drongs spyo 'bogs brang brdung cho nges chug drag rtsal khyad chos mi g.yel ba'i0 brngan pa'i dpa' skyems

ga6sdo: dam rdzas ni gtor ma skyems dang dgra bo bcasaX mnyam por bzhes la ming med mdzodaX bswoḥ dang po'i mdangs 'char sbas pa'i yul 'go grogs brtse ba'i pho nya ba pha ri g.yas nas bya ra byedaḥ chu ri g.yon nas mel rtse mkhasaḥ na ba spangs nas gso byed 'gyedaḥ rdza brag khrod nas srung skyobs mkhan 'babs pa chu nas phrin las myuraḥ skye ba shing nas brtse gdung cheḥ 'bod tshe snyan gsang bskul las myuraḥ dam la gdung zhing bsgrub la brtse mtha' mi'i gnya' gnon rang srid skyongs byams la dgyes shing rtsubs la khro spug po gdong gi lha mgon cheḥ gzu bor gnas pa yong la brtseḥ dam can pho nya g.yog 'khor bcasaX bskul 'osgo rbad do las la sogs 'gres ming med mdzodaḥ bcol ba'i phrin las tha tshig bzhin ma g.yel myur du grub par mdzodaḥ ces bskul gtor ma dgra phyogs rdeb dmigs bskul 'di yang nan du bya rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer rdo rje'i rang bzhin spros te pho nya rnams la phogaḥ sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas ki bswo cho sgra dang bcas teḥ dgra dpung la mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab nas thal ba rdul

phran bzhin du brlag laX gzas pa po ming med du btang bar bsam moḥ dmod bor skra sprugs thal mo bdob dar nag g.yab la bskul 'bod bya gnad des dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur the tshom med do sa mamā rgya rgya rgya lcam mo gamu be+e ral ba 'byu gcig mas brda tshig ra las bskul don tshig 'di bkrol bstan dang 'gro la gso sman 'byung phyir bkod dge bas phan bde rgya chen 'byung gyur cigaḥ sarba maṅga le/

—'di: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las gter bdag sha za mched gsum gyi zab gnad gsang ba'i rgyud bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo dz+nya na ḍak+ki ni ya ༷ tho // skal ldan sgrub la snying rus can ༷ kha gsags bral zhing phu dud che mos gus nor 'byor dam tshig gtsangaḥ de 'dra byung na drag mo yiḥ skye rgyud bshad cing zab gnad bstanaḥ sa ma yāḥ sngon tshe li yul u sa la'iḥ sras mo a cam sbyin legs masaḥ chos kyi bdud rtsir spyod pa la rwa dza gdug pa'i skyen byung nasaX tshe dang chos la bar chad byung de tshe ma chen mkha' 'gro nyidaX bstan la gdung zhing yongs la brtseX bstan pa'i 'gal zla byed pa poraḥ drag tu 'khru zhing gtum rngams kyis dbyings la lceb cing srog blos btangaḥsha za 'dre mo'i gzugs skur bzhengasaX phung byed dgra sde thal bar brlag rtsal las byung ba'i sha za moX mi srun chu srin mgo can byung drod las bskyed pa'i sha za moḥ phyag brnyen dred kyi mgo can byung sha khams las byung sha za moḥ dur byed nag mo bya ba byungaX khrag las byung ba'i sha za moḥ kha kha mthing nag

bya gdong byung rus pa las byung sha za moḥhu lu smug nag 'ug gdong byung dbugs las byung ba'i sha za moḥ he le ljang nag spyang gdong byung ba spu chu ser rgyus phran nasaḥ sprul ba'i pho nya bsam yas byungaḥ pha ni bdud la ma ni kluḥ klu bdud bshos pa'i chas bskyed pa'i lcags kyi sgong nga chen po rdol bde ba'i drod dang bsil ba'i ba'i rlung bsil drod gnyis kyis bskyed pa las re zhig dus su lcags sgong rdolaḥ de nang ma chen sha za mo gtso 'khor 'jigs rngam tshul du byung kun kyang dri thang dmar por brtenaḥ dri yi yul khams phung bar byedaX mtshon chas gzengs pa kun tu 'khrug de tshe ma chen sha za mo gtso 'khor sprul bar bcas pa kun pad+ma dbang chen he ru ga'i sku yi 'jigs rten khyab par mdzadaḥ gsung gi nga ros dbang du bsgyur rjes chags thugs ni yongs la rol de tshe ma chen ma bzod nasaX srog gi snying po phul bar byas dbang chen pad+ma he ru gsaḥlus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs bstan pa bsrung ba'i gnyer byang gtadaX lce la dam tshig bdud rtsi bzhag mgo la dam rtags rdo rje bkodaḥ bstan dgra'i phung khams

gtsasdo: skye mched dngaḥ sha khrag drod dbugs rtsa rgyus snyingaḥ bzhes rol dam tshig rdzas su bzhag dri thang mtshams kyi brag dmar dang de dang nye ba'i gnas sum curaḥ bzhugs pa'i dam tshig mchog tu sbyinaḥ de rjesadabang chen he ru ga'i rnal 'byoranā ga rdzu na yisaX mchod rten pad+ma spung ba phu gsung mchog sgrub pa'i dam tshig la ma chena'akhor bcas 'dus ba'i tsheḥ dam rdzas gtor ma chang skyems sbyinaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa'i gnyer byang gtadaḥ rnal 'byor yongs kyi grogs su bskos gtsug lag chos 'khor gnyer byang gtadaḥ sangs rgyas thob par lung yang bstanaḥ dam tshig mkha' 'gro yongs su gragasaX de rjesapad+ma dbang chen gyi rnal 'byor khrag 'thung nag po yis gnas yul dur khrod brgyad sogs nasaḥ zab gsang gter gyi dgongs pa dngaX bskyed rdzogs bshad sgrub gzhi 'dzug tsheḥ dam tshig sha za mkha' 'gro maḥ gtso 'khor sprul ba g.yog dang bcasaX sngon gyi dam tshig ji bzhin duḥ pad+ma'i phrin las sgrub pa laX tshogs dang gtor mas brngan pa mdzadaḥ bde stong sgrub pa'i grogs su bcolaX gsang sngags snying po'i bstan

pa gtad legs nyes bsrung zhes dam mnos bzhin deng gi rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos ming nas 'bod pa tsam gyis 'dus tha tshig bsgrags pa tsam gyis 'dusaX dkyil 'khor bkod pa tsam la 'dus mchod gtor brngan pa bshams tshe 'dus bde stong spyod pa spyad tshe 'dusaḥ bskyed rdzogs sgrub pa byed tshe 'dusaḥ dam la 'dus pa'i sha za moḥ skal ldan yongs kyi grogs su sgrubaX rnal 'byor yongs kyi bran du gsol rig 'dzin yongs kyi grogs mor bsnyenaX dam ldan kun gyi mdza' mor mchod zas dang skyems kyi phud kyis mchodaḥ sha khrag gtor mas dga' ston phulaḥ de tshe phrin las ma sgrub na bdag nyid khrag 'thung he ru ga'i bka' yi chad pa drag pos gcodaḥ sha za srog dang bral bar 'gyuraḥdam tshig 'di ni bzod mi thubaḥ mi bzod gnyer blang dam srog can0 bdag gi gdung 'dzin phyi rabs gyiX skal ldan yongs kyi mdza' mor bzhag sa ma māḥ mkha' 'ayo skye rgyud gad pa'o rgya rgya rgya phya rabs dus kyi snyigs ma la gsang sngags spyod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rab 'byams phran las yongs 'grub phyir ma chen sha za bsgrub pa'i tshe bla rdo srog 'khor 'di ltar bcing bya mo nag mo'i snying shun la mtshal

—rten: dang bzang drug bsres pa yis ya ge dbu can tshag med duḥbh+yo / ma hūṃ dza hūṃ tsa tung mu kha snying kha rasmo dung dung 'dus 'dus dza dzaḥzhesabakod g.yu byur dung gsum dang bya mo nag mo'i sgo nga yi gser thigade pho'i khrag bcas gzhugs sgrub pa'i rten bkod mkha' 'gro bsreḥganyis med ro gcig bzhugs su gsol me tog 'thor la gtor tshogs 'bul sgrub pa grol tshe dngos grub zhu zangs kya ga'u'i nang du bcugaḥmachan khung g.yon du 'bral med bcing gzhan gyi mig lag ma brgyud na ma chen sha za 'bral med 'grogs gang bcol phrin las rab 'byams sgrub nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel bde stong ye shes gzi byan 'bar the tshoms med do rdo rje'ibaka'aḥs ma yuḥbla rdo sgog 'khor bcang thabs bstan pa'o rgya rgya rgya ma chen sha za mkha' 'gro nyid sgrub pa sngon du srog dbang gces rnal 'byor dbang phyug he ru gas mkha' 'gro'i bskang gsol rgya cher 'bul slob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyis sbyangs bgegs bsgrad bsrung ba'i gur du bzhug mkha' 'gro'i skye rgyud lo rgyus bshad dang spros maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhugaḥthog mar gsol ba gdab pa ni kyi 31gas kyi dbang phyug he ru ka rdo rje sgob dpon brtse bas dgongasaḥdam lngan tshol 'byor bdag cag laḥmakha' 'gro'i srogs dbang gnang bar zhu lan gsum bla ma'i bka' yis lan gnang ba na yinam chogs bsag

'dzom pa'i skal ba canaḥ gsang sngags snying por spyod pa dngaḥ sha za mkha' 'gro sgrub 'dod na rtsa ba lnga dang yan lag bcu yongs su dag par 'dzin nus na ma chen sha za mkha' 'gro yiḥ sgog dbang dang ni dam tshig sbyin slob mas dam tshig khas blang ba niḥhoḥ bka' drin can gyi sgob dpon dgongs bdag ni gsang sngags sgor zhugs nasaḥ so sor thar ba'i sdom pa srung byang chub sems dpa'i bslab byar gnas gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig 'dzin ma chen sha za mkha' 'gro sgrub tshogs dang gtor mas brngan chen 'bul bla mas bstsal ba'i man ngag 'dzin de lta bu yi rigs can laX mkha' 'gros srog dbang gnang du gsol lan gsum zhu rdo rje slob dpon gyis dam chu slob mar sbyan zhing gtor bran laḥhū trī gsang sngags dam srog mna' yi chu rig pa 'dzin pa'i lce la bzhagaX dam srung dngos grub tshe 'dir thob nyams na 'di dang phyi mar gnar de phyir dam sdom zab mo zungs gsang sngags pho nya'i gtsug tu bzhagaḥ dam tshig 'di ni 'dzin par byosaḥ bstan dang der 'dzin 'dus sde skyongasaḥ gtsug lag chos 'khor bshad sgrub srungasaḥ gnyis ka de ltar

—8rdo: gnas gyur na bdag nyid pad+ma he ru gsaḥ dbang bskur gzing bstod rtogs pa spar badz+ra sa ma ya āX tsit+ta na ra gan denasardo slob ma rnams pad+ma dbang rga sku ru gsal thugs gar dbyangs gsal ga'u tso bdud 'dul drag mo tshon gang ba'i thugs srogasdi ཿdmar po las 'od 'phros 'og min dbyings nyid las ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs bstems tsan pad+ma 11 ta seng ha kā li sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ pheb pa'i lha rnams brtan bzhugs bya de nas gtor ma lhar gsal ba slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la nyu trīḥ nga nipad+ma dbang chen rgyal nga ni bdud 'dul seng gdong maḥ nga ni pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dregs pa yongs kyi gtsug na mdzes sde brgyad kun gyi srog la dbangaḥ snang srid lha 'dre 'byung po' gshedaX gang yang bsgo ba'i bka' la nyon bdag gi rjes 'jug slob ma laḥ ma chen mkha' 'gro'i sgog dbang sbyin dur khrod 'dre mo'i snying khrag gtadaḥ sha za mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig sbyinaḥdang nas gsang sngags bstan pa srungs rnal 'byor mchog gi dam tshig niḥ sgub tshugs yang dag 'dzin nus naX rab 'byams phrin las ma lus paḥ sha za mkha' 'gros sgrub pa dngaḥ dngos

grub sna tshogs char ltar 'bebs don gnyis 'grub par gdon mi zaḥ de la mos gus shugs bskyed nasaḥ don gyi dbang thob mos pa mdzod mkha' 'gro'i sgog la dbangabasgyur shogaḥ bh+yo ma hū tsa tung mu ka snying kha rasmo dung dung 'dus 'dus dza dza tsit+ta maṇ+ḍal a bhi ṣiñtsa /ཿ mkha' 'gra'i sku gtad laḥ hū trīX nga ni pad+ma ste ru da bdud 'dul mkha' 'groseng ge'i gdongaḥ o rgyan slob dpon thod phreng rtsal ༷ don la gnyis med chen po steX sha za'i srog la mnga' dbang bsgyur mi snying rlon phrog chen mo yi sku yi sgog dbang khyod lasbyin phrin las 'grub pa'i mthu thob shog rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ0 srog sngags gtad laḥ hū trīX nga ni pad+ma he bdud 'dul o rgyan slob dpon don la gnyis med sha za'i sgog la de phyir mi snying rlon phrog ma'iḥ gsung gi srog dbang phrin las 'grub pa'i rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿgrog 'khor gto laḥ hū trīḥ nga nai pad+ma ste bduda'adul o rgyan don la gnyis med sha za'i srog la de phyir mi sming thugs kyi sgog dbang phrin las 'grab pa'i rtsa sngags mthar tsitā a ji 〉〉 hūṃ gter bum dang lcags kyu

ga rdo: gtad la hūṃ trīX nga ni pad+ma ho bdud 'dul o rgyan don la gnyis sha za'i srog la de phyir mi snying yon tan sgog dbang zas nor gter la mnga' brtes re gaḥ rtsa sngags mthar gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa (ཿ bsgral chas sna tshogs gto la hūṃ hrīḥ nga ni pad+ma steng bdud 'dul o rgyan don la gnyis med sha za'i srog dbang de phyir mi snying phrin las sgog dbang maro na spyod phrin las yongs thob shog rtsa sngags mtharaḥ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃḥ smon lam gdab pa mi ro dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i mdun sar sha za mi snying rlon phrog ma sgrub thabs bskyed chog ji lta ba bzhin du mi 'bral ba'i grogs su mchis par gyur cigaḥ rtag tu gtam gyi lab grogs byed par gyur cigaḥ dbang du 'du bar gyur cig las la 'chun par gyur cigaḥ 'bangs su 'gyur bar gyur cigaḥ bcol ba'i don thams cad thogs pa med pa stsol bar gyur cigaḥ 'grub pa'i rtags mtshan sna tshogs ston cigaX dngos grub bzang po char ltar du phob cigaḥ tshe 'di dang phyi mi don thams cad 'grab pa'i dbang dam pa thob par grur cigaḥ mtha' rten gto cing shis pa brjodaḥ dbang thob yon

mthul dam tshag 'dzin mkha' 'gro sgrub la gegs med dbang dngos grub yid bzhin stsol bar 'gyur ze tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sam yuḥ mkha' 'gro'i srog dbang bskur thabasabastan pa'o rgya rgya rgya dbang cen sgrub sa'al41ra la bar chad dgra yis rgol gyur na man ngag mkha' 'gro bsgrub la dbang nyamasartog yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka'aḥ sa ma āḥ me ma dbang chon gsang bgasung gi gnas bde mdzod rak+ta'i mtsho snyeng dang nye ba'i 'dod rgyal bla mtsho nas dus su sha za ḍak+ki yis brda dang thabs kyis bskul ba'i tshe mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i gsang mdzod 'di rin chen shog skyar pheb pa'oḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'ang lung zin dharma ku mu ying kun bzang bstan 'dzin dar rgyas dang mthar phyin rnams nas nan tan chen po'i bskul ba dang / thog sprul paza' mtshanacan gyisabakra shas lha reg bcas te bskul ngor/ she tho bdud 'a masabyung drag la gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda mdzod las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni chos bdag rjes ma de yis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo la/

—8rdo: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa las lo rgyus rab gsal me long bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: namogu ru yaḥ zan sngo skye/ slob ma'i dad dang gus shugs bskyed rdo rje rgyal po'i 'di skad sgrogasaḥ e ma rten 'brel rgyu mar mgo 'khor ba'i 'khrul ba myong zhen mkhan rnams don dam gdod ma'i btsan sa mchog la bsgral bar byaX des ched du khyed rang gi dad mos snying khung rus pa'i gting nas bskyedaḥ gsang sngags snying po'i nye lam la yid ches shing the tshom gyi spros pa mtha' dag chod par gyis laḥ rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi'i yan lag gi rten 'brel dbang gi brda yis don dam lhan skyes kyi dbang don mngon gyur du mthong nges par dgos pa'iḥ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi gsang mdzod zab lam dbang gi smin 'jug la spyod 'tshalaḥ de yang yid ches bskyed phyir rgyu mtshan zur cam zhu naX rdo rje khyung zhon khrag 'thung nag po rtsal gyisaḥ mchod rten nag po'i khri 'phang la brten bcas nas spror sgrol gyi tshogs ston spro skabs bdud 'dul nag mo sprul pa zhing rdul mnyam pa'i da la

dang bcas stabs gcig bde bar rol zhing tshogs nas gsol ba btab pa niḥ nyi ya glu dang po bde chen mnyam pa'i gluX ri gnam lcags yod pa'i rtse na mdzes ngo mtshar ba'i gsang sngags 'byung ba'i gnas ༷ bdud rū tra'i dpa' skong a la laX glu gnyis pa bsil ba'i tshal na sgrogasaḥ des rang bzhin chags par slong ba'i garaX don dbang chen sngags kyi dga' tshal te las chags rtog a 'thas thad gar gcod glu gsum pa mun pa sangs byed de de dur khrod bha seng gnas su sgrogasaX ma sha za srin mo bde bar bskulaX don gsang chen 'byung ba'i gzhi ma lagasaX glu bzhi pa yang le 31da du sgrogasaX lha ma rungs mi bzad dbang du bsdudaḥ don skye med dbyings su ar la gtadaX chos gsang chen snying po'i phun tshogs ltas glu lnga pa has po ri nas sgrogasaḥ dpal dregs tshogs dam btags zab gter gtadaḥ chos nang rgyud bstan pa'i sgon me sbaraḥ 'dis gdul zhing rig 'dzin a la la glu drug pa mal gro'i 'gram du sgrogasaḥ klu kya ba 'od de gong dkar sogasaḥ nor phan bde'i char 'bebs dbang du sdud chos gtsug lag bstan pa'i so nam

—8rdo 'byung glu bdun pa yak+ta ltag 'gro sgrogasaḥ dkor srung ma sgog bdag gnad la dbabaḥ las sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnyer byang gtadaḥ chos zab gter yongs kyi bya ra bcol glu brgyad pa bsam 'grub ke'u tshang bsgragasaḥ stod mnga' ri dbu gtsang smad mdo rgangaḥ lha dregs pa yongs bsdus zab gter gtadaḥ yul bstan 'gror phan bde'i mdzad phrin spel glu dgu pa mchod rten nag po 'diraḥ da ngan sngags sgrub sde zab mo'i skor yongs 'gro ba'i bde skyid gzhi ru spelaḥ nged 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod 'diḥ gnas tsa ri tsa 'dra tsa gong dang tsa'i rdzogs brgyad dag la rten 'brel babaḥ rje pad+ma khrag 'thung nag po yisaḥ rten 'brel gyi 'phro bzang ya mtshan canaḥ bu thugs sras nus ldan khyung drag pas lcags 'dab chag 'dzin ma'i khyon la brdalaḥ da dga' 'o skyid do e ma rmadaḥ zhes gsung nas ston 'khor 'du ba bcas te rol rtsed sgrogs ba'i phrin las dang bcas teḥ rang gnas su pheb soḥ mkha' 'gro 'dus pa bdud 'dul drag shul dbang mo'i gsang mdzod 'di nub gnam rdzong seng ge'i 'gram pa can dbang

phyug ci ta 'bar ba'i gnas su dgongs rgya btab poX phyis brin las dus la bab tshe o rgyan gsung gi rnal 'byor rgyal mchog bzhad pa'i rdo rje gnas de yi nye 'dabs su gang shar rang grol gyi dgongs nyams la bzhugs tshe ma chen sha za mi snying rlon 'phrog ma byung ste ki ra ka ra su su rta teX ngas mkha' klong bde bzhi gzhal yas suḥ kho dam sri'i snying 'dar mi bzod gter ma mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dam pa bzhugs der 'gal zla che yang gdan la drongasaX dus ma g.yel rin chen shog rkyar bsrengs nged bsrung ma'i tshogs la dpa' skyems phul las myur zhing bka' 'di mthu stobs cheX gegs bcu drug dbu ma'i dbyings su 'thor ༷ skabs 'bar ba'i me 'khor cha shas nubaḥ dpal las kyi rdo rje khyed thugs bskyilaḥ zhes gsungs pa ltar dbang phyug 'dod rgyal dmar po'i bla mtsho nas kho bo nus ldan dpa' bo'i gsal bar byed tshe lha chen glang gdong dmar nag gi sku gsal bar ngoms nas hi ra shar dzam bha la nas kha dog lad lho dmar po'i brnyegashed du g.yo nub grwal kha gong 'og cha shas laḥ byang sa 'og 'khor lo rkyen bsgyur phyiraḥ

—8rdo: las 'di ni gnam lcags thogs las 'phagasaḥkhyed sku la mi 'dod phral snang g.yo rkyen rang gshed rang nyid dbab na legasaḥzhes sgogs pa ltar phral snang glo bur chu 'dzin lta bu las dngul dkar ril bu rdul ltar g.yo bzhin dbyar rnga'i nga ro sogs kyi gzir yangaḥbade ba chen por lam slong byas nas ji snyed bkra ba'i brda gsang ji bzhin gsal bar byas nas phan bde'i gzi byin gdul byar 'bebs tsheX bdud 'dul chen mo 'bum sprin 'khyil ba'i tshogs kyi gzigs bstod glu dang bkra shis lus kyi me tog du mar dbab steX skal ldan gyi pad tshal smin par byas soḥde ltar mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi srog dbang dngos grub gsang ba'i bang mdzodaX byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zeg ma 'diX rigs 'dzin gyi rgyal po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dbang chen dgyes pa'i rdo rjes phan bde'i dga' char dbab pa lags te 'dir bsgrub pa lhur len gyi sgo nas zhugs pa rnams ni ḍak+kis bu bzhin skyongasaXdangos grub char ltar 'bebasaḥskal bzang gi pad tshal bskyed rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'bar rmongs pa'i blo yi mun pa sangasaḥbade stong

mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gañtsi ka la longs spyod cingaḥ nyi zla rlung gi 'pho bsgrod can mun pa ma'i dbyings su btson la bzung ste byi nang zang thal gyi sgron me 'bar byed nges pa'o des na gdul bya las can rnams sgo 'di la spyod cing dben khrod du bsgrub pa'i bstan pa spyi bos bkur naḥ tshe 'di nyid la bde stong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs grwal la spyod cing gzhan phan phrin las 'od stong 'khrugs nges mi bslu ba'i tha tshig goḥ zhes brda sprad nas dbang yon maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab nas 'jug goḥ sa ma wāḥye ma pad+ma gsung gi mtsho chen dang nye ba'i 'dod rgyalabla gnas nas dus bab mkha' 'gro'i brda shog las kho bo nusaldan khyung drag pa sa chos bdagakun bzang dharma tā bradz+nyā nya rat+na sogs dgyes phyar kho bo nus ldan pa sa dag par phab pa 'i dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅka le/

—'di: dam chos thugs gter 'dus pa lasaḥbadud 'dul drag mo'i rtsa dbang gzhan snang zil gnon rdo rje'i go cha bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo sedha ḍak+ki na yaḥ sgomachenashā bde ba'i mthar son las kyi mkha' 'gro maḥgazhan snang zil gnon sisnye ḍak+kir 'dud skal ldan pho mo smin cang grol ba'i phyir drag mo' rtsa dbang ga snang zil gnon bstanaḥs ma māḥde yang mdze pa'i dal bkod sgrub gtor dang bum pa lha tsaka bhasnye bdud rtsa dang rdo rje' rig ma shel rdo mtha' rten sogasaḥgazhu dang mthun par bkod la nyer spyod bkramaḥrdo rje slob dpon lta dgongs ldan pa yis bdag mdun bum bzlas rig ba' me tog dor slob ma'i sgo gsum khrus kyis sbya sa bar byaḥtho mtshams bgegs bskrad bsrung ba'i rwa gur phub bden don bshad la maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bya mos gus drag pos gsol ba gdab pa naḥ.e maḥlas kyi rigs mtshog garma dpa' bo dgongasaḥbadag la zil gnon mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'iḥrtsa dbang 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i sgog tig mchog:brtse ba chen pos rjes zung gnang ba stsolaḥlan gsum zhu'oḥbla mas lan gnang ba niḥ.e ma tshur shog rdo rje'i rigs can pho mo rnamasaḥyang gsang lam la mos pa ngo mtshar cheḥbade mchog

dbang gi dngos grub sbyin dgos na rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bsrung nus samaX mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa'i gnad la brtson nus samaḥ bde stong phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bsgom nus samaḥ de ltar ldan na dbang gi skal ba sbyin mi nus pa rnams skal med phyir dengs shig sdom bzung ni na moḥ mchog gsum 'dus zhal mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchiḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs 'gro don sems mchog bskyedaX rdul rnyed lus sprul sgo gsum gus phyag 'tshalaḥ snang srid ro mnyam mchod sprin maṇ+ḍal 'bulaḥ gzung 'dzin las nyon dri ma mthol lo bshags skyes bu gsum gyi dge la rjes yi rang gang 'dul 'gro 'dren chos 'khor bskor du gsol rgyal dang de sras mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo dbang gi dam tshig spyi dang khyad par lhag khyed kyi bka' bzhin bdag gis bsgrub par byaḥ dam chu sbyin pa niḥ hoḥ sangs rgyas dngos grub bde ba mchog sbyin cing sems can khams na bzhugs pa'i ye shes teX rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi ldan pas sbyin dgongs naḥ rang snang ye shes dkyil 'khor lam du khyeraḥ yo āḥhū hūṃ

la shārdo: āḥskyonaX zhes slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri yis thig le bya zhing lce la bzhag pa'i dam tshig 'di srog thob pa'i mos pa bya'o mig dal bkab cing me tog sbyin slob ma lha ru gsal bar bya dbyings nas ye shes dbang byin dbab de nyad brtan par bzhugs su gsol slar yang gdong g.yog bkrol ba niḥ ho khyed cag ngo bo chos kyi skuḥ ye nas 'du 'bral med mod kyangaḥ rtog pa'i dbang gis ma rig rmongasaḥ da ni rig pa rjen pa'i dbye0 slo dz+nyā na tsasnyu pra we sha ya phaṭa me tog dor ba niḥ ho sku lnga lhun grub dkyil 'khor lhaḥ bde ba chen por gzigs pa'i dalaḥ smon lam las kyis 'brel ba rtsa rig pa'i me tog 'bul bgyi'oX oṃ badz+ra pubye pra ti dza hoḥ lha ro sprad pa ni e ma ho bde gshegs snying po chos kyi skuḥ rigs dang dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i dalaḥkhyod la rang ngo sprad par byaX de don shes mdzod skal pa canaḥ a a āḥ pāṭaX de nas bum dbang niḥ hūṃ hrīḥ bum pa stong gsal chos sku'i 1ngaḥ brda don rtags rdzogs mkha' spyod kyi rten dang brten par gsal ba yiḥ rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur roḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ ku ya a bhishi3/ tsheḥ de nas gtso sku gtad laḥ hūṃ hrīḥ chos nyid dbu ma spros mtha' bral ba'i

dbyings: rang bzhin 'od gsal phyag rgya'i gar bsgyur baX bdud bzhi zil gnon drag mo seng gdong ma'iX sku gsung thugs dbang rigs ldan bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi nyiñtsa maḥ de nas rigs bdag gi sku gtad laḥ hū hrīḥ snang ba dag mnyamazangs mdog dpal gyi riḥ srid pa sgyu 'phrul dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhalaḥ gnyis med mnyam nyid rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dbang skal ldan slob ma khyod la yongs thob shogaX rtsa sngags mthar kā ya rdo rje bdud 'dul ma' sku gam laḥ hū hrīX nga bdag mthar mdzad rdo rje bdud 'dul maḥmun pa'i gos can 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro 'gyedaX thogs bcas bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i brtul zhugs dbangaX rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la yongs rdzogs regag rtsa sngagasamathar kwa ya rin chen bdud 'dul ma'i sku gtad laḥ hū hrīX mog rtog tshar gcod rin chen bdud 'dul maḥ mthing nag zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rngams shing brjedaḥ mnyam nyid rang mdangs 'bum phrag mkha' 'gror 'gyedaḥ kun gyi sgog dbang khyod la yongs rdzogs shog rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya pad+ma bdud 'dul ma' sku gto la hā trīḥ chags pas ma gos bde ba mchog

gtsasdo: la gnasaḥ ma rungs tshar gcod char sprin 'khrigs 'dra'i zhalaX zil gnon pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag giX sgog la dbang bsgyur dbang mchog thob par 31ga rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya las kyi bdud 'dul ma'i sku gtad la ka trīX gnyis rtog zil gnon las kyi bdud 'dul ma ༷ mthing gsal sku la 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro rdzogasaX snyems byed bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las rgyal phyir rigs kyi bu mchog khyod la dbang bskur ro rtsa sngags mthar kā ya rdo rje phra men brgyad kyi sku gtad la / trī chogs brgyad 'khrul ba ka nas dag mdzad cing lhun grub sgo brgyad gdul bya'i dpal du 'gyed mdzad pa rmad byung phra men ma brgyad kyi sku gsung thugs dbang bu mchog khyod la sbyinaX rtsa sngags mthar kā ya de nas dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi sku gtad laḥ / hrī gnas pa phyi yi yul la dbang bsgyur zhingaX 'jug pa nang gi khams la dbang bskur ba'i zung 'jug rtsal ldan dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyi sku gsung thugs dbang bu mchog khyed la sprin rtsa sngags mthar rtsat+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ de nas phyag ma' lnga gto la pa hrīḥ yongs grub 'khor yordul bral rdo

rje dang 'dod 'byung rin chen chags grol ka ma la bya ba lhun rdzogs rdo rje rgya gram rnams rigs kyi gsang ba rtogs phyir khyod la gtadaX rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta a bhi de nas gri thod gto laḥ hū hrīḥ snang ba dbang bsdus gri gug 'bar ba dang gzung 'dzin dbyings sbyor dpal chen dgyes byed khrag0 zung 'jug rtags dbang slob ma khyod la sbyin 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rjer dbang bsgyur re ga rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta a de nas kha ṭ+wāṃ gam laḥ hū hrīX dug gsum rtsad gcod dpal gyi mtshon cha che khams gsum rgyan rdzogs thabs mtshon kha ṭ+wāṃ 'diḥ dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyinaX he ru ka dpal dgongs pa mngon gyur 31ga rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta de nasadapal chas gam laḥ hū hrīX tshogs yul spros pa ka nas dag byed cing nyon mongs ma spangs lam du khyer ba'i dbang dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa khyod la sbyinaḥ las kyi khrag 'thung gsang gsum mngon gyur shogaX rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta de nas bsgral chas gam laḥ hū trīḥ bu khyod gzung 'dzin bdud las rgyal ba dngaḥ khams gsum bde ba chen por rgyas gdab phyiraX mngon spyod drag po'i bsgral dbang

—8rdo: bskur bar bgyi gha na'i dgongs pa'i 'khor ba dong sprugs shogaX rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta de nas me r+ṣa gtad laḥ hū hrīḥ 'bar ba'i rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i gzis0 chags sogs nyon mongs skems shing bsregs byed ba'i 'bar ba'i dbang mchog rigs ldan khyod la sbyinaX phrin las rab 'byams grub pa'i mthu thob 31ga rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta a bhi bzhi pa tshag dbang ni 'ja' shel gto salaḥ ( hrī sems nyid ma bcos chos dbyings nam mkha' che: blta ru med do nam mkha' rnam ra dag dmigs su med do 17sa pa'i mtha' las 'das: blo 'das chos sku'i ngang las nyi ma shar: a phaṭa a phaṭa: a phaṭaḥ zhes dal cig la mnyam par bzhag bzha pa gtor dbang ni hūṃ trīḥ brdal khyab chos dbyings dang mnyam bhan+ta na lhun grub rang byung ye shes gtor chen bshams: gang shar tshogs drug rang grol gtor rgyan spras: dengs 'dir skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bar dor thos bsgom mtha' ru phyin: bsam gtan bar dor rig pa'i rang ngo skyong : 'chi kha bar dor 'pho ba mngon du

gyuraX rme lam bar dor 'khrul snang rang grol shog: chos nyed bar dor dbyings rig ma bu 'dres: sred pa bar dor kun gzhi rang grol te: sku bzhi ye shes lnga dngaldan par regag: mtha' rten gtad cing shis ba brjod rtsa ba yan lag dam khas blang sgo gsum ltos med bla mar 'bul thabs des dbang thob sgrob pa dag nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar rgyasaḥ sam yu rgya rgya rgya e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra'i gsang mdzod 'di zla gam pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas nas dus bab dbyings kyi mkha' 'gros sprad pa 'i brda zhin du zab po bka' gtsigasaphyag rgyas sdom gu rgya brda zim zhes pa 'di'ang lung zin drag sngags dbang phyugakun bzang nas bskul ngor ༈ kho bonu ldan khyung drag rtsal dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pukhye bha dras bgyis pa dge legs 'phel

—8rdo: dag snang las thang lha yar bzhud rtsal gyi srog dbang phrin las lhun grub bzhugs soḥ— 〉sdo cha na mo gu ru pa dha ka ra yaḥ 3411)ste/ gtor ma sku tsaka srog 'khor sogs thugs mthun yo byad kun bkod nas gzhu bsrangs bskang gsol nan du bya dam bsgrags las kyi chu yang sgrub slob ma grwal bsdu khrus bgegs bsal bsru 'khor sgom la skye rgyud bshad rtse gcig gsol ba gdab pa na kye 21 dkon mchog kun dngos bla ma dgongs ༷ bdag ni byang chub sgrub la spro 'gal rkyen bdud las rgyal ba'i phyir dge bsnyen sgog dbang gnang bar zhu lan gsumaḥ bla mas bka' gnang ba naḥ e maḥ 'dir 'tshogs las dang skal bar ldan gsang chen sgrub la brtson pa dang srung ma mchod bskang spel nus naḥ zab lam srog dbang sbyin bgyi'oX mi nus pa la skal ba dmanaḥ de phyir rang gnas phyir dengs shigaḥ som bzung niḥn moX dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchiḥ 'gro ba'i don du sems mchog bskyed 'di bzung byang chub snying po'i b.raX srung ma srog gi gta' ru 'dzin so sor thar dang byang chub semasaḥ gsang ba

sngags kyi dam tshig dang0 sdom pa ma lus nam yang 'dzin de phyir sgog dbang gnang ba dang brtse bas rjes su bzung du gsol dam chu sbyin pa niḥhū hrī 'di ni rdo rje mna' yi chu sgob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag deng nas dam sgog thob lags pasaX spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i sdom ma lus srog gi gta' ru zungs dge bsnyen chen po mchod bskang gsolaḥrtag par rgyun mi chad par byosasgyu bga' sdod thang lha yar bzhud rtsalaḥ dam ldan 'di dang sgog 'brel bas las bzhi gang brtsam khyod kyis mdzod lus dang grib ltar 'grogs nas suX pha bu'i 'du shes nyer bzhag nasaḥ rtag par srung zhing bskyabs mdzod cig skyid badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan gtor ma la bran cing slob mar blud de nas slob ma thod phreng rtsal bskyed la yeshes dbab bstams bya de nyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol srung ma'i gtor ma btegs laḥ hūX nga ni pad+ma thod phreng rtsal zil gnon me yi phreng ba can dregs pa kun gyi srog bdag yin 'jigs byed thang lha yar bzhud kyisaḥ sgog dbang rigs ldan khyod la sprin gsol mchod bsnyen sgrub bskang gsol dang bstan pa skrung ba'i las la brtsonaḥ bshad sgrub

gtsasdo: 'khor lo'i gzhi 'dzin mdzod rgo ba lidha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrīḥ hoX 'jigs byed thang lha yar bzhud rtsal gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la longs spyod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig sru ma'i sku gtad la nyu hrī lha klu gnyan dang dregs pa'i rje ༷ dge bsnyen chen po mchog rab rtsalaḥ dam srung yongs la 'go ba'i lhaḥ gang gi sgog dbang khyod la sbyinaḥ lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang bstan pa srung nus mthu ldan shog kwa ya a bhi nyiñtsa saḥ sngags 'khor gtad laḥ ( hrīḥdri za'i rgyal po mchog rab rtsal sde brgyad dregs pa'i gtsug nas mdzesaḥ mdo sngags bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin paḥ khyod kyi srog dbang bu la sbyinaḥ gtam gyi lab rog la mchis shingaX 'bod rbad las la thogs med shog0 wāk+ka a snyi ṣiñtsa āḥ srog 'bar gtad laḥ hūṃ hrīḥ stong khams yongs la dbang bsgyur zhingaḥ legs nyes dam tshig so kha 'dzinaḥ rnal 'byor yongs kyi grogs gcig puḥ khyod kyi sgog dbang bu la sminaḥ rting 'dzin basmom pa'i grogs byed cingaḥ zhing bcu sgol la thogs med shogaḥ tsibyu a spyo 〉〉 hūṃḥ sba lcags dang shel phreng

/tad la hūhrīḥ dran pas bde sbyinadangos grub gteraḥ sgrub la phan bde'i dpal stsol zhingaḥ legs nyes ltong 'dzin dam tshig canaḥ khyod kyi sgog dab bu la sbyin mnga' thang/ ga rtsal dbang bsod nams rigs kyi bu la yongs 'byer shogaḥ gu kho.a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ ru ma tshon dang spu gre gtad laḥ hūṃhrīḥ khros na mngon spyodalas byed cingaḥ zhi tshe bu la snying nye ba 1 la 'gong spyo 'dre 'dul mdzad pa'i srung ma'i srog dbang bu la sbyinaḥ mthu rtsal gzhan las khyad 'phags shingaḥ dgra bgegs sgrol nus stobs ldan shogaḥ karma.a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī gis rdzas gto laḥ hūṃhrī dam tshig chag nyamasaskong ba dngaḥ dngos grub gegs med thob pa dngaX nyams rtogs 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phyir: ga ṇa tsakra'i dga' ston 'bulaḥ gsangaju gas lta spyod mthar phyin cingaḥ he ru ka dpal thob gyur cigaḥ mahā ga ṇa tsakra.a bhi ṣiñtsa masku hūhrīḥ smon lam gtab cing shis pa brjod des ni nyams rtogs 'phel rgyas shing phrin las rab(3mas grub la sogs yon tan bsam gyas mi khyab po sa ma yuḥ skyabs mchog bslu medag de yis zab mdzod bstan pa 'i dpal stsal ba chos rgyud 'dzin la phan pa' phyir rin chen shog skyar gsal bar byas sngags

—'di: skyes kun bzang gang de ya thugs kyi bzhes don 'grub pa dang bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon gyur nas mthu yi grags pa cher 'byung zhing zab gter sgron me sbar nus shog dge'o/legs so/sarba masgo la/

—11 gter srung gsol mchod bsdus pa ni dkar dmar gtor skyems rab spel teḥ bh+yoḥrdo rje khrag 'thung pad+ma he ru ga'iḥ bka' nyan dam tshig ldan pa'i gter srung baḥ dge bsnyen g.yu rtse rdza yi gser khrab dngaḥ mtsho sman klu lcam ma sring rgya mtshor bcasaḥ bsang ngo mchod do mnga' gsol dbu 'phang bstodaḥ pad+ma'i zab gter bstan pa dar ba dngaḥ rgyal tshab skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan par mdzodaḥdrag rtsal mthu ldan g.yung drung lcags rtse dngaḥ dam tshig gnyer srung klu btsan dbang mo che phrin las snying nye gnyan mo ke war rnamasaḥ bsang rngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshab mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling gnyer srung rgya mtsho dngaX lcags ri 'od 'bar bkra shis sgo mang dngaḥ yang dben khra rdzo gnas bdag gter srung rnamasaḥ bsang rngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rma rgyal spom ra co rdza re tu dngaX sring lcam tha le 'brug rdzongs 'bum yag dngaḥ brag dkar ri dbang la sogs gter bdag rnamasaḥ bsang ngo mchod do thanga' gsol dbu 'phang bstodaḥ pad+ma'i zab gter bstan pa dar ba dang rgyal tshab skyes bu'i sku tshe brtan par mdzodaḥ brag dkar sprel rdzongs sran mo dmar yag dang sgo srung

btsan rgyal 'bum sgos gnod sbyin dngaḥgangs chu klu sman dkar mo la sogs rnamasaḥ bsang ngo mchod pad+ma'i zab rgyal tshab grags pa'i mtsho chenakhri shog rgyal mo dang pho ba rog po bya rog gdong can dang0 rdza ri gser bum nor skyong a mtho sogasaḥbasang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshab 'bangs byed snying nye rdo rje 'brog gnas niḥpha ni btsan la ma ni klu yi sras phrin las pad+ma'i zab gter gnyer 'dzin pa bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshabs rin chen gnas dang bkra shis bag sang rdzongaX gang gi gnyer 'dzin thabs shes cha 'dzin rnams0yid sprul ting 'dzin rol mtshor da tshur byon bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshabs gser mig spong gis khyung 'brug rgyal dngaḥr sde'i thod gtegs nor 'dzin bse shing canaḥbakra shis 'khyil skyong dbang phyug 'bum rje rnamasaX bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshabs dung ri'i gnas sgobargya rtsa'i gter srung dang tsha ba tsha shod rgyal mo tsha ba'i rong lcags la ri mtho lha rgang mkha' 'dza'i tshogasaḥbasang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshab pad dkar thugs rjeganas dang gnas bdag rigasaḥbadz+ra gu ru'i gnas srung tha tshig

phraX canaḥ stag bkra lha rtse shing lo brag dkar bcasaḥ bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshab bal gnas bso thogs rigs gsum rgyal ba'i gnasaḥdhi yi mgon khangam je gangs dkar dang pe ri mthon po la sogs gter srung rnamasaḥ bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshab 'grong rismug po rnga la stag rtse dngaḥ bkra shis rdzong chen bco brgyad gnasagater bdagaX btsan rgod spun bdun mgar ba nag po dang ri rgyal lcags rtse sdong ra dkar po sogasaḥ bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshab tsha ba sgo brag pad+ma'i gsang phug dngaX ridam lung pa na dmar rgod tshang dngaX yag shing brag khra rdo rje stag dkar sogasaX bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshabs pad+ma'i sgrub gnas ya dben shel brag dngaḥ mchims kyi phugapa lho brag seng ge' gdongaḥ rdza yi ra ba 'o yug gnas bdag rnamasaḥ bsang ngo pad+ma'i rgyal tshabs gzhan yang blang rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang rgyal ba mchog dbyangs lang grolo tsā ba khye'u ye shes gzhen nu la sogs pa'iX bka' dam la bzhag gter srung dam can rnamasaḥ bsang ngo pad+ma'i zab rgyal tshabs skyes bu bshad sgrub sdeganyis yar ngos

zla ltar 'phelaX dkar phyogs dbu bstod legs tshogs dpal yon spel nag po'i sma phob nad mug mtshon rgud solaḥ rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par rdo rje'i thegaX yang snying zab gter chu bo bdun ldan skor lung gis bsngags bzhin bstan pa der rgyas nas gdul zhing 'bum phrag bye ba'i grangs ltar duḥ bar chad bdud kyis rgol bas mi gcod par rnga yab dpal rir skyel ma lam grogs mdzod brngan pa'i dga' stonadakar dmar gtor ma dang ja chang skyems phud 'dod yon bsang mchod sprinaḥ dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan du spros te 'bulaX dgyes shing brtse ba'i nyams kyi rab bzhes te thugs mthun bzhed don ma lus phun tshogs mdzod 'gal rkyen dgra dang nyes 'gyed bgegs kyi tshogasaX na pa' rkong sma phob rgyang thags ring par sprodaḥ mthun rkyen 'khor slob sbyin bdag mnga' thang dkoraX rnam mang thos sras dpal dang mtshungs par mdzodaḥ bka' bsgo'i tha tshig ma g.yel sa ma yāX ces brjod bsang spro dkar dmar skyems ci 'byor bdog pa rgya mtsho' bskangs phrin las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yāḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥbarda thimaḥdziḥzhes pa 'di'ang rigs

——1༷ sras shesarab thogasamed dang thabs grogs rat+na sarasabaskulangor kho bo rgyal marga bag pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i wāl bdo las zhal mas te dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pā ṇi'i ming can gyithagabs pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga le/

—— dag snang las thang lha'ibla rdo srog 'khor bri thabs zab mo bzhugs soḥ—— / nam gu ru ya za'itsa/2) ren chen shog dkar mdzes pa 'i ro ra bzang drug rgya snag bsres pa yas mu khyud rag bdun du bskor lte bar sku gzugs mdzes par bkod gnyis pa la ni 'bodasngags dang gsum dang bzhi par sgrub las sbyor lnga par sba lcags shel phreng dang gter bum cang shes gla po che g.yag dkar rgyan ldan ldon shing da ཿjor bu rigs gsum mdzes par bkod drug par dbyangs gsal rten snyingamajug dge bsnyen chen po rdo rje mchog rab rtsal gyas sku gsu thugs yon tan phrin las rnams brten par gyur cig gnas par gyur cig ra ba med par rab tu gnas pa ra gyur cig sa su ste sirnyi masgo leḥzhes pa dbu canatshags med bkod bdun par 'byu bzhi'i ri mo dang lcags zhags sgrog dril mdzas pa ra bkod yar tshes bza por khrus gsol byas dar dkar gsol zhi sna lngas brgyan rten snying stong brjod rab tu gnas der brten lasagazhung bsrengs te sgrubs phrin las ga bcol gegs med 'grub rdzas la 'od khyugs dra bzang 'thul ki bso cho sgra 'ur tshoms dang log smra mtsher sgra la sogs 'byung dam bsgrags gnas gzar dam chu bgo skye med dgongs pa'i
bcol don

shā1) gnas zung gter bdag rnams kyi dgyes bskang tshogasamachod 'bul ba phrin las char 'bebs bzhugs soḥ bkra shis pa'i gnas su tshogs rdzas me sa da dza gad gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' btung ba' (r+shadro rtems dum gcig gi snod du bsags lasngags dang phyag rgyas sbya sa bsgyur spel te 'di skad doḥ / hrīX rab yangs mi yi nor bu ka pā laraX dga' ston sha chang gtsor gyur bza' btung rigs yid sprul ting nge 'dzin gyis rab spel teX lha klu mi yi dga' ston mtha' yas pa yid mthun ma tshangs med pa sgyu 'phrul gteraḥ 'dod yon lnga yi lha mo bsam yas pasaX dga' ston sor rtser sprin te 'bul ba'i gnasaḥ gnas dang nye gnas zhing dang nye ba'i zhingaḥ dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod chen po dang tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho la sogs paraḥ dbang bsgyur dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gter srung rnamasaḥ 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaḥ gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i rol ston bzhes su gsolaḥ nyams chags rtogs sgrib bshags so dag tshangs stsolaḥ ma dag rlung sems rgyu ba dbu mar sgrolaḥ ye nas mnyam nyid bde ba chen por stobasaX brgyud gsum chig rdzogs gter gyi dngos grub stsolaḥ pusgri

ra ma dza len+ta ra dngaḥ 'go dha wa ra ra me shwa ra dang0 ka liṅga dang ko sa la yi yul dhe wi ko ṭa ma la wa brgyad sogasaḥ phyi nang zung 'brel gnas mchog nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'idapa' bo dpa' mo gter srung sogs 'du ba tshogs la sogs dngos grub stsolaX bsil ba'i tshal dang sku la rdzogs pa'i gnas pad+ma brtsegs dang 'jigs byed tshal chen dngaḥ gsang chen rol dang he chen brdal ba'i gnasaḥ liṅga brtsegs dang dur khrod dga' byed tshalaḥ dpa' bo'i gnas mchog brgyad dang 'brel ba rtsa bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor dpa' mo gter srung tshogasaḥ 'du ba tshogs la sogs dngos grub stsolaḥ gsang ba brda shod o rgyan sham bha laraX shā tra pa la gnod sbyin dga' ba'i tshalaḥ ro gtum tshal dang brdal ba can gyi gnas phyi nang zung 'brel yul chen so gnyis naḥ bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo gter srung sogasaX 'du ba tshogs la sogs/ dngos grub stsolaḥ rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang sgo rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas gangs dkar nyer gcig ljongs lnga gling drug dngaḥ phug gsum yang dben brgyad dang mon kha'i bragaḥ grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi dang

sgo phyogs bzhi'i rdzongasaḥ mnga' ris skor gsum dbu gtsang ri bzhi dngaḥ mdo khams sgang drug dag la gnas pa yiḥ o rgyan pad+ma'i byin rlabs zab gterargerno ཿ kun la dbang bsgyur gter srung mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'du ba chogs la sogs daro sa grub stsolaḥ khyad par grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung dngaḥ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs lang gro lo tsā yiḥ sku gsung thugs sprul nus ldan bzhad pa rtsal gang gi bsgo skal zab gter sbas pa'i gnas rdo rje rdzongs dang khyung tshangs stag mo'i rdzongasaX rin chenardzongs dang sprel dkar phrin las rdzongasaḥ rigs bzhir dbang mdzad gter srung dam can rnamasaḥ'adu ba chogs la sogasaḥdangos grub stsolaḥ tsha ba sgo brag tsha rong me long brag yar lung shel bral 'o yug stag sgo'i bragaḥ srin mo'i brag dang gnod sbyin 'khros pa'i bragaḥ mtha' dkar brag dang g.yu lung rngog zor bragaḥ brag chen brgyad sbas gter srungadam can rnams 'du ba tshogs la sogasaḥ dngos grub stsolaḥsor rtog yeshes rig pa'i ral gri nyid me lcags rdo gsum 'thab pa'i rten 'brel dusaḥ 'byung ba'i khams la

ye shes rgyas 'debs phyiraX snang gsal sbyin sreg me shel brda thabs kyi0 gab rgya grol ba'i dus tshig gnas lnga ༄tsho sngon nas g.yar dam gnos pa'i gter srung rnams 'du ba tshogs la sogs dngos grub stsolaḥ bya grub ye shes rdo rje rnon po nyid seng 'brug khyung dang rma bya 'phrod 'dzom dusaX chos can khams la chos nyid rgyas 'debs phyiraḥ 'byung ba'i rlung dang rgyu ba 'byung 'jug rlung0 gang gi thabs las gab rgya grol ba'i gnas yang dben skyid mos tshal chen rnams drug tu phrin las thog med 'jug pa'i gter srung rnamasaX 'du ba tshogs la sogs dngos grub stsolaḥ mi rtog ye shes rtsibs stong dpal 'bar baX zhing sa bzang por dor chas 'phrod 'jom dusaX rten 'brel 'khor lo chos kyis dbang bsgyur phyiraX mkha' dbyings chos dbyings sems kyi dbyings nyid lasaḥ gab rgya grol ba'i phun tshogs bcu gsum duX ye shes grogs su 'char ba'i gter srung rnamasaX 'du ba tshogs la sogs dngos grub stsolaḥ dag snang mi zad rin chen 'phrul gyi gnasaḥ dbyings kyi phun tshogs 'bar ba'i phun tshogs lngaḥ mdzod rdzogs phun tshogs mnyam pa'i

—11 phun tshogs lngaḥ shugs sgrol phun tshogs lnga lngas gzhi bzung tsheḥ gab rgya 1nga grol gdul byar khyab pa'i dusaḥ grogs su shar ba'i lhan skyes gter srung rnamasaX 'du ba chogs la sogs dngos grub stsolaḥ sems kyidabyengs la de bzhin nyid dbyings brdalaḥ rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs ye shes dbyings nyid 'jugaḥ 'bras bu'i nyingakhu gab rgya klong grol tsheḥ grogs byed mkha' mnyam gter srung dam can rnamasaX 'du ba chogs la sogs dngos grub stsolaḥ stong gsum mi mdzod phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas yang zab rin chen gter gyi sgron me nyid sgrib byed smon lam log pa'i sri bdud dngaX bar chad dbang gyur dam log slob ma yiḥ don snying dbyings kyi bdag mo'i dgongs klongarolaḥ brdzu rkyen gang gis mi tshug mkha' ltar duḥ phyogs las rnams par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ lung gesi bsngags pa'i 'bum phrag gdul bya'i tshogasaḥ nyon mongs 'khrulaba'i bslu dbang mi 'gyur bar pad+ma'i rgyal tshab sprul pa'i rjes snyogs teḥ zab gter chos kyi nyi mar lam byas nasaḥ rang snang 'od gsal rnga yab dpal gyi riraX sgyu 'phrul ston

'ashesar phun sum tshogs pa nasami 'bral tshom bu gcig tu 0shesad par regag de ltar tshogs mchod phul bas mthusaḥnyams chags nyes lhung dag pa da ཿtshe bsod ye shes yon tan 'phel don gnyis 'grubapar gdon mi zaḥs ma yuḥrgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥñtsā zhes pa'ang rig srasashesarab sgogasathed dang/thabs grogs rat+na sar mang yang bskul ro ra/bdag 'dra nu ldan rdo risamakha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i zhalabadus te dag pa ra phab pa'i yi ge pa na rang sgob pa ni'i ming can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/sarba mge le/ge rdo 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsolaXganyis 'dzin bral ba'i rol ston bzhes su gsolaXnyams chags rtog sgrib bshags so dag tshangs stsol ma dag rlung sems rgyu ba dbu mar sgrolaX ye nas mnyam nyid bde ba chen por stobasaX brgyud gsum chig rdzogs gter gyi dngos grub stsolaḥgong ma kun la 'gres so
