bsko/: zab gas ra rdo rje snying po lasaḥdha kai regs byed dbang mo'iḥbastan srung sha za kha mo che'i zab sgrub dug gi mde'u zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ—8rdo: na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra yeḥ thumasgroma'i11sko dam 'angs las skal ldan pa 'i skyes bu yis bsgo skal brtan srung grub pa'i thabs zab mo rig 'dzan pad+ma yi snying zig mchog shin tuzab pa gsang ba'i rgya can bstanaḥs ma yā de yang spyor ba dngos gzha rjes dang gsumaḥdang po bhasto dum bzhi' snod na du sru ba' sgrub gtor mnyen lhugs ldan pa laḥr 'dra gtor chung brgyad bskor 'dod sa bkrams byungaba' rak+ta 'byugs la mdzes par bya srog 'khor brten rdzas rnams lnga nyer spyod bshamasaḥkhrus da gtsa sbra sngon btang dam rgya bsdams ra nyad lha mo'i nga rgyal ldan pa yisaḥ/ bh+yogatum drag je la pa te ru'i gnas 'jig rung khrag mtsho khol ma'i dbusaXgasang sngags bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin maḥsha za ḍak+ki kha mo cheX sku mdog dmar nag khrag ltar khol spyan gsum rab bsgrad mche bgatsigasaḥzhal gdangs lja 'dril ha ha rgod dmar nag ral ba gyen du brdzis phyag g.yas spu gri mkha' la phyaraḥgayon pa'i tsit+ta dmar chen bsnamasaX gcer mo mi lngags

stod g.yog dang: stag shams rus rgyan dar dpyangs 'phuraḥ nyi ma zla ba'i snyan cha mjesaḥ 'od 'bar me dpung 'khrigs pa'i sang snang stong gnyis su med par bsgom: shar dudabug len nag mo dang lho ru snying 'byen chen mo dmaraḥ nub dbus sgog 'dren lha mo skrug byang du tshe bsdud 'bar ma sngoḥ kun kyang gcer bu sbrul chun dngaḥ mgo phreng stagashams mdzes pa'i brgyan: phyag na sbu gri tsit+ta bsnams: gar brgyur ya ma zung du stonaḥ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las la rngams me rlung dud sprin 'khrigs sang bskyedaḥ gzhanayang las byed bsam mi khyabaḥ kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sgog khyad par rang rang sa bon lasaḥ 'od 'phros gar bzhugs gnas mchog nas: spyan drangs gnyis su med parabastims rnga gsha rol mo'i sgra bcas te nyu bh+yo0 gtum drag rol pa'i gnas mchog nas sha za ḍak+ki kha mo cheX 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol0 mtshan nas 'bod do ma g.yel cigaḥ / ma mo sha za ḍak+ki kha mo che sarba sa ma yā dza dzaḥ de nas rten la bzhugs gsol ni ( (ཿ bla rdo 17ga 'khor rten rdzas laḥ ma mo sha za ḍāk+ki ni0 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus

—8rdo: pa ༷ dam tshig rten la brten par bzhugasaḥ ྅ ma mo sha za ḍāk+ki kha mo che sarba sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ de nas phyag 'tshal bya ba ni na moḥ gsang ba gnyen po'i bcud 'dzin cing ye shes bka' yi pho nya baḥ ma mo sha za kha mo cher: sgo gsum gus pa'i phyag tshal loX hūṃ ma mo ḍāk+ki ni sarba a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba naḥ / hrī ma rgyud mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtsoḥ sha za ḍāk+ki mched 'khor bcasaḥ dgyes phyir nyer spyod 'dod yon dkor: bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun sha khrag rus pa srog dbug dkor ma tshangs med pa'i mchod sprin gyisaX sngags bdag chen mo gsol zhing mchodaḥ sha za ḍāk+ki gsol bdud 'dul chen mo snying 'byin nag mo dbugs len 'bar ba gsol sgog 'dren lha mo tshe bsdud 'bar ma 'khor dang bcas pa gsol sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nong pa bshags bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar rlog: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs rgud pa sol: phyogs las rnams rgyal snang ba stsol: dam las ma 'da' sa ma yā: ma mo sha za ḍak+ki kha mo che/ sarba sa pā

ri wa ra ma hā ar+ghaṃ sogs shabha rū pa sogs dharma ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rak+ta ma hā bā lting kha ram khā hiḥ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni (ཿbskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus bstan dgra sgrol ba'i pho nya ba: zhing bcu'i gshed la kha mo cheḥ 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di bzung gdod ma chos sku'i bar skad cig 'bral med rjes bzung nas sa dang lam gyi bar chad sol: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa dang 'od skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzodaḥ de nas bzlas dmigs bya ba ni bdag nyid lha yi thugs ga nas:sngags phreng 'od zer lnga ldan 'grosaḥ dam can bsrung ma'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las rnams gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod bh+yo0 ma mo e ka tsa ti sa ma ya hrīng hrīng phem dzaḥ ces ci 'grub brjod la 'bod hūṃ ma mo sha za ḍak+ki kha mo che sarba sa ma yā dgra la rbad ces pa ci 'grub brjod la rbad hūṃ ma mo sha za ḍak+ki kha mo che sarba ka ma ya dgra bgegs che ge mo shur thum sod ces ca 'grub brjod la bsad de nas gsol mchod bya ba ni gtor skyems bsangs sbyangs grub nas slar hu bh+yo gakhum drag 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas rngams

gtsasdo: brjed rol ba'i pho brang nas:dgra bsad sha za kha mo che:'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol:phyi nang gsang mchod sna tshogs dang:brten bsgrub mthun bskang dam rdzas rigs sha khrag ja chang skyems phud kyisaḥsha za ḍāk+ki gsol zhing mchod phrin las kun bsgrub dgra bgegs sgrol:dbug len nag mo gsol zhing mchod0nad yam sol la phrin las bsgrub:snying 'byin chen mo gsol zhing mchod:dme 'khrugs 'thab mkhon zhi bar mdzod:srog 'dren la mo gsol zhing mchod srid pa'i shwa rdil khram kha bzlogaX tshe sdud 'bar ma gsol dgra bgegs ming tsam med pa ra rlogaḥbaka' nyan mkha' 'gro gsol zhing bcol las thogs med grub par mdzod:'bum phrag ḍāk+ki gsol zhing mchod:'khu ldog zhi zhing byams brtse'i skyo sa:mdor na srid pa ma mo yi:bka' 'khor yongs rdzogs gsol zhing mchod:sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs:nyams chags 'gal 'das nor 'khrul bshags bstan pa'i dgra sde thar bar rlogaX srid pa'i legs nyes rgud tshogs sol rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar rgyas mdzod

bdag la 'khu ba'i dgra bo yis: tshe sgog chod la ming med mdzod: drag rtsal che ba'i khyad chos ston dam las ma 'da' sa ma yāX ci 'grub grang bsogs gtor skyems mchod gnad des dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyuraḥ sa ma yāḥ de nas dmigs bsal che dbang gis dgra la rbad bskul byed dgos na gtor ma skyems phud bshams phral las 'gugs gzhugs grangs ldan grub nas slar bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs byas te rang nyid lha phas nga rgyal gyis hū bh+yoḥ mjigs rung rngams pa chen po'i zhing: gtum drag rol ba he ru'i gnas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khri steng nas: gsang sngags bstan pa'i gnyer 'dzin ma: sha za ḍak+ki kha mo che: gtso 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas: gnad nas bskul lo da tshur bzhengs bstan pa'i du tra zas su zo: nyams pa'i khrag la skoms su gyis nyes pa can la bka' chad chodaḥ zhing bcu tshang ba'i tshe srog gtubaḥ bdag la rgol ba'i che ge mo'i: phu nu nye ba rtsa lag kun: ming tsam med par rdul du rlogaX bsad pa'i don snying nga la stonaḥ bsnyen bsgrub mchod pa don ma chungaX bsad pa'i shan pa lag ma sdum mngag pa'i pho nya bang ma bun: sbran pa'i ra mda' snying ma chung: dkon mchog bden
